chapters.title: Chapter 851: Give a Hand
paragraphs: Four medical interns stared outside the window, trying to find traces of an ambulance. They looked like puppies waiting in a veterinary hospital for their owners to pick them up.
There was traffic in the distance, which meant that the early birds were already on the move to their workplace.
“It’s here!” Zhang Yuandong raised his arms. He narrowed his small eyes before he pointed at the front and sprang up.
At the end of the haze were the lights of the ambulance. They were flashing.
“Get ready,” Qi Zao was a little calm. She took a few pictures with her camera and then went to press the elevator button.
After a while, four ambulances stopped at the reception door of the Emergency Medical Center.
More than a dozen doctors who were ready rushed forward and swiftly divided the patients from the ambulance among themselves.
The four interns stood at the front, but they could not find the chance to help out.

When they encountered this kind of situation, other doctors would be competing with each other for work. When they saw interns they did not know, if they were not ready to give them work, they would just shove those interns aside to make room.
In fact, it was not just them. The older interns who were waiting in front of them and even the housemen did not have the chance to touch the stretcher. They were all forgotten in the main hall.
“Any more?” Li Bian’s voice was weak.

“No. This a mudslide.” A houseman who had a cold expression put on a cool pose and told the new female medical intern. “The parts that have the worst off from mudslides are always places where the ambulances cannot reach.”
When the medical interns heard this, they understood the situation. Their expressions changed a little.
Qi Zao subconsciously looked around. She saw several doctors from other departments shaking their heads slightly before they regretfully headed toward the elevator.

Usually, such a disaster required the hospital’s full cooperation. Basically, the people from the Orthopedics Department, who were the doctors most commonly seen in that kind of situation, to the people from the Craniocerebral Department, who had the most complicated skills, were all needed.
Most of the patients would only be placed temporarily at the Emergency Medical Center before they were pushed straight away to the surgical floor for surgeries.
But today, many people obviously had no chance to show off their potential.
“I wonder how many people were sent here.” Qi Zao instinctively tried to gather information.

“Four ambulances. Even if they were stuffed full, they can only get ten people.” The cold houseman sighed before he said, “The Bazhaixiang hospital branch can deal with minor injuries. Those who were transferred here most probably cannot even get up, and they’ll have to see how luck favors them. Well, don’t think about it too much. In the hospital, you should not think too much about this sort of stuff.”
When the four medical interns saw that the houseman’s expression had returned to normal, they were still dumbfounded.
The chubby Zheng Yuandong said, “I wonder how many people died.”

“Natural and man-made disasters have nothing to do with us.” The houseman looked at the four of them and said, “We are doctors. We try our best to save patients who were sent here. But if we can’t, it’s not our fault, understand?”
“If you phrase your sentence that way, you will get beaten up by the patient’s family.” Qi Zao had a very keen sense.

The houseman pursed his lips. “Why do you think people get sick? Because they are unlucky. Forget it, you’ll understand this in a few years’ time... Why don’t we exchange our WeChat username? We can keep in touch. I have friends at Yun Hua University too.”
“Sure,” the four medical interns quickly switched on their phones. Qi Zao asked, “Are your friends studying at Yun Hua University? Which major?”
The houseman stared at the feeble Li Bian. After adding her WeChat, he could not help but secretly sigh and said, “My friend is not studying there.”
“What is your friend doing then?”
“Mainly spending its time as a stray cat,” the houseman said. “I’ve fed at least three cans to that cat since it’s such a coward.”
In the operating theater, Ling Ran worked with Hu Congjun and helped operate on two crush injury patients back to back before he felt less tensed about the situation.

All patients in the Emergency Medical Center had been treated. Ling Ran’s skill in trauma emergency treatment was not comprehensive enough, and he performed better as Huo Congjun’s assistant instead of acting alone.

Hu Congjun did well too. He was so fond of Ling Ran all the way because of how Ling Ran spoon-fed him that he was so delighted that he was grinning. He nodded. “Those with good skills are indeed good...”
The junior doctor nearby was already sick of hearing the same thing over and over again, but he could only continue agreeing with whatever Huo Congjun said to flatter him.
“Director Huo, you have a point.”
“Doctor Ling really has good skills.”
“This patient is really lucky.’”
Huo Congjun was so happy when he heard those words that his laughter rang through the operating theater.

As the director of Yun Hua Hospital’s Emergency Department for twenty years, Huo Congjun spent the second half of his life enjoying praises from the public. If no one praised him, his surgery would not go smoothly.
When someone flattered him, Huo Congjun’s thoughts would be particularly agile, leading to him being able to perform at his full potential.

For critically ill patients, if Old Huo can operate on them at a high standard, the probability of their survival should be increased by at least twenty or thirty percent. From this point of view alone, Huo Congjun was able to bring out the full value of the junior doctor when he used him.
Ling Ran was so familiar with compliments and praises that he became desensitized to them.

However, it had been some time since he acted as an assistant, especially an assistant in a large-scale operation. He had been working for three hours, but those surgeries managed to refresh Ling Ran, as though he had been working on a task that did not quite require him to use his brain.
As long as he finished his share of tasks in the surgeries, Ling Ran would feel quite a strange bit of satisfaction.

He sutured with full seriousness and cut the patient’s spleen completely. He then watched the anesthetist and Old Huo work together to save the patient’s thigh. Each step was almost at the embodiment of the peak of Yun Hua Hospital’s skills.

“This patient is unlucky. He’s the only patient sent to us who is not a local.” Today’s anesthetist was Dog Anesthesia. He was smart and a little loquacious. After he noticed that the patient’s condition was stable, he would start to become chatty.

Old Huo just did two surgeries while he had compliments showered on him, which meant that he inevitably ended up tired. He straightened up once the anesthetist spoke and passed down the remaining work to someone else. He asked, “He’s not a local? What is he doing in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch?”
“I heard that he is a backpacker.” Dog Anesthesia shook his head.
“Alone?”

“Most probably. There is no hiking trail in that place. It’s just an old forest, and he probably went in there for an adventure. He was unlucky enough to run into a mudslide, but he’s lucky that he didn’t die.”
“His legs are saved,” Huo Congjun said lackadaisically. “It seems that he can only walk in the future. There’s no hope in him in running anymore.”

“It’s better than amputation. He’s also lucky that he encountered you, Department Director Huo,” Dog Anesthesia complimented Huo Congjun and said, “The patients dragged away by the Orthopedics Department haven’t been fully treated. Seriously, when it comes to the critically wounded, you’re still better in this regard, Department Director Huo. You’re already much better than them when it comes to treating the patients according to the severity of their injuries.”

Huo Congjun accepted the complicated readily and said with a smile, “I’m also fortunate that Ling Ran is here today, and the surgery in his abdominal cavity ended quickly, which meant that we saved some time to use to treat his leg. The only parts about him that is uninjured is his liver and his stomach and intestines have no major problems, or else, his medical record will be an entire essay in itself.”
“Department Director Huo, you have a point.”
“Such a pity.”
“They are casual injuries.”
“The king asked me to patrol the mountains...” Just as everyone was praising Old Huo, Ling Ran’s phone rang.
Junior Nurse Su Mengxue jumped up quickly and helped Lin Ran get his phone out of his pocket. She pressed the answer key and put it by Ling Ran’s ear.
In the mobile phone, Xiang Xueming shouted, “Doctor Ling? Is this Doctor Ling? I’m Young Xiang. The Bazhaixiang branch can’t handle the situation anymore. Can you give me a hand?”

chapters.title: Chapter 852: Overwhelmingly Powerful
paragraphs: There was a cigarette between Xiang Xueming’s lips, and he looked like an ordinary town cadre from Bazhaixiang. His legs were spread wide apart, and he was resting half of his back against the wall. His body was limp as if he had no bones. His eyes were glazed as he stared at the mountains before him while smoking. He seemed like he was admiring the beautiful scenery, which was something that could not be seen in the city, but he was actually hiding how lost he was feeling.

Li Kangxue, a contract doctor that Cangping District Hospital had just sent over, was standing opposite him. He was only in his twenties and had just graduated from university not long ago. He was not very skillful as he smoked, and this mirrored his performance in the hospital.
District hospitals were a good place for doctors to spend their elderly years in. But if a doctor was unable to get authorized, it would be hard for them to live comfortably when they get old.

Li Kangxue felt even more downcast after he was sent to the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. After he was done with his first cigarette, he lit a second cigarette. He sounded like an elderly man as he exhaled a cloud of smoke and said, “Old Xiang, aren’t the people from Yun Hua Hospital coming? If this continues, I’m really going to leave my post.”

“Only authorized doctors have a position that they can leave. Are you authorized?” When Xiang Xueming heard Li Kangxue grumbling for the first time, he got a little anxious. He was already used to it now, and he had come to realize that Li Kangxue was a person who liked to grumble. Hence, he did not bother playing along with Li Kangxue.

Li Kangxue did not expect Xiang Xueming to offer him any advice either. He merely said out of habit, “Say, not even a single doctor from Yun Hua Hospital is coming over to help even though such a major incident happened. They’re too lazy to even move their a**.”

“The bridge was broken in the flood, and cars are unable to enter Bazhaixiang.” Xiang Xueming was feeling very agitated too. The water level became higher and higher yesterday, and it finally cut off the traffic between the outside world and Bazhaixiang.
“So, Yun Hua Hospital would not be able to send help to us?”
“How would I know?” Xiang Xueming said, but there was still hope in his heart.

Even though Ling Ran was his classmate, deep down inside, Xiang Xueming admired Ling Ran as a classmate. Not only was Ling Ran good at studying, but he was also handsome and humble. Moreover, he was also focused on his job as a doctor.

This was especially true in the recent two years, ever since Xiang Xueming started working in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. The freelance surgeon, Zhang Anmin had extremely high praises for Ling Ran.
A mudslide happened in Bazhaixiang, and to Bazhaixiang Hospital Branch, this was an unprecedented challenge. Even though Xiang Xueming did not believe in anyone, he believed in Ling Ran.
He had neither a large hospital backing him up nor excellent seniors who could help him out. Hence, Ling Ran was the greatest person whom he could rely on.

When Xiang Xueming thought about this, he could not help but smile as he gazed at the agitated Li Kangxue. “Don’t worry. When a major disaster happens, there would naturally be great people coming to our rescue. The patients who are here with us right now aren’t that seriously wounded, to begin with. We just need to keep them in a stable condition.”

“Keep them in a stable condition? If we’re capable of doing this, the elderly man who had a heart attack yesterday wouldn’t have died.” Not many patients died under Li Kangxue’s watch. That was why he was so uneasy. “Please think this through and try to make us sound as pitiful as possible when you ask for help.”
“Can you do the same?” Xiang Xueming asked calmly.

Li Kangxue immediately became tongue-tied. His qualifications were lower compared to that of Xiang Xueming, and he knew way fewer people. Xiang Xueming could at least ask for help from his classmates and seniors from Yun Hua University, but Li Kangxue merely graduated from a mediocre university. He had even less powerful social connections, and he did not enjoy a close relationship with people back in university either.
“Talk about the pot calling the kettle black! It’s not like either of us is able to get anyone to help out,” Li Kangxue refuted, but his case seemed rather weak.
Xiang Xueming pursed his lips. He was about to say something, but he suddenly looked ahead in a focused manner.
Li Kangxue followed his gaze and looked ahead too. This was when he saw that a tiny black dot was approaching them with its back facing the sunlight.
“Is that a helicopter?” Li Kangxue widened his eyes when he saw the thing.
Even though he often saw helicopters depicted in movies, this was his first time seeing a helicopter with his own eyes.

Xiang Xueming had done his internship in Yun Hua Hospital, and he had at least seen the helicopter parked on the roof of Yun Hua Hospital before. Li Kangxie did his internship in a run down tertiary Grade A hospital, and he had seen way less of the world compared to Xiang Xueming.

As they spoke, the helicopter approached them. Xiang Xueming could see that the helicopter was golden, and he became excited. “The helicopter belongs to Yunli Medical Company. It should be Doctor Ling.”
“Are you serious?” Li Kangxue could not really believe it.
To him, it did not seem realistic that a doctor would personally ride a helicopter over.
The weeds growing in the clearing in front of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch started swaying vigorously courtesy of the wind brought about by the momentum of the helicopter.
Xiang Xueming no longer hesitated. He quickly ran downstairs to maintain order and asked the people who had gathered there to see what was going on to step aside.

“Stop taking photos. Hurry up and step aside together with your kids. Drag your farm animals away too. What if the horses get scared and run into the helicopter? Will you be compensating them for the damage, or will they be compensating you for your dead horse?” Xiang Xueming simply winged it. He did not know how to welcome a helicopter either.
Li Kangxue had just responded to Xiang Xueming before he immediately pointed ahead and whispered, “Someone’s getting out.”
“What?” The place was extremely noisy, and Xiang Xueming could not hear him clearly.
“Someone’s getting out!” Li Kangxue raised his voice a little.
“What?”
Li Kangxue shouted loudly, “So f*cking handsome!”

Xiang Xueming heard this clearly. He immediately turned and saw that the helicopter door had slid open. Even though Ling Ran was only clad in an ordinary large white coat, his presence was extremely strong as he stepped onto the clearing.

The blue sky, the white rolling clouds, and the golden helicopter served as Ling Ran’s background, and it only took him a moment to attract everyone’s gaze. After that, everyone could hardly take their eyes off him.
Xiang Xueming could not help but recall the first time he saw Ling Ran in university. He almost wanted to describe Ling Ran’s presence as overwhelmingly powerful.
“Let’s go and welcome him.” Xiang Xueming immediately smoothed his shirt and hurried forward. Even though he was still a distance away, he called out respectfully, “Doctor Ling!”

Ling Ran wore a natural expression as he nodded at Xiang Xueming. He said as he walked, “The bridge is broken. Are there anymore seriously wounded patients? If there’s any, they can be sent to Yun Hua Hospital together with the helicopter.”

The Bazhaixiang hospital branch was a lot inferior compared with Yun Hua Hospital. Even though patients with minor injuries could be treated in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch without much difference, the same could not be said about seriously wounded patients.
Even if a person were to disregard other factors, the fact that there was no ICU in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch alone was a matter of life and death for half of those seriously wounded patients.

Xiang Xueming hummed in acknowledgment, but he was a little hesitant as he looked at the helicopter. “The people in Bazhaixiang don’t earn much. If they have to pay for the ride, they probably won’t be able to afford it.”
“It’s free of charge. My department has paid for the helicopter,” Ling Ran answered right away.

Even though the helicopter belonged to a medical company, the cost of operation to fly the helicopter back and forth from Yun Hua City to Bazhaixiang was pretty high. Even if Yunli Medical Company was willing to do it for free, Zuo Cidian would not have wanted to be indebted to them.
Xiang Xueming immediately agreed and said, “Doctor Ling, I would like to thank you on behalf of everyone in Bazhaixiang.”
Zuo Cidian was standing behind Ling Ran and holding a medicine chest. He pouted. “How about us?”
“Thank you, all of you.” Xiang Xueming immediately wrapped his fist in his palm and saluted everyone in the area in gratitude.
He had been working in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch for around two years, and out of all the skills, his interpersonal skills had obviously improved the most.
The moment they entered the hospital branch, everyone could smell the strong stench of blood, and a cacophony of noises rang out.

The small reception hall which usually housed patients who were waiting for their turn was full of hospital beds right now. The patients’ family members who were here to take care of the patients were walking around the space, and it was so noisy that it could make anyone who stepped into the reception hall agitated.
Just by this scene alone, everyone could figure out what was going on in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.

Ling Ran furrowed his eyebrows a little. “There are three things that need to be done now. First of all, Yu Yuan will be doing planning for infection control. Two, Lu Wenbin will be dividing the patients according to the severity of their injuries. Three, clean up the operating theaters and the wards.”

A group of doctors who were clad in large white coats immediately voiced out their agreement in unison. Due to how synchronized they were, the patients and their family members stopped talking and looked at them.

As they spoke, the helicopter approached them.
Xiang Xueming could see that the helicopter was golden, and he became excited.
“The helicopter belongs to Yunli Medical Company.
It should be Doctor Ling.”
“Are you serious?” Li Kangxue could not really believe it.
To him, it did not seem realistic that a doctor would personally ride a helicopter over.
The weeds growing in the clearing in front of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch started swaying vigorously courtesy of the wind brought about by the momentum of the helicopter.
Xiang Xueming no longer hesitated.
He quickly ran downstairs to maintain order and asked the people who had gathered there to see what was going on to step aside.
“Stop taking photos.
Hurry up and step aside together with your kids.
Drag your farm animals away too.
What if the horses get scared and run into the helicopter?
Will you be compensating them for the damage, or will they be compensating you for your dead horse?” Xiang Xueming simply winged it.
He did not know how to welcome a helicopter either.
Li Kangxue had just responded to Xiang Xueming before he immediately pointed ahead and whispered, “Someone’s getting out.”
“What?” The place was extremely noisy, and Xiang Xueming could not hear him clearly.
“Someone’s getting out!” Li Kangxue raised his voice a little.
“What?”
Li Kangxue shouted loudly, “So f*cking handsome!”
Xiang Xueming heard this clearly.
He immediately turned and saw that the helicopter door had slid open.
Even though Ling Ran was only clad in an ordinary large white coat, his presence was extremely strong as he stepped onto the clearing.
The blue sky, the white rolling clouds, and the golden helicopter served as Ling Ran’s background, and it only took him a moment to attract everyone’s gaze.
After that, everyone could hardly take their eyes off him.
Xiang Xueming could not help but recall the first time he saw Ling Ran in university.
He almost wanted to describe Ling Ran’s presence as overwhelmingly powerful.
“Let’s go and welcome him.” Xiang Xueming immediately smoothed his shirt and hurried forward.
Even though he was still a distance away, he called out respectfully, “Doctor Ling!”
Ling Ran wore a natural expression as he nodded at Xiang Xueming.
He said as he walked, “The bridge is broken.
Are there anymore seriously wounded patients?
If there’s any, they can be sent to Yun Hua Hospital together with the helicopter.”
The Bazhaixiang hospital branch was a lot inferior compared with Yun Hua Hospital.
Even though patients with minor injuries could be treated in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch without much difference, the same could not be said about seriously wounded patients.
Even if a person were to disregard other factors, the fact that there was no ICU in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch alone was a matter of life and death for half of those seriously wounded patients.
Xiang Xueming hummed in acknowledgment, but he was a little hesitant as he looked at the helicopter.
“The people in Bazhaixiang don’t earn much.
If they have to pay for the ride, they probably won’t be able to afford it.”
“It’s free of charge.
My department has paid for the helicopter,” Ling Ran answered right away.
Even though the helicopter belonged to a medical company, the cost of operation to fly the helicopter back and forth from Yun Hua City to Bazhaixiang was pretty high.
Even if Yunli Medical Company was willing to do it for free, Zuo Cidian would not have wanted to be indebted to them.
Xiang Xueming immediately agreed and said, “Doctor Ling, I would like to thank you on behalf of everyone in Bazhaixiang.”
Zuo Cidian was standing behind Ling Ran and holding a medicine chest.
He pouted.
“How about us?”
“Thank you, all of you.” Xiang Xueming immediately wrapped his fist in his palm and saluted everyone in the area in gratitude.
He had been working in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch for around two years, and out of all the skills, his interpersonal skills had obviously improved the most.
The moment they entered the hospital branch, everyone could smell the strong stench of blood, and a cacophony of noises rang out.
The small reception hall which usually housed patients who were waiting for their turn was full of hospital beds right now.
The patients’ family members who were here to take care of the patients were walking around the space, and it was so noisy that it could make anyone who stepped into the reception hall agitated.
Just by this scene alone, everyone could figure out what was going on in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
Ling Ran furrowed his eyebrows a little.
“There are three things that need to be done now.
First of all, Yu Yuan will be doing planning for infection control.
Two, Lu Wenbin will be dividing the patients according to the severity of their injuries.
Three, clean up the operating theaters and the wards.”
A group of doctors who were clad in large white coats immediately voiced out their agreement in unison.
Due to how synchronized they were, the patients and their family members stopped talking and looked at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 853: Room-sharing
paragraphs: Dou Shuang opened her eyes and saw her father’s bed being pushed out.
Before her drowsy mind could register what was going on, she immediately wailed. “Daddy...”
“Oh, my goodness.” Her mother, sitting next to the bed, was startled, and she quickly covered her mouth before she said, “Your dad’s fine, the doctor pushed him out for an examination.”
Dou Shuang crawled up and looked at the people in the room looking at her while smiling. Then, she foolishly fell back to bed.
The father, who was being pushed outside, also heard her cry. He struggled to look up, waved at her, and said, “I’m fine.”
Then, he lay back on the bed weakly.

Dou Shuang looked worriedly at the corridor where her father was pushed into. At the age of seven or eight, she did not quite understand what it meant by examination, but since she could not see her dad anymore, she pursed her lips, and she still wanted to cry.
“It’s okay, it’s okay, your dad is just going for an examination.” The mother hugged her and rocked her. “He’ll be back in a while.”
Dou Shuang shook her head in disbelief. “Yesterday, you said that Uncle Lu was going for an examination, then, he was washed away by the flood.”
“Look at you, blabbering away...” The mother was instantly worked up, and she raised her hands as if she was about to hit her.
“Big sister, don’t take a child’s word seriously.”
“It’s no big deal.”
“What do children know anyway?”
The other people in the room took turns to convince otherwise.

The mother was actually just putting up a show. The people in the hospital were all affected by the disaster. Someone may have been washed away by the mudslide, but her family came out completely fine. If her child continued to talk nonsense, she would easily get hated.
Dou Shuang managed to escape from the disaster. She craned her head outward and asked, “How long will it take before daddy is back?”
“He’ll be right back,” the mother answered.
Dou Shuang asked with her youthful voice, “How soon would it be?”
“About an hour and a half.” The answer this time came from the door.
Dou Shuang followed her voice and called out, “Mommy, mommy, there’s a good-looking lady over there.”
“Yeah.” Her mother also sat up straight and stroked her hair subconsciously.
In front of her eyes was Tian Qi, who was dressed in professional attire.

“Little girl, your dad is going for an examination to ensure that he remains in good health. Once the examination is done, he will come back. Don’t worry, we can wait outside.” As Tian Qi spoke, she nodded to the others with a smile and continued, “Everyone, I’m the person in charge of Yunli Medical Company. Our company rented some rooms outside the hospital and would be providing them to everyone free-of-charge. The patients in the hospital can apply on a first-come, first-served basis. ”
“The rooms are free? Are there any garbage collection fees, management fees, or some kind of fees?”
“Can’t we just live in the room in the hospital?”
“How long can we stay there? My house has collapsed ...”

Bazhaixiang’s room was originally a large six-person room. As of now, more than twelve patients were staying in the room. When the patient’s family members were added to the mix, there were now thirty people in the room. It was stuffy and smelly. In such an environment, they were already lucky that they were not infected, which meant that they could forget completely about taking care of their injuries.
It was impossible to add extra beds for the patients, but with so many family members in the hospital, the danger of nosocomial infection would be too high.
Tian Qi came with the second helicopter and saw that Yu Yuan was incredibly busy. So, she took the initiative to take over the responsibility of evacuating the family members of the patients.

Right then, the patients’ family members in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch were not quite the same as the usual patients. At the same time, they may also be people who were affected by the disaster. Therefore, regardless of whether they chased them out in a rude or courteous manner, the end result may not be satisfactory.

Many people were admitted to the hospital with minor injuries and minor illnesses. Some may not have anywhere to go back to. They might even be homeless, and they could only stay with patients who were seriously ill.
From Tian Qi’s point of view, the best solution was to find a good accommodation for them and then move their families over.
“Our company rented three buildings nearby. All the rooms are free. Not only do you not have to pay for waste management fees, but even electricity and water bills are waived.

“Each patient is only allowed to have one family member to look after them, and they can only visit during the day during the prescribed time. This is the best for the patients, and it can also reduce everyone’s burden.
“Everyone, you can live there for up to two weeks for free. If your homes are not suitable for accommodation purposes, you can apply for an extension of up to three months ...”

Tian Qi easily answered everyone’s questions before she added a sentence at the end, “However, our company has limited capability, and we only have a number of rooms up for rent. Therefore, we’re going with a ‘first come, first served’ principle. Patients and family members who did not manage to apply, please do not take offense...”
As she said those words, the patients and family members who originally wanted to wait and observe the situation eagerly started to move.
“Then I want one.” Dou Shuang’s mother was the first to raise her hand. Both daughter and mother stayed to look after a patient mainly because they could not find a place to stay.

Her family was not directly affected, but it was a fact that her husband’s body had long been in poor health. However, he had always procrastinated from going to the hospital. He was hospitalized now, but that was mainly because he got a fever due to the rain, and his body felt weak.

As for her house, she could not go back right now because water had entered it, and she would need to clean it meticulously. In addition, the problem of water and electricity had to be resolved as well. But as of now, the hotels in Bazhaixiang were full, and the hospital beds were slightly cheaper.
Of course, even if the guesthouses in the village had rooms available, they could not afford them.
“I want it too, where do I register?” The man sitting at the door also stood up, glanced at Tian Qi, and lowered his head in shame.
Tian Qi smiled and indicated the location.
The man wanted to say a word or two to her, so he thought hard and asked, “Can we cook in the house?”

“It’s possible in most of them. We tried to furnish them completely with the necessary furniture and appliances, but some are still lacking because we just rented the rooms. So I’ll have to repeat what I just said. This is on a first-come, first-served basis. There will not be any kitchen appliances for the ones who rent the rooms later, but you can go to the public space to cook,” Tian Qi tried her best to explain.
At this time, the family members of the remaining patients in the room no longer hesitated, and they quickly went out to line up and register.

Actually, there were benefits to living in a hospital. Besides not needing to pay for accommodation, the hospital would definitely not miss out on receiving the government’s unified distribution of resources. Meanwhile, although the conditions in the wards were not good, that also depended on which sort of hospital room they were compared with. In contrast to the victims living in the schools, the hospital at least had floor tiles, sufficient bathrooms, places for bathing, and hot water. It was already considered pretty good.
However, similarly, when the hospital was compared to the residential buildings outside the hospital, the living conditions in it would be much worse.
Tian Qi smiled slightly when she saw this. She exchanged with Little Dou Shuang again before she went to visit the other wards.

In the examination room, Li Kangxue operated the ultrasound machine quite carelessly. He was not originally from the field of medical imaging. If he were placed in Yun Hua Hospital, he would not even get to perform an ultrasound examination. However, compared to Yun Hua Hospital’s doctors, since he did not know how to do anything anyway, so spontaneously letting him operate the ultrasound machine could be regarded as the best utilization of human resources.

That was one of the benefits of a small hospital. There was no specialization whatsoever in it, and the medical staff had a chance to get involved in every field. After all, there was only so much hospital equipment. Whoever wanted to try them would not be rejected.
But it was only limited to those who knew how to operate the equipment.
Li Kangxue rubbed on the patient’s stomach for a long time, plus the scan obtained was also a little vague and blurry.
“I don’t see anything,” Li Kangxue said to himself.
“Why not look at my head? I usually have a severe headache.” Dou Shuang’s father, Dou Shan, frowned. His face was pale.
Ling Ran came over from the end of the examination room. The area of a village hospital was only so large, and it really saved some stamina for doctors when it came to walking.
“Is your face always so pale?” Ling Ran glanced at the B-scan and asked.
“Over the past few years, I am indeed a little pale, but that’s probably because I did not get any sun...” Dou Shan replied while giving an explanation.
Ling Ran asked, “Is it anemia?”
“It seems like it ...”
Ling Ran looked at the B-Scan again. Without further hesitation, he said to Ma Yanlin next to him, “Give him a colonoscopy.”
Ma Yanlin answered to the order before he lowered his head diffidently. He looked around but did not see Yu Yuan. Then, he exhaled softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 854: Yellow Lump
paragraphs: “Do sign the informed consent form. After this, we will be giving you a colon cleanse.” Ma Yanlin brought an informed consent form over and passed it to the patient, Dou Shan so that he could read it. He then asked, “Where’re your family members?”
“They’re in the ward.” Dou Shan was lying on his back, and he spoke a little arduously.
Ma Yanlin looked around and saw that there were still patients queueing up. “Then, go ahead and sign the form first. I’ll inform your family members later. It’s just a minor surgery, anyway.”

“Can’t I go without it? I’m just having a bit of a headache and feeling a little weak. I got caught in the rain yesterday, so I have a fever...” Dou Shan was merely an honest farmer in Bazhaixiang, and he reared a few sows on the side so that he could make money out of the piglets they gave birth to. He did not have medical insurance, and he had no faith in hospitals either. His brain was shutting down at the sound of the word “surgery”.
Ma Yanlin knew what was on Dou Shan’s mind just by looking at his expression.

Even though Ma Yanlin was considered an inexperienced doctor in the Ling Treatment Group, if you were to factor in his internship, he had been a doctor for six years. Along with his years as a medical student, he had been in the field of medicine for over ten years. If he were in another profession, he would be part of the backbone of the company already. But in the hospital, he was nothing but a junior resident doctor.
Dou Shan was an inexperienced patient. After he took the informed consent form, he looked like he wanted to sign it but was too afraid to.
When Ma Yanlin saw this, he had no choice but to explain, “We’re mainly cleaning your colon right now, with the purpose of looking at the condition of your colon...”

Ma Yanlin spent some time explaining things to Dou Shan, and even though Dou Shan did not really understand anything, because of how amicable and patient Ma Yanlin was, he could feel less of a gap between them. So, he ended up signing the informed consent form.

Ma Yanlin took the informed consent form from him and turned to pass it to Qi Zao, the medical intern who was standing guard beside Ma Yanlin and seemed a little dumb. “keep this. All informed consent forms have to be filed.”
“Okay.” Qi Zao took the form and subconsciously glanced at it. She suddenly burst out laughing.
“What’s the matter?” Ma Yanlin furrowed his eyebrows. ‘How can she laugh in the patient’s face?’
Qi Zao realized that she had made a mistake too. She immediately stopped laughing. While she was at it, she pointed at the emergency contact column on the form for Ma Yanlin to see.
Ma Yanlin looked at it and saw that to the right of the subheading “relationship with the other party”, which was under the heading “emergency contact”, Dou Shan had written two words—pretty good.
“Pfft...”
Ma Yanlin swallowed his laughter and snorted instead.
A doctor must have been in the field of medicine for ten years to be able to swallow his laughter in such a natural manner by making a sound that did not sound like laughter at all.

“Ask him to fill in a new form.” Ma Yanlin did not turn as he was worried that he would not be able to hold back his laughter. A doctor must have been in the field of medicine for fifteen years to be able to hold back laughter while looking at the patient’s face.

Qi Zao held back her laughter so hard that her eyes turned red. She lowered her head and hummed in acknowledgment. She pretended to be rummaging for the informed consent form, but she was actually laughing to her heart’s content. Only when she was done laughing did she emerge. This time, she went to look for the patient’s family member so that the family member could sign the informed consent form together with the patient.
The patient ingested polyethylene glycol-electrolyte solution.
He then emptied his bowels.
His feces was sent for a pathological examination.
When all the preparations were done, Yu Yuan, who had just completed her tasks at hand, happened to pass by the examination room and saw that Ma Yanlin was preparing to carry out a colonoscopy.
Ling Ran, too, walked into the examination room at about the same time.
“You have not gotten started yet?” Ling Ran glanced at Ma Yanlin.
“I’ll immediately do it...” Ma Yanlin looked to the right a little diffidently.
It was only then that Ling Ran noticed that Yu Yuan was there. He asked, “How’s the situation regarding infection control?”

“There are quite a lot of problems, but because Yunli Medical Company helped transport some patients away, there are fewer patients in the hospital now. I feel that right now, we should put our main focus on categorizing patients,” Yu Yuan quickly answered.

Ling Ran nodded. The scope of infection control was specific but large, and it was something that a person would need to investigate personally before he had the right to speak. Ling Ran had no time for it right then, so he had no choice but to recognize Yu Yuan’s work.

After all, the Ling Treatment Group had been executing infection control in Yun Hua Hospital for a long time, so its members were pretty experienced in it already. Yu Yuan had enough knowledge to handle the infection control of a village hospital.

Even if Ling Ran were to join Yu Yuan in her efforts, the infection control would not necessarily be better. Moreover, with the Bazhaixiang hospital branch’s situation right now, the quality of infection control that could be achieved did not really depend on the doctors’ skills.
It was just like the categorization of patients. If they did not receive help from Yunli Medical Company, they would not have been able to carry it out this well.
From what Ling Ran could see right then, it was considered quite a feat to be able to achieve all this in the span of one day.
“Since Yu Yuan is here, both of you can carry out the colonoscopy together.” Ling Ran stood aside with his hands clasped behind his back.

Internationally, colonoscopes that only needed to be operated by one person were more commonly used. However, as the Bazhaixiang hospital branch was not equipped with the newest technology, they were still using the traditional kind of colonoscopes that had to be operated by two people.
Ling Ran did not like to carry out colonoscopies, anyway. Since Yu Yuan was around, he let her do it.
Yu Yuan immediately laughed out loud, and she did not bother to put on a polite front and say no. She took the position of the chief surgeon and ordered Ma Yanlin, “Intramuscular injection of 654-2.”
She sounded so forceful that it was as if a four-feet-seven canon was being fired.
“Intramuscular injection of 654-2,” Ma Yanlin repeated. He did not mind giving up the position of the chief surgeon, as Yu Yuan was a lot more experienced than him. She was basically his senior.
Next, a tube full of raceanisodamine was injected.
Yu Yuan then placed a cotton ball that was sterilized using 1% lidocaine into a steel tube. Two or three minutes later, she excitedly got started.
The patient was lying on the examination bed, and he did not look like he cared about anything anymore.

Everyone who was going through a colonoscopy, especially the men, basically had the same expression. It was as if they had practiced it beforehand in an acting class catered for people who were going to receive a colonoscopy.
Yu Yuan glanced at his wrinkly face and saw that the changes in his facial expression were normal. She then focused on his anus.
Ling Ran looked at the screen too.

The patient had been experiencing anemia and fatigue for a long time, and the first impression a doctor would get from these symptoms was that the patient was suffering from gastrointestinal bleeding. If the doctor were to make further deductions from there, the diagnosis would not really be an optimistic one.
On the other hand, the patient’s abdomen was soft, without any tenderness or rebound tenderness. His abdominal muscles were not tensed either.
From the information he had at that moment, Ling Ran could not really give an exact diagnosis.

However, surgeons had always been very hands-on when it came to making diagnoses. They were not like internists who would think long and hard before making a diagnosis. Instead, they would carry out all kinds of tests and examinations and use them as the basis for their diagnosis.
Ling Ran’s main weapon when it came to making diagnoses was physical examination. He would then add on to the information obtained by sending his patients for medical imaging.

“keep this.

“Okay.” Qi Zao took the form and subconsciously glanced at it.
She suddenly burst out laughing.
“What’s the matter?” Ma Yanlin furrowed his eyebrows.

Qi Zao realized that she had made a mistake too.
She immediately stopped laughing.

Ma Yanlin looked at it and saw that to the right of the subheading “relationship with the other party”, which was under the heading “emergency contact”, Dou Shan had written two words—pretty good.
“Pfft...”
Ma Yanlin swallowed his laughter and snorted instead.
A doctor must have been in the field of medicine for ten years to be able to swallow his laughter in such a natural manner by making a sound that did not sound like laughter at all.

A doctor must have been in the field of medicine for fifteen years to be able to hold back laughter while looking at the patient’s face.
Qi Zao held back her laughter so hard that her eyes turned red.
She lowered her head and hummed in acknowledgment.
She pretended to be rummaging for the informed consent form, but she was actually laughing to her heart’s content.
Only when she was done laughing did she emerge.
This time, she went to look for the patient’s family member so that the family member could sign the informed consent form together with the patient.
The patient ingested polyethylene glycol-electrolyte solution.
He then emptied his bowels.
His feces was sent for a pathological examination.

chapters.title: Chapter 855: Catch the Worm
paragraphs: “Should be a tapeworm! So rare...” Yu Yuan mumbled to herself.
Ling Ran had read about it before, so he just remembered some information about it before he acknowledged what Yu Yuan said, “It’s indeed a tapeworm.”
Ma Yanlin looked with the corner of his eye while he thought secretly, ‘While Yu Yuan is no good with surgeries, she’s pretty good at recognizing parasites.’
Right then, Ling Ran said, “Talk to the laboratory, ask them to look for worm eggs from the fecal examination and confirm the species.”
Ma Yanlin quickly answered, “Their laboratory has only one machine, and it’s quite rare to see tapeworms now, right?”
“The last record of tapeworms in Yun Hua Hospital was three years ago.” Yu Yuan possessed a strong memory. She had an expression on her face that said that she was recalling the past.
Ma Yanlin gasped in amazement. “So, we have met something good.”
The patient’s facial expression became worried at this moment. He could not move, so he could only crane his neck and say, “What did you see?”

“A parasite. We’ll take it out, then you’ll be fine after taking some medicine. Don’t worry, and don’t move,” Ling Ran answered to comfort the patient and ensure that he could retain his posture for the surgery.

Yu Yuan did not have anything to do, so she also walked two steps forward and stood at a place where the patient could see her from the bed. She asked, “Do you have a habit of eating raw pork or other frozen foods?”
“No,” the patient denied.
“Have you ever approached any cattle or the manure from cattle?” Yu Yuan was asking about his lifestyle, and this was the standard procedure when encountering parasites.

At that moment, the patient felt so bloated that he could not describe the feeling. With a twisted expression, he said, “I raise pigs at home, so of course, I come in touch with pig manure. A farmer’s life is different from that of city people like you.”
Yu Yuan slowly nodded, and after a few seconds, she asked, “Then, do you fertilize the vegetable field with pig manure?”
“Sometimes.”

“You may have been infected that way.” Yu Yuan asked a few more questions while she also made some records. For a patient who did not engage in any indecent sexual acts, never went out of the country and rarely went to other places, his life history tended to be simple. He raised pigs at home and used pig manure as fertilizer, so Yu Yuan did not need to have her imagination run wild and conjure up a scenario like a blonde girl from the United States ate the sashimi from Japan and decided to come to Bazhaixiang to search for the true meaning of life. During that time, she went insane and bit a middle-aged farmer and infected him with pork tapeworm.
At the same time, Ling Ran chased after the tapeworm to the ileocecal junction, and when the tapeworm squirmed upward along the ileocecal junction, Ling Ran quickly said, “Grasping forceps.”
Yu Yuan immediately turned around when she heard him.
Then, Ling Ran pushed the five-clawed grasping forceps into the body along the path of biopsy forceps and quickly clamped the midsection of the flat and golden tapeworm.

The tapeworm that originally kept moving in the intestines instantly curled up, as if it wanted to attack the grasping forceps made with alloy. Its appearance was like a skater boy who chased after his youth and dreams in a tunnel and wanted to crush a police car with his passion and speed.
“You can pull it out directly.” Yu Yuan’s voice was laced with excitement, and she heaped praises on the tapeworm. “It sure is big.”
Ma Yanlin stared at the flat, yellowish worm that occupied most of the screen, and he could not help but shiver. “It’s really fat. I wonder what exactly it ate to get so fat.”
“Well, one thing’s for sure, it doesn’t eat feces.” Yu Yuan cast a glance at him, then looked at the screen and said, “If you look at it closely, it’s quite cute.”
“Wh-Which part of it is cute, exactly?” Ma Yanlin’s voice was trembling.

“For one, its color is pretty. There aren’t many colorful animals in nature. The golden retriever in the city is normal compared with this tapeworm.” Yu Yuan gulped before she continued, “Besides, look at its body. It’s so soft and seems really bouncy...”
Ma Yanlin looked at Yu Yuan coldly.
Doctor Yu today was excited, just as usual, and her small body showed a strong sense of curiosity.
Ling Ran firmly yet slowly pulled the tapeworm out of the patient’s body.
The tapeworm that left the host rolled over its body arduously, as if it was very difficult for it to adapt to the air outside.
The tapeworm that left the monitor and was dragged out of the body was like a snail that lost its shell. It was about three feet long.
Yu Yuan looked at it seriously for a few seconds before she put on a contemptuous look.
“What should we do now?” Ma Yanlin felt as if there were ants crawling all over his body.
Yu Yuan said with great familiarity, “The adult worm has been pulled out, so the rest of the task is to handle the eggs. I’m familiar with this, can I handle it?”
She raised her head and asked Ling Ran.
Ling Ran did not hesitate. He finished the colonoscopy, then passed the disheartened patient to Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan happily called a nurse over before she left with her.
Outside the door were the concerned voices from the patient’s family members. “Old Dou, did the surgery go smoothly? Did you feel pain?”
“Old Dou, is your body okay?”
“Old Dou, there’s nothing wrong, right?”
The voices outside the door were getting further. Ma Yanlin finally composed himself and was ready to call the next patient over.

Qi Zao, the intern stood outside, and she could not help but sigh at that moment. “If your surname is Dou, you can actually have it pretty easy, especially in the northern region. You can always deceive girls and make them carry your child. ”
“Pfft.” Ma Yanlin snickered. He spoke in the sentimental tone of an experienced person, “Trust me, it’s not easy to be a father.”
At four o’clock in the morning.
Ling Ran held a cup of Energy Serum and took some sips while he randomly casually through research articles.
He took too much Energy Serum today, so he could not fall asleep at night. All he could do was to read some articles and do something boring.

However, the most important reason was because of the bad basic condition in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. He could not even perform surgeries in succession. At night, everyone was exhausted, so they could only end work earlier.
Ling Ran found it slightly regretful. Based on his efficiency, if he could perform surgeries nonstop until the next morning, most of the trauma patients would have been treated.
However, when Ling Ran lifted his cup of Energy Serum again, he found himself not bothered by this fact.

Bazhaixiang was a small place, and the Bazhaixiang hospital branch was a branch of Cangping District Hospital, so it should be considered the minority among minorities. Even if it received help from tens of medical staff from Yun Hua Hospital as well as a few helicopters, it was very hard to perform better when the hospital was only equipped with the basics.

After experiencing the massive flood in Brazil, performing more than a hundred freelance surgeries, and staying in the Emergency Medical Center for so long, Ling Ran understood very well that different hospitals had different standards.

“The management of the operating theater still needs to be strengthened.” Ling Ran drank the Energy Serum, while he stared at the starry sky above him, which was rarely seen in Yun Hua, and reorganized his mindset.
For a normal doctor, reorganizing the operating theater of another hospital might be something arduous but fruitless.
However, for Ling Ran, it was just a measure to provide more support to him when he performed surgeries.

chapters.title: Chapter 856: Imposing Manner
paragraphs: “Preoperative items which are required, such as curing tape, instruments pack, and stepping stools need to be placed in the operating theater beforehand. Ah... prepare a few more stepping stools. Doctor Yu Yuan will participate in the surgery as well. Make sure you check on the number of stepping stools.” Zuo Cidian gave instructions seriously based on the task given to him by Ling Ran.

Xiang Xueming had performed continuous surgeries before. However, when he thought about wanting to equip the Bazhaixiang hospital branch with the facilities required for continuous surgeries, he wanted to claw at his own face. At this time, he could only ask about the important things, “How many stepping stools are needed?”

“Depends on your willingness to bend your body.” Zuo Cidian eyed Xiang Xueming, and he sighed in slight envy. “Look at you. If you work as Doctor Yu’s assistant, how many stepping stools do you think will be suitable for Doctor Yu?”
Xiang Xueming imagined Yu Yuan’s height, and he could not help but take a deep breath. “More is good.”
“Do you think you’re Han Xin or something ?” Zuo Cidian laughed, turned his head around, and said, “Five are enough for sure. If the surgery time is short, two should be enough.”

Xiang Xueming imagined the scenario of Yu Yuan using just one stepping stool. ‘If Doctor Yu Yuan adjusts the operating table to the height she is comfortable with and asks me to become her assistant, I will have to curl up so much that I turn into a prawn.’
Xiang Xueming shook his head hard. “We can still get things like stepping stools at Bazhaixiang hospital branch. No problem. I will keep that in mind for any operating theaters Doctor Yu will be in.”

Zuo Cidian smiled and nodded, then he turned around and said to Su Jiafu, “It’s the same case for anesthetists. Try to reduce the frequency of going in and out during surgery. This is the main point that the Bazhaixiang hospital branch needs to change at this moment. Refilling the anesthetics twice a day should be enough, right?”

“That should be enough.” Su Jiafu’s head was in a mess. He was an anesthetist who had his head wrapped in clouds in Yun Hua Hospital. It was already good enough when he could finish his work accordingly every day without having to work overtime and losing his stools, which meant that he never had to bother about replenishing the supply of anesthetics and other matters.
However, in such a small hospital, there were not many supporting staff and fixed rules, and everybody needed to learn on their own.
Nonetheless, everyone, including Su Jiafu was very happy with it.

A chance to practice like this was extremely precious. Only in a place like Bazhaixiang hospital branch and Ling Ran showing up would allow them to use an entire hospital to practice, no matter how small that hospital was. They could not do it on their own without someone experienced to help them, because while the adjustments on the regulations in a small hospital were simpler than in a big hospital, if there was no experienced doctor, a junior doctor with normal skills would not be able to handle it either.

These doctors might not be happy if they were sent to work in such a small hospital, but if they received such a chance to practice their skills while they were providing support, it was naturally the best thing that could possibly happen to them.
Zuo Cidian continued to give explanations to the nurses and working staff, and the head nurse who also came stood next to him and listened as well.
They always performed surgeries back to back, but all of them needed to fumble about to understand how to manage this in a practical and detailed manner.

Zuo Cidian gave instructions such as telling them to be gentle when draping, changing the gauze and cleaning the basin, among others. When he finished giving his instructions, he took a sip of water and asked, “Do you want to try?”
“Yes, we can try.”
Everyone, including the young nurses, was slightly excited.
The head nurse also went off for work with sparkling eyes.
As of now, the medical staff who could support the Bazhaixiang hospital branch were all doctors and nurses from Yun Hua Hospital. Even the care workers came from Yun Hua Hospital.

There was nothing to do about it. They were the earliest batch to come over, and the frequency in which the helicopters came by was also high. On the day Xiang Xueming asked for help, Yun Hua Hospital also filled up the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. When a few hospitals were able to free up hands to help came later, once they confirmed that land transportation was not available, they were forced to rent helicopters, and by then, they could only go to clinics with worse conditions.
That made Yun Hua Hospital the main force supporting Bazhaixiang.
Once that support was completed, the honor they gained would be enough to make everyone be on cloud nine, and the other hospitals could not even say anything about it.
People like Xiang Xueming in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch did not feel unhappy too.

Upgrading the hospital was still something good at the end of the day. Previously, it was impossible for them to ask Yun Hua Hospital to help, and being in a village hospital was the most demotivating thing for a doctor. Even if people like Xiang Xueming were still willing to spend money and time to hire freelance surgeons to improve their skills, they could not help feeling down after working for two to three years in this sort of place.

While he watched the doctors from Yun Hua Hospital setting up the operating theater, Xiang Xueming did not put a stop to their actions, but he did not help either, and he felt slightly lonely as if he was not a part of this.
“Any problems?” Ling Ran saw Xiang Xueming daydreaming, so he asked him the question when he passed by.

He still cared about a doctor’s mental state when they were in an operating theater. What happened if they were triggered by something and became mentally sick? Not every doctor could evaluate their own mental state.

When Xiang Xueming saw Ling Ran, he was shocked and immediately stood straight. He did not know how to explain what he felt, so he just threw out an answer, “I’m thinking why Doctor Zhang Anmin is not here.”

“Associate Chief Physician Zhang is the associate chief physician in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, so he can only stay in the hospital.” Lu Wenbin wore a happy smile. He held two stepping stools in each hand, and they looked tiny and cute.

“Oh,” Xiang Xueming answered before he patted his head and mocked himself, “my memory’s seriously bad. After Doctor Zhang was promoted to an associate attending physician, I even treated him to a drink.”

“If you increase the price for Old Zhang when he comes over for freelance surgery, he will be truly happy.” Lu Wenbin chuckled while he looked at Xiang Xueming. “You’re considered the person who’s putting bread on his table.”

“I am not a big deal...” Xiang Xueming was full of emotions, but he said in a melancholic fashion, “After Associate Chief Physician Zhang was promoted, he rarely came over. But with how small Bazhaixiang is, we can’t afford to increase his freelance surgery fees either.”
Lu Wenbin clicked his tongue. “Old Zhang still comes often after being promoted to an associate chief physician? He is really poor.”
Xiang Xueming nodded earnestly. “Last time, a patient passed him a Zhonghua cigarette. When he smoked, he did not even spill out the smoke.”

“I’ve seen what you said before.” Lu Wenbin immediately acted out the scene. He exhaled before he breathed in with all his strength. Then, he breathed out again, and breathed in again, just like a big fish trying to test whether something was bait.

Ling Ran looked at his facial expression, and he could not help but sense just how great Lu Wenbin’s vitality was, so he said, “Lu Wenbin, when you finish your work, go downstairs to help. There are quite a lot of patients today.”
Lu Wenbin was stunned for a while before he obediently agreed.
Ling Ran looked at Xiang Xueming and asked, “What do you plan to do?”

“For the time being... Nothing.” Although Xiang Xueming was Ling Ran’s coursemate, his relationship with Ling Ran was still different from Ling Ran’s relationship with Chen Wanhao and Wang Zhuangyong, who were his dormmates. While they were still in university, he only dared to look at Ling Ran from afar. This kind of a department prince was already bound to be treated differently compared to normal students at the moment he entered university.
After becoming an intern at Yun Hua Hospital and working at Bazhaixiang for two years, Xiang Xueming could sense Ling Ran’s imposing mannerism even clearer than before.

Ling Ran would not go and guess what was on Xiang Xueming’s mind. He looked at Xiang Xueming carefully and made sure that he was not about to suffer from a mental breakdown before he said, “Go and choose a few patients who are in a more critical state compared to others. Then send them over for surgery.”
Xiang Xueming was stunned and instantly became motivated. He immediately replied, “Okay.”

Currently, the Bazhaixiang hospital branch did not have any patients with severe injuries. The most critical patients were either handled by Ling Ran on the spot or were sent to Yun Hua Hospital by helicopter. Coupled with the surgeries performed yesterday, even if some of the remaining patients were in a rather severe condition, they were just at the level between requiring emergency surgery and scheduled surgery.

However, this kind of patient was the most suitable surgery subject for every doctor. They did not need to worry about any complicated conversations, and the family members would usually not nag too much. Meanwhile, the doctors would not be so anxious to the point that they would need to work in a flurry.
Suddenly, Ling Ran heard a mission notification by his ear.
[Mission: Perfect Surgery]
[Mission Details: Perfect surgery is the goal every surgeon works hard for.]
[Reward: One Basic Treasure Chest for each perfect surgery.]
Han Xin: a military general who served Liu Bang during the Chu-Han. When Han Xin selects his troops, he does so with the idea that the more, the better. (Source: Wikipedia)

chapters.title: Chapter 857: Everything is Under Control
paragraphs: “Tell the Medical Imaging Department to hurry up and send the report over.”
“Are the results for the four-classic transfusion-transmissible infections out yet? If not, I’ll put on gloves.”
“Sterile pack, sterile scrubs, electric surgical drill...”
When Ling Ran walked into the operating theater that was painted green, everyone in the room was very busy.

After all, this was not the operating theater that they were familiar with, and since Ling Ran requested for continuous surgeries, Zuo Cidian, Yu Yuan, and other doctors faced a much greater work pressure than when they performed hepatectomy in Yun Hua Hospital.
Ling Ran wore a pair of green scrubs and wore a blue cap, and he looked like other doctors. It was just that his back was straight, and people knew him by it.
“Doctor Ling.”
“Teacher Ling.”
“Doctor... Ling...”
The people in the operating theater started to shout.
Ling Ran only nodded and asked, “How’s the condition of the patient? Is he ready?”

“The patient fell from a high place. After he used his left palm to brace for the ground, he suffered Colles’ fracture in the left arm. The left thumb and left ring finger are partially severed...” Xiang Xueming stood out and explained the patient’s medical condition like a young resident doctor.

The few interns felt disgusted when they heard that. They just graduated from university, and they felt strange when they heard this, because this horrible tragedy might have possibly happened to them.
Ling Ran nodded gently and looked at the X-ray scan that was taken.
With his Perfect Level X-ray Scan Analysis, it was very easy for him to observe a bone fracture.
In fact, with Ling Ran’s current level, it was incredibly easy for him to perform finger replantation.

Zuo Cidian also looked at the film for half a minute, but did not understand, and he said, “He has two partially severed fingers with a bone fracture. You might take some time to perform it. Are there any other patients in urgent need of surgery?”
“This is the one who is just sent over. The others are not in need of surgery as much as this one,” Xiang Xueming said carefully, and he added. “If it takes too much time...”
“One and a half hours should not be affecting the subsequent surgeries.” Ling Ran interrupted Xiang Xueming’s guesses.
Xiang Xueming immediately nodded.

Finger replantation can already be considered as a surgical skill that will forever be retained in Ling Ran’s treatment group. Xiang Xueming had been the intern before at Yun Hua Hospital, and he certainly knew about Ling Ran’s main surgical method. He then went and took the microscope.
“There’s only a single binocular head microscope,” Xiang Xueming said softly.

Almost all the microscopes he saw at Yun Hua Hospital were double binocular head microscopes, and those that were not were trinocular head microscopes, but at a small place like Bazhaixiang branch hospital, it was already lucky for them to even have a microscope. They cannot hope to compare to the elite Hand Surgery Department of Yun Hua Hospital.
The microscope should have been previously checked by the young doctor. Ling Ran cast a brief glance at it and said, “It’s better than nothing.”
Once he finished speaking, Ma Yanlin and a nurse beside him immediately went forward and put on a cover on the microscope.

It was not practical to thoroughly clean a precise instrument like the microscope before and after a surgery. In the hospital, the only way was to put on a beautiful plastic cover on the microscopes. The effect was about the same as a condom, which could separate what was inside and outside.
“It was mainly because we don’t really perform surgeries for finger replantation.” Xiang Xueming chuckled and asked, “It’s not as convenient to use as the ones you usually use, right?”
“Nope.” Ling Ran gave a surprisingly accurate reply.
“Do you want to send the microscope you always use over here?” At this moment, another unexpected voice was heard from the back.
Ling Ran turned around and had a look. It was Tian Qi, who was dressed in scrubs and put on some light makeup. From afar, she looked like a female doctor who just joined the medical field.

“Some of the resources are donated by the business world to Bazhaixiang branch hospital. Yunli is the one that helped set it up.” Tian Qi explained in a simple way and repeated. “Now, the helicopters don’t have to do any work anymore. Do you need us to send the instruments you usually use over?”

Ling Ran remembered the Perfect Surgery mission given by the system. He hesitated, but he still said, “It’s too complicated to disassemble the instruments, and that might affect the operation of the hospital.”
Zuo Cidian said at the side, “Some instruments might not be easy to disassemble. After we finish our surgery at Bazhaixiang, we still need to go back for surgery.”
“Then just use the new instruments.” Tian Qi gave a new plan resolutely.
Even if Xiang Xueming wanted new instruments, he dared not received such a gift, he quickly said, “Bazhaixiang branch hospital could not afford that.”
“Hmm... In that case, shall we rent them to you?”
“No hospital can just disassemble their instruments, right?” Zuo Cidian tried to reject Miss Tian’s idea. From his point of view, such a method was not reliable.
But Tian Qi was nodding while listening. She thought for a while and said, “In that case, we can establish a financial leasing company that specializes in providing a lease for medical instruments.”
Zuo Cidian thought. ‘What?’

Tian Qi straightened her thoughts, nodded, and said, “Yunli actually has a batch of medical instruments stored in the store room. Maybe we can let the financial leasing company take them all. Then, Doctor Ling can be the first one to try them first. The instruments are all new too...”

Financial leasing meant that the financial leasing company will purchase instruments based on the requirements from the renting company, then make leasing contracts and rent the instruments to the renting company.
That meant that the financial leasing company will purchase the instruments, and the company using the instrument would pay accordingly. It was quite similar to the installments payment method.

Zuo Cidian still knew about this. He was speechless and said, “What happens in the future? We only need the instruments when we’re at Bazhaixiang. We can’t be like other companies, who rent instruments for a longer period. We don’t allocate our budget in this aspect as well.”

“Maybe this can be a trial service for all of you.” Tian Qi thought for a short time, smiled, and said, “Providing financial leases on medical instruments in the country had also just started. But there are some countries that have more experience in this regard. In the United States, 80% of the huge medical devices in hospitals obtained them through financial leases. So, we can definitely find someone to continue developing this line of business later on.”
Zuo Cidian felt that the whole idea was impossible. “Even if you find an occupational manager, some might not be reliable. Also, what is applicable out there might not be suitable over here...”
Tian Qi blinked and nodded slowly, “What you said is quite true as well. A company can’t just be set up just because I think it will work...”
Zuo Cidian showed a smile on his face, “Exactly...”

“Let’s just buy over a company,” Tian Qi said and smiled sweetly at Ling Ran, “All of you can just continue with your work first. We will be able to send the instruments over earliest by tonight, but we should only be able to send the smaller ones, like C-arms...”
Everyone watched Tian Qi walk away from the operating theater.
Xiang Xueming’s lips trembled, “Is C-arm considered a small item?”
Even Zuo Cidian’s wrinkles were sighing. “Are rich people always so wilful?”
Ma Yanlin said softly, “I heard that the stock price of Yunli has increased by more than four-folded since a year ago...”
The operating theater was finally silent.
Ling Ran was satisfied with such an atmosphere. He surveyed the operating theater once and announced the start of the surgery.
Outside the door, Tian Qi took out her phone and gave a long press on the button numbered 5.
