“Maybe this can be a trial service for all of you.” Tian Qi thought for a short time, smiled, and said, “Providing financial leases on medical instruments in the country had also just started.
But there are some countries that have more experience in this regard.
In the United States, 80% of the huge medical devices in hospitals obtained them through financial leases.
So, we can definitely find someone to continue developing this line of business later on.”
Zuo Cidian felt that the whole idea was impossible.
“Even if you find an occupational manager, some might not be reliable.
Also, what is applicable out there might not be suitable over here...”
Tian Qi blinked and nodded slowly, “What you said is quite true as well.
A company can’t just be set up just because I think it will work...”
Zuo Cidian showed a smile on his face, “Exactly...”
“Let’s just buy over a company,” Tian Qi said and smiled sweetly at Ling Ran, “All of you can just continue with your work first.
We will be able to send the instruments over earliest by tonight, but we should only be able to send the smaller ones, like C-arms...”
Everyone watched Tian Qi walk away from the operating theater.
Xiang Xueming’s lips trembled, “Is C-arm considered a small item?”
Even Zuo Cidian’s wrinkles were sighing.
“Are rich people always so wilful?”
Ma Yanlin said softly, “I heard that the stock price of Yunli has increased by more than four-folded since a year ago...”
The operating theater was finally silent.
Ling Ran was satisfied with such an atmosphere.
He surveyed the operating theater once and announced the start of the surgery.
Outside the door, Tian Qi took out her phone and gave a long press on the button numbered 5.

chapters.title: Chapter 858: Touched
paragraphs: “Completed... We can really have a carefree time when performing surgery with you, Doctor Ling.” Xiang Xueming chuckled and tried to butter up Ling Ran.
He truly felt no worry whatsoever when he performed the surgery.

At Bazhaixiang hospital branch, he can already be considered an expert surgeon. The doctors who remained were either too lazy to work or too old. Sometimes, Zhang Anmin would come and become the assistant for him, and he might even get scolded if he did not handle the surgery with care.

A surgeon can face many problems during surgery. For a doctor like Zhang Anmin, it was unavoidable for him to face some problems that he could not solve. And the only solution he had was to scold his assistants.
Ling Ran was used to the silence in the operating theater.
For other doctors, they might place some music in the operating theater to show how much they were at ease performing surgeries.
But that was for a normal doctor. Ling Ran usually did not care about what others thought. Anyway, he would usually receive lots of praise and nothing else...
For Ling Ran, he just wanted to do his tasks well.
This was not just limited to the operating theater, because he did the same thing outside the operating theater.

For the assistants, it would be lucky for them if the chief surgeon did not scold them, and it would be even better if the chief surgeon was a quiet person. Doctors like Ling Ran, who usually talked very little, and when they did, usually guided the assistants, something junior doctors were not used to, and they just wanted to kneel down to thank them.

Xiang Xueming could not help but think of his life at Yun Hua Hospital and felt a little regretful. He was indeed too young at that time, and he was just a normal intern. Although he learned a lot, if he went to learn under Ling Ran again, he might be able to learn even more.
After he thought for a while, Xiang Xueming thanked Ling Ran for giving him a chance to learn at Yun Hua Hospital.

From the moment he started observing surgeries, he was already watching the best surgery operations. His basic training can be considered to have been completed under Ling Ran. After learning with Ling Ran for half a year, he slowly had the ability to learn on his own and was able to pick up the role of a surgeon at Bazhaixiang hospital branch. Later, he became familiar with the role, otherwise, if he caused problems with one surgery, he might not actually have the courage to perform his second surgery.

The only thing Xiang Xueming regretted was that he could not stay at Yun Hua Hospital. However, this kind of matter was never something a normal student can control. Previously, he was willing to go to Cangping District Hospital in order to stay at Yun Hua Hospital. Who would have known that he would be sent to the rural Bazhaixiang hospital branch by Cangping District Hospital?
“Doctor Ling, why don’t we go and rest for a while? We should let them tidy up the operating theater a little.” Xiang Xueming squashed down all the wild imaginations in his head and said politely.
Ling Ran gently nodded and asked, “What’s the next surgery?”

“Trauma on the left leg. From the X-ray scan, the joints still look good.” Xiang Xueming looked at the small notebook and said, “He also fell from a high place. There are lacerations caused by branches, along with residues in the wound.”
This debridement would be a bit more difficult.
Ling Ran used to do this often two years ago, but once he obtained his skill in hepatectomy, he did fewer debridements.

Afterall, debridement was much simpler compared to hepatectomy. For Ling Ran, this was similar to if he can choose to do analytic geometry. If he can choose analytic geometry, he will not deliberately choose to do euclidean geometry.
However, if questions relating to euclidean geometry were placed in front of him, Ling Ran was still willing to do it.

“I’m not resting. I’m going to shower now. I’ll wash my hands when I come back, then continue with surgeries. If the wound is not serious, I can deal with the wound in the debridement room, and we won’t be using the operating theater.” Ling Ran’s thoughts were clear, and he turned around before he went to the bathroom.
The instruments at Bazhaixiang hospital branch were quite normal. But other common facilities such as the bathroom were very clean and met Ling Ran’s expectations.
After showering and changing to a new pair of underwear and scrubs, Ling Ran entered the debridement room. He felt very relaxed... Or rather, he felt more relaxed.
From Xiang Xueming and the other’s perspectives, Ling Ran looked very relaxed and handsome, and he even gave others a dashing feeling.

“It’s too much of a waste to keep Doctor Ling in the operating theater.” Qi Zao felt so sad until her tears almost fell. She put aside her feelings, lifted the single-lens reflex camera, and kept pressing the shutter.

The patient was a woman in her thirties. She lay down on the operating theater and was stunned when she saw Ling Ran. She could not help but say, “Well, this is amazing, my leg was not in pain anymore when I looked at this doctor.”
“Because I anesthetized you.” Su Jiafu sat on the stool, and his voice was as cold as the wind that blew across the mountain stream.
The patient could not help but to look at Su Jiafu and smiled kindly, “Maybe it’s all due to you.”
“Scrub and wash the skin.” Ling Ran ordered and took the brush to do the task as well.
Xiang Xueming immediately said by the side, “Doctor Ling, just let us do the hard work.”
“No need.” Ling Ran had already received a mission and did not need Xiang Xueming’s clear attempts of trying to be attentive to his needs.
When Xiang Xueming looked at Ling Ran, he was worried that he had done something wrong. He could not help but look at Zuo Cidian.

“If Doctor Ling said that he doesn’t need help, that’s what he meant. You just need to be the assistant.” Zuo Cidian did not want to be the assistant in the first place, so he took the initiative to give Xiang Xueming the position.
As a resident doctor who was over forty years old, Zuo Cidian’s head, neck, back, and waist gave him real pain everyday...
Debridement was not an attractive surgery, so Zuo Cidian naturally would avoid it if he can.
Ling Ran was extremely serious about scrubbing.
He was already very serious in his routine surgery. In fact, he was so serious that his assistants could not understand it. However, he would still give his assistants room to use their skills.
Surgery was always about teamwork, especially when it came to performing surgeries for a long duration of time. Help from the other doctors in the team was definitely required.
However, Ling Ran wanted to perform a perfect surgery today. So, when he worked, his operation was different.
Half of the patient’s leg was scrubbed cleanly by Ling Ran. Not only were the contaminants from the fall removed, even the dead cells on the leg were removed by Ling Ran.
The patient was touched when she saw Ling Ran scrubbing her leg seriously.
Su Jiafu was surprised when he saw that. “How do you feel? Does it hurt?”
“Not at all,” the patient said with a choked voice.
“It still doesn’t hurt even now?” Su Jiafu said angrily, “Just be honest with what you’re feeling. Is your leg in pain? Do you sense anything at all...?”
“No... I just feel that it’s not easy to become a doctor...” The patient pursed her lips and stared at Ling Ran while her eyes were filled with gratitude.
Su Jiafu gritted his teeth and slowly sat back on his stool. He was like an old pine tree on the mountain top; no matter how hard the wind blew at it, it would not move an inch.
“Saline.” Ling Ran took over a bottle from the nurse and poured the solution directly on the wound to wash it.
Then, he trimmed the edges of the skin, and Ling Ran worked even faster when he performed the steps to remove the fascia.
When Xiang Xueming regained his consciousness, Ling Ran had started suturing.

Xiang Xueming could not help but blinked. He had learned debridement and suturing at Yun Hua Hospital, and initially he wanted to do some revision. But now, when he let his mind wander for a while, the surgery was almost completed.
“6-0 surgical thread.”
Before Xiang Xueming snapped back to attention, Ling Ran had sutured the epidermis.
“Doctor Ling, let me do the final steps” Xiang Xueming wanted to share some workload.
Ling Ran lowered his head and looked at the patient’s leg hair, shook his head, and said, “If I suture it, the scar will be smaller.”
This time, the female patient’s gaze fell on Ling Ran, and she used a stern look to stare at Xiang Xueming. “Doctor, can you stop disturbing this handsome doctor when he’s treating me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Could not Do It
paragraphs: “Remove the thread on time, avoid contact with water, don’t touch the ground, take care of it, and the scar will be smaller.” Ling Ran solemnly answered a few questions from a patient with a calm attitude.

With Energy Serums, he had the advantage of time. Others had to be in a hurry at other rescue points, and they might not even be able to save that many patients even if they worked overtime, but Ling Ran... if he worked overtime, he could treat even more patients than what the disaster can produce, so much so that Ling Ran had a lot of time to answer the patients’ questions in detail.
In truth, the production of patients was dependent on time.
In big cities like Yun Hua, there were more patients during the day, while in Bazhaixiang, when a large number of patients appeared, all of it was caused by disasters.
When the progress of Ling Ran’s treatment group managed to help them treat all the patients caused by the disaster, the treatment burden of Bazhaixiang hospital branch was significantly reduced.
The patient was misty-eyed as Ling Ran gave those instructions. “Doctor Ling, you’re so good. Thank you, Doctor Ling...”

The doctors who stood at the front lowered their heads because they were embarrassed by the patient’s attitude and did not want to complain about how selective the patient was in choosing to express his gratitude.
Ling Ran’s attitude was still the same. He had a decent smile that fit social expectations as he sent the patient out. He then went to take a bath and changed his clothes.
Since Ling Ran had the Perfect Surgery mission, he will naturally have some requirements to dress up perfectly if he wanted to perform surgery. At such times, his underwear would also cost 399.
Almost twenty minutes passed when all changes were made, and everything was ready.

Ling Ran stepped out and opened the system page. He saw that there was a very clear figure that stated 2/1 for his Perfect Surgery mission, and his reward was two Basic Treasure Chests, which he received.
Ling Ran only took a glance at it. He did not open it.

Now, he had accumulated four hundred and two Basic Treasure Chests. If he were to include the two from just now, he would have four hundred and four of them. He had opened more than thousands of Basic Treasure Chests since the beginning of his career, and he currently did not have any urgent need for any skills.

Of course, even if he did not have any urgent need for any skills, it did not mean that he had any need at all. Basic Treasure Chests can give him some unimportant skills to fill up his skill bank, and the consumables they gave him were all the energy that can provide him to do continuous work. It would do him no harm no matter how much he accumulated them.
Ling Ran just wanted to wait for a good number.

Relatively speaking, Ling Ran liked the Perfect Surgery mission. On the one hand, when a surgery was done perfectly, it would align with Ling Ran’s mindset. On the other hand, it also aligned with Ling Ran’s mindset as well if he continued accumulating Basic Treasure Chests from it until he obtained a round number.
Anyhow, it was impossible for any Transformer to appear from the current Basic Treasure Chests and Intermediate Treasure Chests.
“Any critically wounded patients?” When Ling Ran came to the on-call room, he asked Xiang Xueming, who was in here first.
“No, but...” Xiang Xueming hesitated for a moment and said, “The township hospital said that it was ready to transfer patients here.”
“Oh,” Ling Ran said and asked, “What kind of patients?”
“Liver laceration. Doctor Gan from the township hospital took the initiative to send him over.” Xiang Xueming emphasized this fact.

Bazhaixiang hospital branch was the hospital branch of the Cangping District in Yun Hua City. The township hospital was the hospital of Bazhaixiang. Both were in Bazhaixiang, but they did not have much contact. After all, they were all small lower-rank hospitals. Even if they formed any sort of connection with each other, it was meaningless. It would be better if they did what Xiang Xueming did and asked freelance surgeons from high-rank hospitals.
Of course, there was no way for doctors in the township hospitals to invite senior doctors like Zhang Anmin at a cheap price.

However, township hospitals these days were different. Although the rank of hospitals and doctors who came from Changxi province to Bazhaixiang to provide aid arrived after those from Hua Hospital, a lot of them still arrived in a continuous stream. Among them, the weaker hospitals and doctors were sent to schools or government buildings to set up shelters, and did something similar to doctors sending medicine to the countrysides.
Those who were able to stay in the township hospital were from rather strong hospitals.

Ling Ran did not understand all the politics behind this. He just understood that a patient was going to come because a hospital was sending him over here while he sat and listened in a corner. He immediately asked, “Which hospital is based in the township hospital now?”
Xiang Xueming said to himself, ‘Doctor Zuo would have understood it.’ He hurriedly said, “It’s from the provincial hospital and Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital.”
After that, Xiang Xueming explained. “The main focus of the township hospital has always been traditional Chinese medicine. Usually, they only do infusion and prescribe Chinese medicine.”

This explained why Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital was stationed there. Zuo Cidian understood it. He could not help but stroked his chin and frowned, “It means that the patient is sent by the provincial hospital? Why would the provincial hospital be willing to send the patient here?”

It was a conventional rule for lower-rank hospitals to send patients they could not handle to high-rank hospitals. If they treated the same patient with the same disease, if the patient was unlucky enough to die in a tertiary Grade A hospital, as long as the hospital did not do anything wrong, it would not be punished. But if the patient died in a secondary Grade B hospital, if the hospital did not transfer the patient before that happened, it would be criticized. If luck was not on its side, it would get punished.

In Yun Hua City or Changxi Province, the provincial government and Yun Hua Hospital competed against each other. Everyone felt that they were the top dogs. Naturally, it was impossible for them to send the patients they cannot treat to the other hospital for treatment.
Zuo Cidian was shocked by this, and he could not help but think about it.
Xiang Xueming spoke tentatively, “It is Doctor Gan’s insistence.”
“He sure is brave.” Zuo Cidian was surprised.
“I think he’s afraid of responsibility.” Xiang Xueming pursed his mouth and explained, “Doctor Gan used to be a barefoot doctor.”
Zuo Cidian, who came from a town hospital himself, instantly understood. “He doesn’t have someone taking care of him and is going to retire soon? He’ll be afraid of trouble, then.”

Xiang Xueming nodded and said, “Now, the patient can only take a helicopter if he’s to be sent to Yun Hua Hospital. The cost can be subsidized, but no one has, but no one has the specific regulations as to how much they are going to subsidize just yet.”
“Maybe it’s the patient’s request. Did Doctor Gan make the decision?”
As Zuo Cidian and Xiang Xueming tried to figure out the situation together, they were probably not far from the truth.
Xiang Xueming whispered, “The patient is here. Should we take him?”

Zuo Cidian knew what Xiang Xueming meant, but he said with a smile, “Yes, why not? If we have everything that we need, we will operate on the patient. Even if we don’t, the patient will be sent back to Yun Hua Hospital anyway.”
“If the patient still refuses?”

“The provincial hospital asked to send the patient to Yun Hua Hospital, but he refused. If Yun Hua Hospital were to decide to transfer him, where will he go? To live is better than to die. If the patient is willing to be transferred, this indicates that he still wants to live,” Zuo Cidian said as he looked at Ling Ran. “Doctor Ling, why don’t you have a quick check later? If you can help him, please do. If you can’t, I think there is no need for the patient to get out of that helicopter. We’ll just send him straight to Yun Hua.”
Ling Ran nodded slowly, and then looked in the direction of the operating theater as he said, “The equipment in the operating theater is still incomplete. We cannot perform many of our surgeries.”

“If we can’t do it, they would not be able to do it too. Don’t worry, no matter who decides to send the patient to us, they must know the condition of our operating theater. If we can’t do the surgery at all, they would have sent the patient directly to Yun Hua. They’ll just be causing trouble to themselves if they decided to send the patient here halfway through their journey to Yun Hua Hospital.” Zuo Cidian laughed again and said, “But the surgeries that we do are surgeries that can’t be done by the provincial hospital.”

“The main focus of the township hospital has always been traditional Chinese medicine.
Usually, they only do infusion and prescribe Chinese medicine.”
This explained why Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital was stationed there.
Zuo Cidian understood it.
He could not help but stroked his chin and frowned, “It means that the patient is sent by the provincial hospital?
Why would the provincial hospital be willing to send the patient here?”
It was a conventional rule for lower-rank hospitals to send patients they could not handle to high-rank hospitals.

If they treated the same patient with the same disease, if the patient was unlucky enough to die in a tertiary Grade A hospital, as long as the hospital did not do anything wrong, it would not be punished.
But if the patient died in a secondary Grade B hospital, if the hospital did not transfer the patient before that happened, it would be criticized.
If luck was not on its side, it would get punished.
In Yun Hua City or Changxi Province, the provincial government and Yun Hua Hospital competed against each other.
Everyone felt that they were the top dogs.
Naturally, it was impossible for them to send the patients they cannot treat to the other hospital for treatment.
Zuo Cidian was shocked by this, and he could not help but think about it.
Xiang Xueming spoke tentatively, “It is Doctor Gan’s insistence.”
“He sure is brave.” Zuo Cidian was surprised.
“I think he’s afraid of responsibility.” Xiang Xueming pursed his mouth and explained, “Doctor Gan used to be a barefoot doctor.”
Zuo Cidian, who came from a town hospital himself, instantly understood.
“He doesn’t have someone taking care of him and is going to retire soon?
He’ll be afraid of trouble, then.”
Xiang Xueming nodded and said, “Now, the patient can only take a helicopter if he’s to be sent to Yun Hua Hospital.
The cost can be subsidized, but no one has, but no one has the specific regulations as to how much they are going to subsidize just yet.”
“Maybe it’s the patient’s request.
Did Doctor Gan make the decision?”
As Zuo Cidian and Xiang Xueming tried to figure out the situation together, they were probably not far from the truth.
Xiang Xueming whispered, “The patient is here.
Should we take him?”
Zuo Cidian knew what Xiang Xueming meant, but he said with a smile, “Yes, why not?
If we have everything that we need, we will operate on the patient.
Even if we don’t, the patient will be sent back to Yun Hua Hospital anyway.”
“If the patient still refuses?”
“The provincial hospital asked to send the patient to Yun Hua Hospital, but he refused.
If Yun Hua Hospital were to decide to transfer him, where will he go?
To live is better than to die.
If the patient is willing to be transferred, this indicates that he still wants to live,” Zuo Cidian said as he looked at Ling Ran.
“Doctor Ling, why don’t you have a quick check later?
If you can help him, please do.
If you can’t, I think there is no need for the patient to get out of that helicopter.
We’ll just send him straight to Yun Hua.”
Ling Ran nodded slowly, and then looked in the direction of the operating theater as he said, “The equipment in the operating theater is still incomplete.
We cannot perform many of our surgeries.”
“If we can’t do it, they would not be able to do it too.
Don’t worry, no matter who decides to send the patient to us, they must know the condition of our operating theater.
If we can’t do the surgery at all, they would have sent the patient directly to Yun Hua.

They’ll just be causing trouble to themselves if they decided to send the patient here halfway through their journey to Yun Hua Hospital.” Zuo Cidian laughed again and said, “But the surgeries that we do are surgeries that can’t be done by the provincial hospital.”

chapters.title: Chapter 860: We’re Just Rich
paragraphs: A helicopter carrying the symbol of Jin Hui Airlines landed on the rooftop of a Bazhaixiang branch hospital. Three doctors got off the helicopter along with a patient on a stretcher.

Lu Wenbin did not wait for the helicopter to leave. He braved the wind and charged below the raging rotors to help carry the stretcher. This drew a few somewhat impressed looks from the three Yun Hua Provincial Hospital doctors.
The keyword being, somewhat.
It was kind of hard for the doctors, who were also top doctors in the area, to accept the fact that they had to personally escort the patient over.
“I’m sorry to trouble you,” the attending physician who came over in the helicopter greeted Lu Wenbin.
“What are you saying?” Lu Wenbin shouted. He could not hear what the attending physician said over the turbulent blades.
The attending physician, who was standing opposite him, shook his head. He pointed at his mouth and said, “I’ll shout from one to three, and we’ll carry the gurney together.”
As he spoke, he got into position. However, Lu Wenbin extended his hands, grabbed both sides of the stretcher, and carried it onto the gurney alone.
His arms were extremely burly, and his bulging muscles were so hard that the sight of them made the three doctors dizzy.
“Let’s get going!” Lu Wenbin growled and pushed the gurney as he walked forward.

Back in Yun Hua Hospital, Lu Wenbin had always been very generous in contributing his physical strength. He even sought out physical tasks on purpose. Not only was he spending a lot of time working under Ling Ran, but he also had to take care of his stew for pork trotters business. Hence, he had to find other ways to train his muscles as he no longer got to spend long hours in the gym.

The three doctors from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital had never seen anything like this, and they followed closely behind Lu Wenbin. Even though they felt like they were being treated with importance, they felt extremely inferior to Lu Wenbin in terms of physical strength.
The sound of the helicopter blades slowly faded. The experienced attending physician who had fallen behind smiled and said, “Treatment groups run by young people are different indeed.”

In a tertiary Grade A hospital like Yun Hua Provincial Hospital, an attending physician in their forties only if they had either offended a powerful person or because they were so bad with words that they offended people all the time.
As this was the territory of Yun Hua Hospital, the two doctors who came along with him did not feel like saying much. They merely chuckled.

“Alright, let’s see if they can handle this patient. If they can’t do it, we’ll still have to send the patient back to Yun Hua Provincial Hospital,” Cai Qiong the attending physician muttered. His task was to send the patient to Yun Hua Provincial Hospital instead of Yun Hua Hospital when needed.
But to the two younger doctors, the attending physician would just be looking for trouble if he were to do this.

If the patient was sent to Yun Hua Hospital instead, their department director would be embarrassed. But it was not like the department director could actually do anything to the attending physician, who was almost fifty years old already.
Obstinate people would only be proven as obstinate when they had a lifetime of being scolded but still retained their views. That was because they felt nothing even when they were scolded.
The three doctors walked behind Lu Wenbin into Bazhaixiang hospital branch, a subsidiary of Cangping District Hospital, in a leisurely manner.
Now that the patient was already here, there was nothing much left for them to do. Hence, they no longer felt anxious.
Cai Qiong even put on an act and walked with his hands clasped behind his back, emulating what his department director often did.

The building of Bazhaixiang hospital branch was pretty tiny. After they walked through the entrance, they reached a small reception hall that served multiple purposes. The payment counter was located there, and patients waited there for their turn. It was also where consultation and emergency treatment were carried out. Aside from this, patients also collected their examination reports in the reception hall.

Cai Qiong pursed his lips in disdain and laughed out loud. “Back when I first started working as a doctor in the nineties, a few of the departments were located in buildings like this. However, they were cleaner.”
The two resident doctors who came along with him flashed a slight smile.
“You don’t believe what I said?” Cai Qiong asked with a smile.
“I was only born in 1993,” the resident doctor who was walking behind him said in a whisper.
Cai Qiong’s face could not help but twitch a few times. When he raised his head, his field of vision became blurry because of the jarring lights.

Numerous energy saving lamps the size of a human skull were hanging from the ceiling. Even though the reception hall did not have much natural light, the place was as bright as an operating theater because of the energy saving lamps.
Not many patients and family members were there for consultation.
The other resident doctor looked around. He was trying to lighten up the atmosphere as well as satisfy his curiosity. “Where’re the patients?”

“Some of them are in the wards, and some have been discharged.” Zuo Cidian was observing the three of them first. He only stepped forward and introduced himself after hearing their conversation. “I’m Zuo Cidian from Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center. Let me find you guys a place to rest.”

“There’s no need for that. We would like to take a look at the operating theater. Isn’t Doctor Ling the best liver surgeon in Changxi Province? We would like to learn from him.” Somehow, even when Cai Qiong was saying something nice, it still sounded like a mockery.
Zuo Cidian smiled. “No problem, go ahead. Let’s get changed first, then.”
This was a rule in every hospital, and the three doctors from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital nodded.
“Let’s go this way.” Zuo Cidian opened a side door and took the lead. “Didn’t the patient’s family members come along?”

“They’re coming here by car and will probably arrive in another hour or two.” The roads in Bazhaixiang were also badly affected by the natural disaster, and Bazhaixiang hospital branch was located in a building that used to be owned by the people’s commune during the communist era. If not for the fact that the journey to the hospital would be too bumpy, they would not have needed to summon a helicopter. It was quite costly to use Jin Hui Airlines’ services.
“Can you tell us about the patient’s condition?” Zuo Cidian was still acting amicably.
“Are we talking about it here?” Cai Qiong, the senior attending physician, looked around in disdain. “Isn’t Doctor Ling participating in the consultation as well?”
Zuo Cidian smiled. “It’s better if we get started early with the preparations in case any problem were to arise. Right now, Doctor Ling is probably washing his hands already.”

“Hm... It’s exactly as I told you over the phone. There’s an abdominal puncture, with a tree branch piercing into the patient’s abdominal cavity. The bleeding is quite bad, and after initial diagnosis, it’s concluded that the liver is injured... Oh, by the way, is there enough blood in the blood bank? I reckon that the patient will lose even more blood when his abdominal cavity is opened.”

Heavy bleeding was also one of the reasons why the team from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital made a swift decision to transport the patient to Bazhaixiang hospital branch. The blood supply to the liver was very rich, and any kind of injury to it will cause the patient to lose plenty of blood.

With the situation right now, even if the village hospital under Yun Hua Provincial Hospital had enough blood supply, they did not dare to use a large amount of it. The cooling system was not working because of the natural disaster, and they were not sure about when new blood supply would be sent to them. Aside from this, they were not confident in saving a patient even if they were to transfuse a large amount of blood.

Like teams sent from other hospitals, most of the members in the rescue team Yun Hua Provincial Hospital sent over to Bazhaixiang consisted of emergency physicians and general surgeons. Even though the latter knew how to conduct liver surgeries, they found them no less dangerous.

Whenever general surgeons who were not specialized in liver surgeries carried out liver surgeries, it was just like high school students trying to solve functional equations. They might be able to do some basic ones where the diagrams were precise such as logarithmic functions, trigonometric functions and constant functions. However, if the equations were to evolve any further, they would not be able to handle it. It was just like how general surgeons would not be able to handle it if the liver injury was not a standard one.

The treatment plan the team from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital had for this kind of patient was to send them back to Yun Hua Provincial Hospital so that specialized departments could treat them. But since this plan would not work out right now, they had no choice but to entrust the patient to Ling Ran.

Doctors often meet patients who gave up on the best choice or even second best choice because of financial constraints, but it was never part of a doctor’s job scope to solve patients’ financial problems.

Zuo Cidian could kind of guess what was on the minds of the doctors from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital. He merely smiled and said, “We have prepared enough blood bags. A batch was just sent over just now.”
“Via helicopter? You guys have such a good relationship with Jin Hui Airlines?” Cai Qiong asked another awkward question.
Zuo Cidian shook his head. “We chartered a helicopter.”
“Wow, that’s intense.” Cai Qiong’s laughter was a profound one.
Zuo Cidian got a little annoyed when he heard this. He turned to look at Cai Qiong and said flatly, “We’re just rich.”

chapters.title: Chapter 861: You Managed to Tell, Right
paragraphs: Cai Qiong entered the operating theater of Bazhaixiang hospital branch with disdain.
This disdain was dedicated to Bazhaixiang hospital branch and also to Ling Ran’s treatment group.

Naturally, he had heard of Ling Ran’s reputation before. In Changxi Province, Ling Ran was known as a celebrity doctor who shocked everyone whenever he decided to do something. And it was precisely because of this that Cai Qiong despised them even more.
From Cai Qiong’s perspective, being a celebrity doctor and being young were both disadvantages.

After all, as a senior attending physician who was older than Zuo Cidian, Cai Qiong had an advantage in terms of experience. When he faced a young doctor, even if said doctor was the leader of a treatment group, Cai Qiong could still proudly say, “When I first became a doctor...”
Zuo Cidian could sense some of Cai Qiong’s thoughts, but he only treated whatever Cai Qiong thought with disdain in his heart.
“Doctor Cai, this way, please.” Zuo Cidian showed the way, leaving little room to have small talk.
They quietly walked forward. Their slippers tapped against the terrazzo floor.
“Defreeze a few more blood bags, don’t let Doctor Ling touch them with his hands. What if he catches a cold?” The whispered discussion between young nurses was heard from the supply room next door.
The doctors pretended that they did not hear it.

“Doctors from the provincial hospital are so bad. When they can’t treat a patient, they pass the patient to Doctor Ling. Doctor Ling already worked hard over the past few days, and he practically did not sleep. Now, he finally has the chance to relax, and they send another critically ill patient over...”
“That’s right. If they aren’t good, then don’t send the patient over. In the end, they still need to trouble Doctor Ling.”
“Oh yea, how did you know that Doctor Ling did not sleep?”
“Well, I just know.”
The three doctors from the provincial hospital who followed Zuo Cidian became more quiet. The youngest doctor pursed his lips a little. He wanted to refute, but in the end, he said nothing.
What was he supposed to explain, and what use was there for him to explain anything.

“Doctor Ling prefers silence in the operating theater. So, don’t talk if you don’t have anything to say.” When they stood before the operating theater, Zuo Cidian made another statement before he stepped open the airtight access door of the operating theater and brought those three inside.
There was no need for Zuo Cidian to even make any introductions, Cai Qiong could see Ling Ran performing surgery inside immediately when he went in.
Ling Ran stood straight, and he only lowered his head a little. He looked very busy.

Cai Qiong did not see Ling Ran’s face from the front, so he could only look at his back from behind him. As he watched Ling Ran’s light movements and obvious handsomeness from behind him, suddenly, Cai Qiong was unable to show his scorn.
Cai Qiong was even so shocked when he saw the layout in the operating theater that he almost gasped in amazement.
The common C-arm in provincial hospitals, the common display screen, the common ultrasonic knife...
These instruments were commonly seen in provincial hospitals, but they were extremely precious in Baizhaixiang.

In truth, if they had suitable equipment, the doctors from the provincial hospital could perform the surgery themselves. In the worst case, they can just request for the provincial hospital to send a hepatobiliary expert over. After all, it was not something impossible for them to do.

“Why do you have these?” Cai Qiong did not believe these belonged to Bazhaixiang hospital branch. Forget about the fact that Bazhaixiang hospital branch cannot afford the equipment in this operating theater, all the equipment was also very new.
“We brought them.” Zuo Cidian’s answer was extremely simple.
Cai Qiong shook his head. “Did you bring so many instruments along? You’re crazy.”
“You think too much.” Zuo Cidian lowered his voice and said, “You still remember what I’ve said before, right?”
Cai Qiong immediately remembered what Zuo Cidian mentioned about being rich, but he did not believe him and said, “You can’t spend in this way even if you’re rich.”
Zuo Cidian smiled. “You misunderstood. What I mean is you can’t afford these even if the provincial hospital is rich. So, this is not what we call crazy.”
Cai Qiong eagerly wanted his eyes to be lasers so that he can burn Zuo Cidian’s wrinkles with his gaze alone.
“How’s the blood pressure?” Ling Ran’s voice was heard, and it made the operating theater become silent immediately.
Ling Ran’s focus was on the patient’s abdominal cavity, so he did not raise his head.
“80, 40.” Su Jiafu frowned a little. His control of the patient’s blood pressure was not very ideal.Visit web novel. live If You like manga , comics
Ling Ran only frowned a little and said, “Take note to replenish fluid.”
Then, he inserted a hand into the patient’s abdominal cavity.
“Barehanded bleeding control.” Zuo Cidian suddenly felt proud.
He had seen Ling Ran using barehanded bleeding control many times, but whenever he saw it, he still shuddered, for some reason.

This was a skill with a combination of talent and skill. For a normal doctor, it was a special skill that they can only hear about but never be able to see, it was also a skill that they thought was something that they can use to boast at any moment.
Cia Qiong was surprised again.

The surgeons were actually conservative people. Abdominoscopy had been developed for many years, but there were still a number of surgeons who insisted on open abdominal surgery, and the major reason for them to do so was to see the situation inside the abdominal cavity with their eyes.
Cai Qiong was, indeed, a senior attending physician who cannot be promoted because of how talkative he was, but he was also a surgeon.
While he stared at Ling Ran’s movements, Cai Qiong walked a few steps forward stiffly because he wanted to have a clearer look.
And he was indeed able to see clearer.

In the abdominal cavity of the patient was a large amount of blood in the abdominal cavity, and it was being sucked out. The color of the injured liver had changed slightly. A liver that lost its pinkish color was like a Barbie doll that lost its hair and did not look cute at all.
The others were all contaminated blood and liver tissues.
Cai Qiong observed while thinking in his mind. ‘What if I encountered a case like this?’
Then, Cai Qiong tried to compare what he would do with Ling Ran’s actual operation.

The actual operation was always more complicated and difficult than what a person can imagine, even if the surgeon faced the same surgery. Since Cai Qiong was only imagining it, the difficulty of the surgery became lower, but his imagination ran even wilder.
This made Cai Qiong feel more arrogant.
He turned to glance at Zuo Cidian before he said in a low voice, “Doctor Ling performs the surgery quite well.”
Zuo Cidian cast Cai Qiong a sidelong glance, “Are you saying that the provincial hospital is unable to handle this surgery?”
“We don’t have a complete set of facilities.” Cai Qiong defended himself before he turned around and watched Ling Ran perform the surgery.
One second, five seconds.
Cai Qiong suddenly realized that Ling Ran had intercepted the hepatic portal vein, and the operation was completely different from what he imagined.
Cai Qiong could not help but become focused.
Surgical methods can be seen as a formula to treat a problem.
Different people used different formulae to solve problems because they had different mindsets, and it was the same with surgical methods.
Cai Qiong was no longer a doctor who pursued skills, but he was still curious toward Ling Ran’s operation method.
Ling Ran can be seen with a hand in the patient’s body while he stood by the operating table. His other hand operated independently, and he quickly completed ligating the blood vessels.

After Ling Ran pulled out his hand, Cai Qiong realized in a daze that Ling Ran controlled and interrupted the blood flow in the hepatic portal vein at a distance, allowing him to control the bleeding.
How familiar was he with the anatomy of the liver?
This thought popped up in Cai Qiong’s mind, and he looked at Ling Ran’s operation before he thought. ‘How did he learn this kind of skill?’
When he was thinking about it, he heard Ling Ran say, “Lu Wenbin, I’ll pass this to you.”
Then, he saw Ling Ran pass the major portion of suturing the patient to Lu Wenbin, the assistant opposite him.
Lu Wenbin lowered his head and started to suture, and his movements showed familiarity.
Cai Qiong could not help but raise his head and stared at Lu Wenbin.

When Lu Wenbin was performing the suture, he suddenly raised his head and showed a happy smile to Cai Qiong. He exercised his neck and shoulder before he tightened his muscles. “You managed to tell, right? I recently trained my splenius capitis muscle.”

“Defreeze a few more blood bags, don’t let Doctor Ling touch them with his hands.
What if he catches a cold?” The whispered discussion between young nurses was heard from the supply room next door.
The doctors pretended that they did not hear it.
“Doctors from the provincial hospital are so bad.
When they can’t treat a patient, they pass the patient to Doctor Ling.
Doctor Ling already worked hard over the past few days, and he practically did not sleep.
Now, he finally has the chance to relax, and they send another critically ill patient over...”
“That’s right.
If they aren’t good, then don’t send the patient over.
In the end, they still need to trouble Doctor Ling.”
“Oh yea, how did you know that Doctor Ling did not sleep?”
“Well, I just know.”
The three doctors from the provincial hospital who followed Zuo Cidian became more quiet.
The youngest doctor pursed his lips a little.
He wanted to refute, but in the end, he said nothing.
What was he supposed to explain, and what use was there for him to explain anything.
“Doctor Ling prefers silence in the operating theater.

So, don’t talk if you don’t have anything to say.” When they stood before the operating theater, Zuo Cidian made another statement before he stepped open the airtight access door of the operating theater and brought those three inside.
There was no need for Zuo Cidian to even make any introductions, Cai Qiong could see Ling Ran performing surgery inside immediately when he went in.
Ling Ran stood straight, and he only lowered his head a little.
He looked very busy.
Cai Qiong did not see Ling Ran’s face from the front, so he could only look at his back from behind him.
As he watched Ling Ran’s light movements and obvious handsomeness from behind him, suddenly, Cai Qiong was unable to show his scorn.
Cai Qiong was even so shocked when he saw the layout in the operating theater that he almost gasped in amazement.
The common C-arm in provincial hospitals, the common display screen, the common ultrasonic knife...
These instruments were commonly seen in provincial hospitals, but they were extremely precious in Baizhaixiang.
In truth, if they had suitable equipment, the doctors from the provincial hospital could perform the surgery themselves.
In the worst case, they can just request for the provincial hospital to send a hepatobiliary expert over.
After all, it was not something impossible for them to do.
“Why do you have these?” Cai Qiong did not believe these belonged to Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
Forget about the fact that Bazhaixiang hospital branch cannot afford the equipment in this operating theater, all the equipment was also very new.
“We brought them.” Zuo Cidian’s answer was extremely simple.
Cai Qiong shook his head.
“Did you bring so many instruments along?
You’re crazy.”
“You think too much.” Zuo Cidian lowered his voice and said, “You still remember what I’ve said before, right?”
Cai Qiong immediately remembered what Zuo Cidian mentioned about being rich, but he did not believe him and said, “You can’t spend in this way even if you’re rich.”
Zuo Cidian smiled.
“You misunderstood.
What I mean is you can’t afford these even if the provincial hospital is rich.
So, this is not what we call crazy.”
Cai Qiong eagerly wanted his eyes to be lasers so that he can burn Zuo Cidian’s wrinkles with his gaze alone.
“How’s the blood pressure?” Ling Ran’s voice was heard, and it made the operating theater become silent immediately.
Ling Ran’s focus was on the patient’s abdominal cavity, so he did not raise his head.
“80, 40.” Su Jiafu frowned a little.
His control of the patient’s blood pressure was not very ideal.Visit web novel. live If You like manga , comics
Ling Ran only frowned a little and said, “Take note to replenish fluid.”
Then, he inserted a hand into the patient’s abdominal cavity.
“Barehanded bleeding control.” Zuo Cidian suddenly felt proud.
He had seen Ling Ran using barehanded bleeding control many times, but whenever he saw it, he still shuddered, for some reason.
This was a skill with a combination of talent and skill.
For a normal doctor, it was a special skill that they can only hear about but never be able to see, it was also a skill that they thought was something that they can use to boast at any moment.
Cia Qiong was surprised again.
The surgeons were actually conservative people.

Abdominoscopy had been developed for many years, but there were still a number of surgeons who insisted on open abdominal surgery, and the major reason for them to do so was to see the situation inside the abdominal cavity with their eyes.
Cai Qiong was, indeed, a senior attending physician who cannot be promoted because of how talkative he was, but he was also a surgeon.
While he stared at Ling Ran’s movements, Cai Qiong walked a few steps forward stiffly because he wanted to have a clearer look.
And he was indeed able to see clearer.
In the abdominal cavity of the patient was a large amount of blood in the abdominal cavity, and it was being sucked out.
The color of the injured liver had changed slightly.
A liver that lost its pinkish color was like a Barbie doll that lost its hair and did not look cute at all.
The others were all contaminated blood and liver tissues.
Cai Qiong observed while thinking in his mind.
‘What if I encountered a case like this?’
Then, Cai Qiong tried to compare what he would do with Ling Ran’s actual operation.
The actual operation was always more complicated and difficult than what a person can imagine, even if the surgeon faced the same surgery.
Since Cai Qiong was only imagining it, the difficulty of the surgery became lower, but his imagination ran even wilder.
This made Cai Qiong feel more arrogant.
He turned to glance at Zuo Cidian before he said in a low voice, “Doctor Ling performs the surgery quite well.”
Zuo Cidian cast Cai Qiong a sidelong glance, “Are you saying that the provincial hospital is unable to handle this surgery?”
“We don’t have a complete set of facilities.” Cai Qiong defended himself before he turned around and watched Ling Ran perform the surgery.
One second, five seconds.
Cai Qiong suddenly realized that Ling Ran had intercepted the hepatic portal vein, and the operation was completely different from what he imagined.
Cai Qiong could not help but become focused.
Surgical methods can be seen as a formula to treat a problem.
Different people used different formulae to solve problems because they had different mindsets, and it was the same with surgical methods.
Cai Qiong was no longer a doctor who pursued skills, but he was still curious toward Ling Ran’s operation method.
Ling Ran can be seen with a hand in the patient’s body while he stood by the operating table.
His other hand operated independently, and he quickly completed ligating the blood vessels.

After Ling Ran pulled out his hand, Cai Qiong realized in a daze that Ling Ran controlled and interrupted the blood flow in the hepatic portal vein at a distance, allowing him to control the bleeding.
How familiar was he with the anatomy of the liver?
This thought popped up in Cai Qiong’s mind, and he looked at Ling Ran’s operation before he thought.
‘How did he learn this kind of skill?’
When he was thinking about it, he heard Ling Ran say, “Lu Wenbin, I’ll pass this to you.”
Then, he saw Ling Ran pass the major portion of suturing the patient to Lu Wenbin, the assistant opposite him.
Lu Wenbin lowered his head and started to suture, and his movements showed familiarity.
Cai Qiong could not help but raise his head and stared at Lu Wenbin.
When Lu Wenbin was performing the suture, he suddenly raised his head and showed a happy smile to Cai Qiong.
He exercised his neck and shoulder before he tightened his muscles.
“You managed to tell, right?
I recently trained my splenius capitis muscle.”

chapters.title: Chapter 862: Choosing a Bed
paragraphs: “Fluid replacement, 71 ounces.” Su Jiafu watched the last bit of liquid enter the patient and gave the vocal confirmation.
“Okay,” Ling Ran acknowledged. After making the final examination, he said, “Let’s close it up.”
Lu Wenbin and Xiang Xueming, who were standing across him, immediately went to work. One helped Ling Ran thread the needle, the other removed the bandage around the wound from the clip...
Cai Qiong craned his neck and watched them. He was eager to learn Ling Ran’s technique immediately.
Just like how willing Zhang Anmin was to be a mole in order to learn hepatectomy, Cai Qiong was just as eager to learn hepatectomy techniques.

Unfortunately, even if Cai Qiong wanted to be a mole, there was no place for him to sell himself. The provincial General Surgery Department did not give Cai Qiong the opportunity to learn about hepatectomy.

Cai Qiong looked at the abdominal closure, and he remembered experiencing this scene when he was at the operating table. If it were not for his talkative mouth that offended everyone, he may have already begun to perform hepatectomy now, he might even be able to perform surgeries that could earn him more money instead of needing to perform his all-too-familiar colorectal surgery, digging feces out all day long till the sky was dark.
“Bring me the 6-0 surgical suture,” Ling Ran spoke again, but it was to correct the scrub nurse beside him, Wang Jia.
Wang Jia immediately took a 6-0 surgical suture to Ling Ran with a pair of forceps, and she asked, “Are you thinking of minimizing the formation of scar tissue?”
“Yes,” Ling Ran answered, took the needle holder, cast it a slight glance, and then pierced the curved needle into the patient’s skin.
Wang Jia stood on her toes, took a glance, pouted, and said, “But this person’s leg hair is long and messy, it doesn’t matter if there is a scar.”
Ling Ran smiled and did not answer. Since he wanted to perform a perfect operation, he could not just leave a scar just because the person was hairy.
Young nurse Wang Jia stared at Ling Ran and said excitedly, “Doctor Ling, you smiled just now, right?”
Cai Qiong could not help it anymore. “How would you know if he is when he’s wearing a mask?”
Wang Jia glanced at him with a look of disdain. “When Doctor Ling smiles, his temple will move a little.”
“Temple...” Cai Qiong dragged himself out of self-pity and continued to mutter, “Take a look. Does my temple curve when I smile?”

“Your hair is too thin, you have a lot of wrinkles on your temples, and your neck’s fat. I can’t see clearly.” Wang Jia also pretended to answer it earnestly. Since he was a provincial doctor, it was okay to rebuke him until he vomited blood.
Cai Qiong froze and subconsciously touched his face with his hands.

Ling Ran lowered his head and did not participate in their idle chatter. Instead, he stared at the patient’s abdomen and finished the final sutures. In order to reduce scarring, Ling Ran even used the technique of intradermal suture and heavy reinforcing suture.
One stitch after another.

Suturing was a doctor’s basic skill, and there were not many shortcuts to take to master it, especially sutures involving the skin. Even if the doctor was confident, he still had to suture the skin stitch by stitch.

Seeing this, Cai Qiong found it a little funny. He could see that Ling Ran’s basics were very strong, but he was already able to tell through the hepatectomy just now, he did not rely on the closing of the incision for him to be able to do so.
However, Ling Ran completed the entire process before withdrawing from the operating table.

“This is all thanks to the number of surgeries you did, otherwise, there would be no room for such a young doctor to do something like this.” Cai Qiong stepped out of the operating theater and winked at Zuo Cidian.

Patients may be more concerned about the abdominal closure, but in the whole operation, it can be said that it was the part that doctors did not care about most. When it came to places like the provincial hospital, it was more like a platform for young doctors to practice.

Zuo Cidian laughed without saying a word. A no good doctor from the provincial hospital had no right to interfere with how Yun Hua Hospital trained young doctors and how the Ling Treatment Group allocated work.
The operating theater became quieter. Only the faint sound of Ling Ran’s suturing was heard when the needle penetrated into the muscle.
Xiang Xueming looked at Ling Ran nervously all the way. Then, when he announced the completion of the surgery, he let out a sigh of relief.

When higher ups fought, the ones working under them were the ones who would be in trouble. This place was Bazhaixiang’s hospital branch in Cangping District. For every doctor here, Yun Hua Hospital and the provincial hospital were giants, they would die with a single prod.

“It’s good that you’re done with it and the person is saved.” Xiang Xueming waited for the operation to finish, and then with vigorous strides, stepped up to help Ling Ran take off his surgical gown and the other items.
“We don’t need your help anymore.” The circulating nurse who was originally helping Wang Jia count the gauze immediately stood up at this time.
Xiang Xueming laughed stupidly and thought. ‘I don’t want to help, anyway. How can this kind of help be helpful?’
“Is there a special care unit?” Ling Ran did not even ask for an ICU, knowing that the Bazhaixiang hospital branch would not be able to provide one.
Xiang Xueming scratched his head, looked around, and whispered, “We haven’t prepared a special care unit. Um... Does this patient have to go into a special care unit?”

“After hepatectomy, the correct procedure is for the patient to enter the ICU.” Ling Ran looked at Xiang Xueming, who had a troubled look. He sighed and said, “If there is no special care unit, please just arrange one out now.”
“OK ... Sure!” Xiang Xueming agreed.
Ling Ran also followed him and went out.
The special care unit was a weakened version of the ICU, and a newly organized special care unit was an extra weakened version. Such wards must be carefully cleaned before they can be used.
Xiang Xueming led the way and went directly to the second floor of the hospital.
A row of green painted doors were opened all along the corridor, and this sight can be seen from the stairs on the first floor. There were about ten rooms.
“Which room is easier to clean?” Ling Ran looked at the long ward and consulted Xiang Xueming again.
Xiang Xueming scratched his head and laughed foolishly, “The room is almost done...”
Ling Ran nodded and walked toward a room close to him.
“This won’t do.” Xiang Xueming hurriedly stopped him.
Ling Ran frowned and looked at Xiang Xueming.
“This... this room... the patients in this room are recovering slowly.” Xiang Xueming knew that Ling Ran was an insistent person, and he could only obediently explain the situation.
“All patients who entered this room recovered slowly?” Ling Ran asked.
Xiang Xueming quickly shook his head, “No, but most of the patients who are sent here recover slowly. Some of them just don’t heal from their incisions, and we can’t figure out why.”
Ling Ran turned his head and looked at the seemingly normal room, but he was not troubled.
There may be many explanations for the patients’ slow recovery in this ward, but he was not here to solve this.
Moreover, such superstitions were not exclusive to Bazhaixiang, but existed in almost all the Surgery Departments in every hospital.
“Then let’s change to another room.” Ling Ran made a new decision without hesitation.
Xiang Xueming was afraid of making another mistake and quickly designated a room.
After that, it was time to empty the ward and resterilize it.
Xiang Xueming’s organizational ability in this regard was acceptable, and he quickly completed the task.
At about the same time, the patient woke up and was sent directly to the single special care unit...

“You can go back. By the way, remember to report the situation.” Zuo Cidian watched the patient settle down, and when he faced Cai Qiong again, the wrinkles on his face seem to have been oiled, because they glistened under the sun.

chapters.title: Chapter 863: Sent Away
paragraphs: In the afternoon, the humidity in the air was a little lower. The sun was golden and bright as if someone graceful was dancing about, even though that person could not be clearly seen.

Two dirty off-road vehicles made noises so loud they did not care about who they bothered. They drove slowly from the other end of the street, swaying from side to side as if they were office workers who were really exhausted after a day’s work.

When the SUV stopped at a board that stated “The Bazhaixiang hospital branch, Cangping District Hospital, Yun Hua City”, a row of six people got off the vehicle one after another. They were also swaying from side to side. Everyone looked pale as if they could immediately be sent to an emergency treatment room.

“The patient is fine. Don’t worry. Let’s go ahead and have a look.” One of the people who came down from the first car was an associate chief physician from the provincial hospital. He was dressed in a white coat, and it was a little dirty.

The road from the township hospital to Bazhaixiang was not far, but the journey was incredibly challenging. The people in the vehicles had to get down to help the vehicles get through the mud on the roads more than once.
The clothes of the patient’s family members were stained with mud. Their expressions and gazes were very anxious.

“The surgery went well. Let me lead you up,” Zuo Cidian, who was in charge of reception, also did not speak much. He took the crowd to the special care unit, which was reconstructed on the first floor.
Compared with the other rooms, where six patients in one room, only three patients were placed in the special care unit. A nurse sat at a corner, writing records while she took care of the patients.

“The patient is okay, you can rest assured.” The associate chief physician from the provincial hospital looked at the patient’s condition, and his expression changed slightly. Then, he smiled and comforted the patient and his family members. His attitude was very amiable.
When the patient’s family members saw that the surgery was completed and the patient was lying down safely, they naturally became happy.
“Thank you, doctor. Thank you, Associate Chief Physician Deng.”
“I thank you and your family on behalf of my family.”
“Everything is okay now. At least, you didn’t waste all the money you spent to send the patient over via helicopter.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng from the provincial hospital wore a kind smile no matter what the patient’s family said.

He even spoke highly about Yun Hua Hospital. “It is fine as long as everything is okay. You all may come out after having a look at the patient. Look, this room has been changed into a special care unit. We all should abide by the rules, and the same goes for the patient. Abide by the rules, and he will recover soon.”
The senior nurse in the special care unit looked at Associate Chief Physician Deng and nodded at him.
They were not from the same hospital, and what she did was already considered polite behavior.
The patient’s family members agreed reluctantly.
Associate Chief Physician Deng was still smiling, but he said to Cai Qiong, who was next to him, “Old Cai, come with me.”
Cai Qiong’s expression changed. He followed him out of the special care unit with an unyielding attitude.
“Find a smoking area.” Although the associate chief physician was only one rank higher than Cai Qiong, he was the leader of his treatment group and Cai Qiong’s superior.
Also, the other directors did not want Cai Qiong, who talked too much and was unskilled. Hence, Cai Qiong was placed under him, as he had a lower qualification.
Cai Qiong guessed that he was going to be scolded, but now, he had no interest in speaking. He walked forward without uttering a word and stood still as soon as he found a corner.
Associate Chief Physician Deng’s expression slightly changed. He thought to himself, ‘Why is he not speaking when he should?’
He then followed Cai Qiong in the corner, took out his cigarette, looked up, and saw the word “supply room”.
Associate Chief Physician Deng felt anger burn in him, but he suppressed it and put away his cigarette.
“You aren’t going to smoke?” Cai Qiong frowned instead. “If you’re not smoking, then what’s the point of coming this far?”
“You’re asking me to smoke near the supply room? Are you crazy?” Associate Chief Physician Deng said, then waved his hand. “Let’s not talk about this...”
Cai Qiong never really thought twice about what he said. He casually provoked Associate Chief Physician Deng, “Smoking is also forbidden in the office, yet you still smoke in there every day.”
“It’s not the same.”
“It looks the same for those of us who don’t smoke.”

Associate Chief Physician Deng gritted his teeth as he recited in his heart that he would not argue with idiots. Then, he asked the key question slowly, “Didn’t I ask you to transfer the patient back to Yun Hua Hospital itself? Why did Ling Ran perform the surgery?”

“You told me to follow the patient to Bazhaixiang hospital branch to see if the doctors from Yun Hua Hospital can perform this surgery. If not, I was to send the patient to Yun Hua Hospital itself. Turns out, the doctors from Yun Hua Hospital were able to perform the surgery. There’s nothing I can do...” Cai Qiong spread his arms to show that he did not want to take the blame.
Associate Chief Physician Deng nearly snorted. “Don’t you understand human language? Is that what I meant?”
“I basically repeated what you said, I also have a few witnesses—”

“I...” Associate Chief Physician Deng gritted his teeth and said, “I asked you to come to the Bazhaixiang hospital branch and performed some formalities before transferring the patient to Yun Hua Hospital itself, don’t you understand that? Who asked you to give the patient to the people of Yun Hua Hospital?”

Cai Qiong called out, “Don’t push the blame on me! You didn’t say that in the beginning. What’s wrong? Doctor Ling already completed the surgery. Now that you feel so embarrassed, you’re thinking about me causing trouble?”
Associate Chief Physician Deng would have thrown a punch if punching did not hurt his hand.
It was too tiring to talk to a simple-minded person.
After catching his breath, Associate Chief Physician Deng held back his anger and asked, “Did they send in a lot of equipment?”
“Yes, didn’t I take a picture of them?” Cai Qiong answered every question, but he always did so in a manner that would make a person unhappy.
“So... the surgery went well?”

“Of course, he’s Doctor Ling...” Cai Qiong suddenly felt a bit sentimental, but because of his pride as someone from the provincial hospital, he was not willing to praise someone from Yun Hua Hospital.

Associate Chief Physician Deng could understand what he was trying to say, but he did not think about it much. He just smiled slightly. “He went to Beijing as a freelance surgeon. If he worked in an operating theater with a full set of equipment, there’s no way he’ll slip up when he performs a hepatectomy.”
Cai Qiong chuckled and looked at Associate Chief Physician Deng’s expression. It was somewhat intriguing.
Associate Chief Physician Deng suddenly found the brat really annoying. Not only was he chatty, but he just had an annoying face.
“Old Cai.” Associate Chief Physician Deng squeezed his cigarette box, and his smile faded.
“Yes?” Cai Qiong had a mirthless grin on his face. He was quite experienced and knowledgeable, so he was not afraid of unimportant things, especially unimportant scoldings.

Associate Chief Physician Deng revealed a daring smile that belonged to those who feared nothing after they had done dirty work for years. “The higher-ups have requested for us to go to the rural areas to work. Our group will send you there.”
Cai Qiong was taken by surprise. “Where?”
“Huang Village.” When Associate Chief Physician Deng said the words, he suddenly felt so refreshed.

Cai Qiong was stunned. Huang Village was in the mountains of Bazhaixiang. He was a doctor who worked in operating theaters. What could he possibly do when he was sent to a place where an infirmary did not even exist?
“Work hard when you’re there,” Associate Chief Physician Deng said nothing more and turned away to leave.
Cai Qiong stared at Associate Chief Physician Deng’s back as he gritted his teeth, and he said slowly, “Doctor Ling is twice as strong as you during surgeries just by the way he sutures.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng’s greatest pride was his suturing skill. After he heard this, he stopped moving for a while before he continued to walk away as if nothing had happened.
Cai Qiong felt refreshed, but after that, he felt hollow again.
“I said something wrong again.” Old Cai sighed, and he suddenly wanted to smoke.
Ahead of Cai Qiong was Associate Chief Physician Deng, who turned into a corner before he slowly stopped moving. After thinking about it, he decided to go to the ward on the first floor.
The patient’s family members had been convinced to leave by now. The nurse, who remained, greeted Associate Chief Physician Deng politely when they saw him.
“Let me look at your wound,” Associate Chief Physician Deng continued to smile amiably and lifted the hem of the patient’s clothes.

sentences.text: In the afternoon, the humidity in the air was a little lower.
The sun was golden and bright as if someone graceful was dancing about, even though that person could not be clearly seen.
Two dirty off-road vehicles made noises so loud they did not care about who they bothered.
They drove slowly from the other end of the street, swaying from side to side as if they were office workers who were really exhausted after a day’s work.
When the SUV stopped at a board that stated “The Bazhaixiang hospital branch, Cangping District Hospital, Yun Hua City”, a row of six people got off the vehicle one after another.
They were also swaying from side to side.
Everyone looked pale as if they could immediately be sent to an emergency treatment room.
“The patient is fine.
Don’t worry.
Let’s go ahead and have a look.” One of the people who came down from the first car was an associate chief physician from the provincial hospital.
He was dressed in a white coat, and it was a little dirty.
The road from the township hospital to Bazhaixiang was not far, but the journey was incredibly challenging.
The people in the vehicles had to get down to help the vehicles get through the mud on the roads more than once.
The clothes of the patient’s family members were stained with mud.
Their expressions and gazes were very anxious.
“The surgery went well.
Let me lead you up,” Zuo Cidian, who was in charge of reception, also did not speak much.
He took the crowd to the special care unit, which was reconstructed on the first floor.
Compared with the other rooms, where six patients in one room, only three patients were placed in the special care unit.
A nurse sat at a corner, writing records while she took care of the patients.
“The patient is okay, you can rest assured.” The associate chief physician from the provincial hospital looked at the patient’s condition, and his expression changed slightly.
Then, he smiled and comforted the patient and his family members.
His attitude was very amiable.
When the patient’s family members saw that the surgery was completed and the patient was lying down safely, they naturally became happy.
“Thank you, doctor.
Thank you, Associate Chief Physician Deng.”
“I thank you and your family on behalf of my family.”
“Everything is okay now.
At least, you didn’t waste all the money you spent to send the patient over via helicopter.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng from the provincial hospital wore a kind smile no matter what the patient’s family said.
He even spoke highly about Yun Hua Hospital.
“It is fine as long as everything is okay.
You all may come out after having a look at the patient.
Look, this room has been changed into a special care unit.
We all should abide by the rules, and the same goes for the patient.
Abide by the rules, and he will recover soon.”
The senior nurse in the special care unit looked at Associate Chief Physician Deng and nodded at him.
They were not from the same hospital, and what she did was already considered polite behavior.
The patient’s family members agreed reluctantly.
Associate Chief Physician Deng was still smiling, but he said to Cai Qiong, who was next to him, “Old Cai, come with me.”
Cai Qiong’s expression changed.
He followed him out of the special care unit with an unyielding attitude.
“Find a smoking area.” Although the associate chief physician was only one rank higher than Cai Qiong, he was the leader of his treatment group and Cai Qiong’s superior.
Also, the other directors did not want Cai Qiong, who talked too much and was unskilled.
Hence, Cai Qiong was placed under him, as he had a lower qualification.
Cai Qiong guessed that he was going to be scolded, but now, he had no interest in speaking.
He walked forward without uttering a word and stood still as soon as he found a corner.
Associate Chief Physician Deng’s expression slightly changed.
He thought to himself, ‘Why is he not speaking when he should?’
He then followed Cai Qiong in the corner, took out his cigarette, looked up, and saw the word “supply room”.
Associate Chief Physician Deng felt anger burn in him, but he suppressed it and put away his cigarette.
“You aren’t going to smoke?” Cai Qiong frowned instead.
“If you’re not smoking, then what’s the point of coming this far?”
“You’re asking me to smoke near the supply room?
Are you crazy?” Associate Chief Physician Deng said, then waved his hand.
“Let’s not talk about this...”
Cai Qiong never really thought twice about what he said.
He casually provoked Associate Chief Physician Deng, “Smoking is also forbidden in the office, yet you still smoke in there every day.”
“It’s not the same.”
“It looks the same for those of us who don’t smoke.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng gritted his teeth as he recited in his heart that he would not argue with idiots.
Then, he asked the key question slowly, “Didn’t I ask you to transfer the patient back to Yun Hua Hospital itself?
Why did Ling Ran perform the surgery?”
“You told me to follow the patient to Bazhaixiang hospital branch to see if the doctors from Yun Hua Hospital can perform this surgery.
If not, I was to send the patient to Yun Hua Hospital itself.
Turns out, the doctors from Yun Hua Hospital were able to perform the surgery.
There’s nothing I can do...” Cai Qiong spread his arms to show that he did not want to take the blame.
Associate Chief Physician Deng nearly snorted.
“Don’t you understand human language?
Is that what I meant?”
“I basically repeated what you said, I also have a few witnesses—”

“I...” Associate Chief Physician Deng gritted his teeth and said, “I asked you to come to the Bazhaixiang hospital branch and performed some formalities before transferring the patient to Yun Hua Hospital itself, don’t you understand that?
Who asked you to give the patient to the people of Yun Hua Hospital?”
Cai Qiong called out, “Don’t push the blame on me!
You didn’t say that in the beginning.
What’s wrong?
Doctor Ling already completed the surgery.
Now that you feel so embarrassed, you’re thinking about me causing trouble?”
Associate Chief Physician Deng would have thrown a punch if punching did not hurt his hand.
It was too tiring to talk to a simple-minded person.
After catching his breath, Associate Chief Physician Deng held back his anger and asked, “Did they send in a lot of equipment?”
“Yes, didn’t I take a picture of them?” Cai Qiong answered every question, but he always did so in a manner that would make a person unhappy.
“So... the surgery went well?”

“Of course, he’s Doctor Ling...” Cai Qiong suddenly felt a bit sentimental, but because of his pride as someone from the provincial hospital, he was not willing to praise someone from Yun Hua Hospital.
Associate Chief Physician Deng could understand what he was trying to say, but he did not think about it much.
He just smiled slightly.
“He went to Beijing as a freelance surgeon.
If he worked in an operating theater with a full set of equipment, there’s no way he’ll slip up when he performs a hepatectomy.”
Cai Qiong chuckled and looked at Associate Chief Physician Deng’s expression.
It was somewhat intriguing.
Associate Chief Physician Deng suddenly found the brat really annoying.
Not only was he chatty, but he just had an annoying face.
“Old Cai.” Associate Chief Physician Deng squeezed his cigarette box, and his smile faded.
“Yes?” Cai Qiong had a mirthless grin on his face.
He was quite experienced and knowledgeable, so he was not afraid of unimportant things, especially unimportant scoldings.
Associate Chief Physician Deng revealed a daring smile that belonged to those who feared nothing after they had done dirty work for years.
“The higher-ups have requested for us to go to the rural areas to work.
Our group will send you there.”
Cai Qiong was taken by surprise.
“Where?”
“Huang Village.” When Associate Chief Physician Deng said the words, he suddenly felt so refreshed.
Cai Qiong was stunned.
Huang Village was in the mountains of Bazhaixiang.
He was a doctor who worked in operating theaters.
What could he possibly do when he was sent to a place where an infirmary did not even exist?
“Work hard when you’re there,” Associate Chief Physician Deng said nothing more and turned away to leave.
