chapters.title: Chapter 864: Little Dark Room
paragraphs: “Associate Chief Physician Deng, what can I do for you?” The senior nurse of the special care unit stood up. As someone who had been a full-time circulating nurse and who gained the achievement of scolding at least one hundred doctors, when she faced doctors below the rank of a chief physician, she could do so boldly.

Associate Chief Physician Deng was a little diffident. After he looked at the neatly bandaged gauze, he found that there was no exudation and no oozing of blood. He raised his eyebrows and said, “I want to examine the patient’s recovery...”

“The patient just finished his surgery. You may come again after the person changes his dressing.” The senior nurse stood up. She was generally polite, but her gaze was quite fierce, just like how she looked at the junior doctors when she noticed their hair slipped out of their surgical caps.

Associate Chief Physician Deng had been a junior doctor too. He coughed a couple of times decisively and said, “I’m rushing home, I only need to ask a few questions about the patient’s condition for a while.”
The senior nurse did not make a sound and shifted to the side as she stared at Associate Chief Physician Deng.
“How are you feeling?” Associate Chief Physician Deng felt a little guilty as he looked at the patient.
The patient who just regained consciousness moved his lips and laboriously said, “...I’m okay...”
From the looks of it, the patient did not look okay at all.
However, according to Associate Chief Physician Deng’s experience, being able to regain consciousness the same day he received hepatectomy was good news.

Associate Chief Physician Deng looked at the patient’s expression, picked up the nursing record at the end of the bed, and went through it. He turned to the nurse, who was now on high alert, and asked, “Do you have a video of the surgery?”
“You can ask from Doctor Yu,” the nurse replied.
“Where is Doctor Yu?” Associate Chief Physician Deng asked.
“Right behind you,” the senior nurse answered.
Associate Chief Physician Deng turned around and heard a voice,
“Here.” She may have been small, but she was loud.
Associate Chief Physician Deng could not help but be surprised, but he quickly schooled his expression so as not to show that he was shocked.

“Associate Chief Physician Deng, you want to have a look at the video of the surgery?” Yu Yuan did not make any fuss. Since Ling Ran’s age did not match with his status in the medical community, the potential challengers Ling Ran encountered had also inevitably increased, especially since the live broadcast system from Yunli Medical Company was used by more people in a larger area.
Doctors from the General Surgery Department were all normal challengers, and Yu Yuan herself had dealt with a few of them.
For Yu Yuan, the challengers in Changxi Province were not really a threat.

Associate Chief Physician Deng was a little worried. His intention had been seen through. He laughed and said, “This patient was sent here by me, and I am a little uneasy. Of course, I’m talking about being uneasy about the patient’s condition...”
“I’ll make a room for you. You can watch the video yourself. You are not allowed to make a copy or record it, understand?” Yu Yuan explained with familiar ease.
Associate Chief Physician Deng hummed and thought about what she just said a while ago. It felt as though it was what he heard when he was younger back then...
Yu Yuan led Associate Chief Physician Deng to a corner once they got out the door. After a long walk, they reached a room with a television set shining and with thick curtains covering the windows.

At the other end of the television set, were several shabby leather and cloth couches with their backs turned to the door. They were not placed neatly, but surprisingly, people could be found on the couches.
“Close the door.” The voice of a person inside rose, and it was mixed with heavy breathing as well as the sound of bodies moving.
Yu Yuan pointed forward and said, “There’s still one hour left for the video.”

Associate Chief Physician Deng hesitated for a few seconds. For a while, he did not want to go into the room. There was a stench in the room, but the image on the television attracted Associate Chief Physician Deng, and it made him step into the room involuntarily.
“Call me if you need anything.” Yu Yuan drew the curtain and left swiftly.
Associate Chief Physician Deng’s lips moved. He did not go out of the room in the end, so he found an empty space at a corner and sat down.
*Creak*
The noise that the really old couch made was grating to the ears.
Several people looked over with discontent, and their eyes shone with a fierce light.
Associate Chief Physician Deng smiled bashfully. In the dim room, everyone’s status was a mere illusion.
On the screen, the video continued playing.
Associate Chief Physician Deng quickly composed himself and focused on the screen.
Familiar and unfamiliar figures took each other’s places while the camera lens moved about in the operating theater.
It was a very typical hepatectomy.

Associate Chief Physician Deng had seen surgeries similar to this a number of times. He would even see something similar during various meetings occasionally, but most of the time, he would just smile and turn around.
But today, Associate Chief Physician Deng plopped himself against the broken couch and did not quite want to get up.
The surgery went so smoothly that it would be a shame if it was to be interrupted.
The image on the screen changed rhythmically, just like a planned performance. All the details were perfect, and the rhythm of the surgery was extremely pleasant.
Associate Chief Physician Deng just felt his body slowly sink into the broken couch, like the night from twenty-two years ago...
*Creak*
Someone opened the door again.
This time, Associate Chief Physician Deng and the others turned around fiercely.
“Close the door,” Associate Chief Physician Deng and the others yelled.
“Oh...” The person who just entered the dark environment also seemed to feel guilty.
*Creak*
He sat down, and the old couch moaned as well.
Associate Chief Physician Deng glanced at the back impatiently. He widened his eyes in surprise, and he subconsciously wanted to greet Chief Physician Li, but he forced himself to hold back.
The present environment was not suitable for him to greet someone.

Moreover, although everyone in the room was considered as a chief physician from the other people’s views, with the strict system in the hospital, Associate Chief Physician Deng was just an associate chief physician, and Chief Physician Li was a chief physician. There were several levels separating them, and it was another matter entirely as to whether Chief Physician Li was willing to exchange greetings with him.
Afterward, Associate Chief Physician Deng thought again. Chief Physician Li was supposedly in the provincial hospital itself and not in Bazhaixiang. Why was he suddenly here, and in such a place...?
“Amazing...” Chief Physician Li, who had just arrived, was obviously not familiar with the rules of watching films in a dark room like this. He actually shouted when he was really into the video.
Associate Chief Physician Deng looked at him with contempt.

From where he sat, he could see half of Chief Physician Li’s figure. Chief Physician Li was turned to the side slightly. His upper body was stiff and straight, and his arms, as well as fingers, just kept moving in front of him.
Associate Chief Physician Deng could not help but show an admiring expression.
Being able to do whatever one wanted was also an ability.
In this kind of place, being able to follow the video and perform a surgery simulation meant that a person was incredibly focused.
As a result, Associate Chief Physician Deng turned his head around, relaxed his hands, and followed the movements from the scenes in the video.
There were mixes of slight bits of enthusiasm, fervor, and passion in the small room.
“You’re done watching, right?”
The curtains were drawn synchronously, and immediately afterward, the lights were on.
The room was filled with regretful groans.
Associate Chief Physician Deng let out a groan as well, and he heard Chief Physician Li, who was nearby, did the same thing.
The two of them looked at each other at the same time. They turned away quickly the first moment they saw each other’s hands.
“Why did you come to Bazhaixiang?” Associate Chief Physician Deng only felt like asking Chief Physician Li once they were outside and saw the sun after being deprived of it for a long time.

The latter just smiled before he slowly said, “Yun Hua Hospital is in Bazhaixiang. After they showed off over here for such a long time, the upper management asked me to come down here to take a look.”
“Take a look... at what?” Associate Chief Physician Deng subconsciously looked at the dark room behind him.
“Don’t jump to conclusions. I just came to see Ling Ran’s surgery. They make it sound so legendary, after all...
“And your conclusion?”
“He did an amazing job!” Chief Physician Li sighed and said, “We have to find an alternative path.”
“An alternative path? What is it?”
“Public health,” Chief Physician Li said affirmatively.

chapters.title: Chapter 865: Overcome With Worry
paragraphs: “Old Cai, don’t head to Huang Village just yet.” Associate Chief Physician Deng successfully found Cai Qiong in the cafeteria.

Cai Qiong’s mouth was full of chewed rice and vegetables. He muttered, “You aren’t even allowing me to go to Huang Village? Send me to exile, then. Forget about it, island vacations are in trend nowadays. I reckon that you guys aren’t prepared to be so merciful toward me...”
“No one’s sending you to exile. Can you please talk like a proper human being?” Associate Chief Physician Deng’s tone became slightly sterner.

“It’s just exile. Since you guys are capable of doing it, why aren’t you owning up to it?” Cai Qiong felt that morality wise, he had already obtained the upper hand in the conversation. Hence, he raised his voice and said, “I have already gone to Huang Village. Why would I be afraid of anything? But I am curious about whether there’s any place that’s worse than Huang Village... hahaha...”

In fact, he was truly not afraid. He was already an authorized doctor anyway, and the worst that could happen to him was to be sent to exile. Just like what he had said, Huang Village was the worst possible place that a doctor could be sent to. Aside from this, Yun Hua Provincial Hospital did not dare to let him stay there for too long, as he might otherwise refuse to go to work and make a scene, causing trouble to the hospital.

Associate Chief Physician Deng knew what kind of person Cai Qiong was, so he did not bother replying. He merely stood beside the table and glared fiercely at Cai Qiong. He had practiced this glare since yesterday.

Cai Qiong was merely a person who had trouble controlling his mouth. He was not an idiot. Now that he had spoken those harsh words and obtained gratification from doing so, he shut up. He then said slowly, “Tell me, where will I be going?”

“This is Chief Physician Li’s suggestion. Our position in Bazhaixiang is unstable right now, and we should mainly work on establishing our presence there right now.” Associate Chief Physician Deng first explained the situation. He then slowly said, “So, you’ll be staying in Cangping District Hospital’s Bazhaixiang branch and helping them out. This way, Yun Hua Provincial Hospital will be able to make a name for itself there.”
Cai Qiong widened his eyes. “You’re asking me to work on public health? I’m a clinician.”

“With the situation in Bazhaixiang right now, we would be at an advantage if we were to help them out with public health. We have to do it before Yun Hua Hospital does, and it would do nothing but benefit us if we’re able to do it successfully. Don’t you agree with me?” There was a smile on Associate Chief Physician Deng’s face. No one would be willing to do this kind of job, so he had no choice but to ask Cai Qiong to do it.
Cai Qiong, though, was extremely reluctant. He muttered again, “I’m a clinician, you can’t just make me work on public health.”
“It’ll just be for a while. After we sort things out, we’ll have somebody take over you.”

“What if no one’s taking over? I would have fallen into your trap, then.” Cai Qiong had trouble controlling his mouth, and this was a good time for him to start complaining. “You really have many tricks up your sleeve. Do you really think that anyone would agree to take over the job of helping out with public health in Bazhaixiang? No one from this hospital is as much of a pushover as I am...”

Associate Chief Physician Deng scrunched up his eyebrows tightly when he heard this, and his tone became stern once again. “Doctor Cai, this is an order from your superior, and you’re not in a position to talk about it or make any bargains. Do you really want to stay in Huang Village until the end of your career?”
Can Qiong’s neck stiffened. “I would rather go to Huang Village than to work on public health.”
“Are you sure?” Associate Chief Physician Deng said in a ghastly tone.
“I... wait, I didn’t say that I want to go to Huang Village.” Cai Qiong looked suspiciously at Associate Chief Physician Deng. ‘Don’t tell me that this is another trap.’
“You can choose between Huang Village and working on public health.”
“I’m not going to make any choice.”
“You were the one who said this...”
“Wait a moment... what did I say? I said nothing...”
In the afternoon, Cai Qiong walked behind Chief Physician Li, and both of them were studying every inch of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
“Hm, based on what I can gather right now, this storeroom in the backyard is very suitable to be used for storing the stuff needed for public health,” Chief Physician Li said as he nodded.

To junior doctors, public health was an extremely uninteresting task. They were unable to derive any motivation from it or find any meaning in it. However, high-ranking doctors found public health quite interesting, and even though Chief Physician Li had been a clinician for many years, he made a lot of sense when he talked about public health.
Cai Qiong listened glumly. He did not know if he had made the right choice.

“Another choice would be the corner room on the first floor,” Chief Physician Li continued. “Even though the lighting there is a little bad, it’s quite a large room. It’ll be usable after we remove the sofas and other furniture inside the room and clean the place up. Not only can it be used as an office space, but it can also double up as a storeroom. I reckon that they would prefer to give us this room compared to the storeroom in the courtyard. When that happens, your first task would be to clean up and set up this room.”
Department Director Li chuckled as he observed Cai Qiong, who had made a name for himself in the hospital for being difficult.

In the environment of the hospital, young people who had the intention to improve themselves made the best subordinates. This also applied to middle-aged doctors who had the intention to improve themselves. They would persist until the end even if they were almost dying from overwork.

Correspondingly, doctors who have lost their desire to improve themselves made the worst subordinates. Take a man like Cai Qiong who had been beaten down many times as an example. There might have been some changes in his mental state.

Since Chief Physician Li was not Cai Qiong’s direct superior, he was being quite polite to him. He even kind of treasured Cai Qiong as Cai Qiong was his only subordinate right now. He turned and said with a smile, “If Bazhaixiang doesn’t let us use the storeroom downstairs or the corner room on the first floor, the third choice would be one of the shophouses near the hospital. But that would be a little troublesome.”
“If I were to do my job in a shophouse outside the hospital, people would mistake me for a quack.” Cai Qiong could no longer hold himself back from speaking.

There was a smile on Chief Physician Li’s face. “When you work on public health, it’s impossible to please everyone. Also, this is the last choice, isn’t it? If the doctors in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch insist on not allocating space for us, we would have no choice but to rent a shophouse.”
“Based on my experience, as long as there is a last choice, it would be what I get,” Cai Qiong muttered dejectedly, and it delivered quite a shock to those who heard him.

Chief Physician Li had high hopes of putting on a good performance in Bazhaixiang, and he almost tripped and fell to death when he heard what Cai Qiong said. He was so furious that he almost started scolding Cai Qiong, but he changed his mind after he turned and looked at Cai Qiong, who was already over forty years old but was still an attending physician. He could not help but sigh and say, “This isn’t the same. No matter what, working on public health is better than working as a village doctor in Huang Village, isn’t it?”
Cai Qiong had calmed down by then. “I think so too. But I always make the wrong choice whenever I have to answer a multiple-choice question.”
Chief Physician Li looked at Cai Qiong in a daze, and he was actually unable to come out with a retort.
But he finally understood why this man was still a senior attending physician even though he was already over the age of forty.

Chief Physician Li’s original plan was for Cai Qiong to talk to the people in Bazhaixiang and make some progress first before he handled things personally. But after what had just happened, he suddenly felt that he had not taken enough things into consideration.
Cai Qiong would probably make a mess of things.
“Alright, come with me.” No matter what, Chief Physician Li still felt that he needed someone to help him out with miscellaneous tasks.
Chief Physician Li led the way as they looked for the office in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.

Unlike the hospital directors in large hospitals in the city, the hospital director of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch did not really hold much power. His office was extremely shabby. It was merely a small office room that was located inside the office shared by everyone.

Cai Qiong could not help but make a snide remark as he stared at the tiny office. “The hospital director doesn’t even have a separate office. Do you really think that they would allocate a room for us to use as a storeroom and an office space?”
“Don’t be pessimistic,” Chief Physician Li replied. For some reason, he no longer felt angry. Perhaps, he was used to Cai Qiong’s behavior already.

After he knocked on the door, Chief Physician Li stood in the office and said, “I’m Li Bingfu from the General Surgery Department of Yun Hua Provincial Hospital. May I know if the hospital director is around?”

“Director Wang is away. What’s the matter?” A doctor, who was clad in a large white coat and had a face that was full of wrinkles, looked away from the monitor and peered at Chief Physician Li as well as Cai Qiong.
“Huh? Doctor... Doctor Zuo, why are you here?” Cai Qiong cried out in surprise.
Chief Physician Li turned to look at Zuo Cidian. “Do you guys know each other?”
“This is Doctor Zuo from Yun Hua Hospital. He’s part of the Ling Treatment Group.” Cai Qiong managed to introduce Zuo Cidian to Chief Physician Li in a socially appropriate manner.
Zuo Cidian rose with a smile and said, “There’s quite a lot of tasks that have to be carried out in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch, so I came over to help out.”

He was extremely familiar with the way village hospitals operated. It was extremely easy for outsiders to enter the office. Meanwhile, the hospital director of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch was more interested in being an internist, and he was always missing from the office.

Chief Physician Li looked around. Even though he was reluctant to talk about the intention of his visit to Zuo Cidian, he was not the kind of person who bothered with trivialities. Hence, he told Zuo Cidian about their intention to help out with public health in Bazhaixiang. “It’s actually a good thing. Aside from allocating some space for us, the Bazhaixiang hospital branch will not have to be responsible for any of the expenses. Everything, from the drugs used to the doctors who are working on the project, will come from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital. After the roads clear up two days later, the Bazhaixiang hospital branch won’t even have to pay for the disinfectants we use...”

Chief Physician Li stood in the middle of the office as he spoke, trying his best to ensure that the two people in the office apart from Zuo Cidian could hear what he was saying. He had already made up his mind that if Yun Hua Hospital stopped their efforts, he would immediately head outside and rent a shophouse to make a name for themselves so that Yun Hua Hospital would not beat them to it.
Zuo Cidian looked as though he did not notice Chief Physician Li’s expression. He said with a smile, “I’ll make a call and ask Doctor Ling about it. Give me a few minutes.”
“Sure.” Chief Physician Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back.
Cai Qiong chuckled a few times. “So, Cangping District Hospital’s Bazhaixiang branch has to report to Yun Hua Hospital before doing anything nowadays?”
No one in the office looked at him.
Zuo Cidian’s call soon went through. He quickly explained the situation and hummed a few times before hanging up.
Chief Physician Li was already mentally prepared. He smiled and said, “If it’s not possible...”

“Doctor Ling has voiced his agreement. You guys can go ahead and use the storeroom as well as the office. But we don’t have enough manpower right now, so we can only allocate two helpers we hired from outside to help you guys out. Will this do?” Zuo Cidian spoke speedily and urgently, but everyone could hear him clearly.
Chief Physician Li froze for a moment before he turned and smiled. “Doctor Ling is a generous person indeed. Sure, thank you very much then.”
After he said that, Chief Physician Li asked for a key and happily went to make preparations.

Cai Qiong walked behind Chief Physician Li, and he did not even bother to smile. He was overcome with worry as he thought about things. ‘Aren’t things going a little too smoothly? If this continues, the Bazhaixiang hospital branch might just be caught up in the mudflow.’

chapters.title: Chapter 866: Too Tame
paragraphs: Cai Qiong looked worried while standing in the courtyard of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.

The sky was as blue as a coastline, and the clouds were as white as the clouds shown in European and American films. Even the important people sent to the hospital smiled like those in Japanese films.
Everything went so smoothly that it made Cai Qiong tremble.

When was the last time things went so smoothly? Oh right, it was during his national college entrance test. Cai Qiong had successfully gained a life achievement of passing through a major test in his life with high marks that were 50 marks lower than his trial examination. Then... he was sent to medical school.

Even after twenty years, when Cai Qiong remembered the moment he received his letter of admission, he still felt a chill down his spine. He would not be in such a miserable stage if he did not study in medical school.
If he had some other job, he would not be tied down to the point that he could not leave.
“Why is your face so horrible? Aren’t things going quite smoothly?” Chief Physician Li walked over with a smile.
It had been some time since he wanted to do a project related to public health. He never thought that supporting Bazhaixiang would provide him with a chance.

In the present, clinical medicine and public health were separate things. Experts who mastered both clinical medicine and public health such as R. Koch, Yan Fuqing, and Wu Liande could rarely be found after the seventies and eighties. However, Chief Physician Li was not prepared to become like those top-class doctors. With his current position, regardless of whether it was public health, preventative medicine, or disease control, a lot more trouble can end up happening as compared to clinical medicine.
Cai Qiong still looked so gloomy and said, “It’s going too smoothly? Aren’t you scared?”
“What are you scared of?”
“Natural disasters and manmade disasters!” Cai Qiong said seriously with a stern expression.
Chief Physician Li sighed. Honestly speaking, if he had a chance, he would have replaced Cai Qiong a long time ago, and it would not be for any other reason aside from getting a good omen.

Unfortunately, the road was not cleared yet, and it was impossible for the provincial hospital to send someone via helicopter just to get a good omen. He was not that important in the hospital, and the provincial hospital was not that rich as well.
When Chief Physician Li thought about this, he frowned. Since when did Yun Hua Hospital become that rich?
“Has the office been cleared yet?” Chief Physician Li decided frankly to just talk about the specifics of his work.

Cai Qiong’s stared at the corner of the first floor and said, “We have the middle-aged ladies hired by Yunli to work for us. All those couches have been removed. They’re cleaning up the place right now.”
“We’ve received all the items required for an office?”
“The Bazhaixiang branch hospital lent us some, and Yunli gave us another batch. It’s sufficient for the time being.” Cai Qiong looked solemn.
“Isn’t that pretty...?” The chief physician wanted to praise Cai Qiong but he held back when he saw his face.

“I remembered that things went quite smoothly during my wedding.” Cai Qiong stared at Chief Physician Li, and there was a warning tone in his voice. Plus, his words seemed to hold a serious reminder. “My matchmaking and marriage were quite smooth. The weather was good as well. There was not a single cloud in sight, and the weather was neither too hot nor cold. My child was born smoothly as well. Without needing my help, she found someone with good genes to father her child...”
Chief Physician Li did not want to listen anymore. He coughed and said, “Old Cai, let us talk about the work first. Um... when will the disinfectants arrive?”
“They’ve already arrived, and they’ve been sent to the warehouse,” Cai Qiong replied. “They were brought over personally by Zuo Cidian from Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center.”
“Why is he so... enthusiastic?” Chief Physician Li could hardly believe that.
Cai Qiong nodded and said, “According to Zuo Cidian, Doctor Ling supports us in doing public health.”
He spoke in the way parrots spoke when they tried to learn how to speak. He also had a frown on his face, making him look like Zuo Cidian.
Chief Physician Li did not laugh. He could not help but put his hands together and started to mutter.
Cai Qiong felt his heart thump, but a smile was seen on his face. “Did something bad happen? Actually, it’s okay to be unlucky sometimes. We can’t always expect good things to happen...”

“We’ll do what we need to do. It doesn’t matter to us whether he supports us or not.” Chief Physician Li quickly affirmed his beliefs, making himself confident. He had goals and ambitions when he came over to Bazhaixiang. He even prepared to be regarded with hostility or be dragged down in his work. Now, Chief Physician Li at least had official support, and for him, that was not really a bad thing.
Cai Qiong was very disappointed. He gazed into the distance, and no one knew what he was thinking.

Chief Physician Li ignored him too. He went to check on the spare items in the warehouse himself, and he realized that the warehouse was completely stocked from disinfectant, computers, to all kinds of sticker papers.

Certainly, it was not as huge and well-equipped as the provincial hospital during their promotion period for public health, but with the current condition in Bazhaixiang in mind, he could not ask for more.

“This is good...” Chief Physician Li was in incredibly high spirits. He also talked pleasantly with the pharmaceutical sales representative guarding the warehouse. “I forgot to ask, which company did you all come from?”
“Yunli Medical Company. I’m Mai Chun from Yunli Medical Company. You can just call me Young Mai.” Mai Chun was smart now, and she became enthusiastic when she heard Chief Physician Li’s tone.

Chief Physician Li was full of frustration because of Cai Qiong. Now, when he heard a clear and melodious female voice, his mood turned better. He touched his chin and said, “Yunli Medical Company is recently doing quite well in Bazhaixiang. You appeared at all fronts of the rescue effort. What are you thinking of achieving?”
“Our company aims to provide the best service. So, when we know that Doctor Ling has decided to take part, Yunli Medical Company must follow him.” Mai Chun tried to go through the formalities.

Chief Li nodded gently. “Is that so? I can tell that you brought quite the complete supply of goods over. Could you contact logistics and tell them to prepare more items? Once the road is cleared, send all of them to me. Of course, if Yun Hua Hospital is your only customer, just ignore what I said. Hahaha...”

“How can that be? Just rest assured...” Mai Chun’s eyes sparkled, and she added Chief Physician Li’s WeChat. She turned around and sent him out before she shouted in the company group chat. [When I came over to Bazhaixiang to give help, I got myself a major business deal!]
Tons of words quickly popped up in the small group.
[How big is that?]
[It’s business given by Doctor Ling, right?]
[So jealous of you. It must be business given by Doctor Ling.]
Mai Chun smiled when she saw the texts. She was so happy that she sent out three photos of handbags, together with a cute picture with the caption: Which one should I buy?
Discussions instantly started again in the group chat.
[Doctor Ling is really handsome and has good luck.]
[Sob, sob, sob... I want to get a handbag too...]
[By the way, Young Mai, from whom did you get the business deal? What did they want?]

Mai Chun proudly typed out the words ‘provincial hospital’ and wrote, [I can’t share the details, and I hope that all of you can keep this a secret for me. Argh, I can’t continue with this. I need to prepare food for Doctor Ling.]
Again, rows of texts popped up in the group chat.
Mai Chun put away her phone and happily went to prepare food.

Tonight’s dinner would be stewed potatoes with beef. The potatoes were grown by the villagers. The beef was reared by the villagers, and the pot was also bought by the villagers. Even the chef was selected from among the villagers.
Even so, compared with the dining area, which could not be considered a cafeteria in Bazhaixiang, the food prepared by the villagers was much better.

Mai Chun believed that after the chef learned how to cook through the live lecture given by the company’s head chef through the video call, the food and beverage today could satisfy Miss Tian Qi’s basic requirements.
“Young Mai, your side is in charge of dinner tonight, right?” Zuo Cidian chuckled and appeared in the scullery.

Mai Chun knew that Zuo Cidian was Ling Ran’s greatest lackey, and she immediately said, “It’s by us. The main course will be stewed potatoes with beef, and the side dishes are stirred-fried beef with green bell peppers, Kung Pao Chicken...”
“You don’t have to tell me the name of the dishes. I just came over and asked to see whether it’s convenient for you to prepare food for a few more mouths.”
“How many people?”

“Two or three. They’re Chief Physician Li, Department Director Deng, and a senior attending physician from the provincial hospital, though I’m not sure whether they will come or not?” Zuo Cidian smiled faintly. “Doctor Ling was thinking that it’s not easy for them to perform public health, and he wanted them to eat something good...”
“Since this is Doctor Ling’s request. That should not be a problem.” Mai Chun resolutely made an “okay” gesture.

sentences.text: Cai Qiong looked worried while standing in the courtyard of the Bazhaixiang hospital branch.
The sky was as blue as a coastline, and the clouds were as white as the clouds shown in European and American films.
Even the important people sent to the hospital smiled like those in Japanese films.
Everything went so smoothly that it made Cai Qiong tremble.
When was the last time things went so smoothly?
Oh right, it was during his national college entrance test.
Cai Qiong had successfully gained a life achievement of passing through a major test in his life with high marks that were 50 marks lower than his trial examination.
Then... he was sent to medical school.
Even after twenty years, when Cai Qiong remembered the moment he received his letter of admission, he still felt a chill down his spine.
He would not be in such a miserable stage if he did not study in medical school.
If he had some other job, he would not be tied down to the point that he could not leave.
“Why is your face so horrible?
Aren’t things going quite smoothly?” Chief Physician Li walked over with a smile.
It had been some time since he wanted to do a project related to public health.
He never thought that supporting Bazhaixiang would provide him with a chance.
In the present, clinical medicine and public health were separate things.
Experts who mastered both clinical medicine and public health such as R.
Koch, Yan Fuqing, and Wu Liande could rarely be found after the seventies and eighties.
However, Chief Physician Li was not prepared to become like those top-class doctors.
With his current position, regardless of whether it was public health, preventative medicine, or disease control, a lot more trouble can end up happening as compared to clinical medicine.
Cai Qiong still looked so gloomy and said, “It’s going too smoothly?
Aren’t you scared?”
“What are you scared of?”
“Natural disasters and manmade disasters!” Cai Qiong said seriously with a stern expression.
Chief Physician Li sighed.
Honestly speaking, if he had a chance, he would have replaced Cai Qiong a long time ago, and it would not be for any other reason aside from getting a good omen.
Unfortunately, the road was not cleared yet, and it was impossible for the provincial hospital to send someone via helicopter just to get a good omen.
He was not that important in the hospital, and the provincial hospital was not that rich as well.
When Chief Physician Li thought about this, he frowned.
Since when did Yun Hua Hospital become that rich?
“Has the office been cleared yet?” Chief Physician Li decided frankly to just talk about the specifics of his work.
Cai Qiong’s stared at the corner of the first floor and said, “We have the middle-aged ladies hired by Yunli to work for us.
All those couches have been removed.
They’re cleaning up the place right now.”
“We’ve received all the items required for an office?”
“The Bazhaixiang branch hospital lent us some, and Yunli gave us another batch.
It’s sufficient for the time being.” Cai Qiong looked solemn.
“Isn’t that pretty...?” The chief physician wanted to praise Cai Qiong but he held back when he saw his face.
“I remembered that things went quite smoothly during my wedding.” Cai Qiong stared at Chief Physician Li, and there was a warning tone in his voice.
Plus, his words seemed to hold a serious reminder.
“My matchmaking and marriage were quite smooth.
The weather was good as well.
There was not a single cloud in sight, and the weather was neither too hot nor cold.
My child was born smoothly as well.
Without needing my help, she found someone with good genes to father her child...”
Chief Physician Li did not want to listen anymore.
He coughed and said, “Old Cai, let us talk about the work first.
Um... when will the disinfectants arrive?”
“They’ve already arrived, and they’ve been sent to the warehouse,” Cai Qiong replied.
“They were brought over personally by Zuo Cidian from Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center.”
“Why is he so... enthusiastic?” Chief Physician Li could hardly believe that.
Cai Qiong nodded and said, “According to Zuo Cidian, Doctor Ling supports us in doing public health.”
He spoke in the way parrots spoke when they tried to learn how to speak.
He also had a frown on his face, making him look like Zuo Cidian.
Chief Physician Li did not laugh.
He could not help but put his hands together and started to mutter.
Cai Qiong felt his heart thump, but a smile was seen on his face.
“Did something bad happen?
Actually, it’s okay to be unlucky sometimes.
We can’t always expect good things to happen...”
“We’ll do what we need to do.
It doesn’t matter to us whether he supports us or not.” Chief Physician Li quickly affirmed his beliefs, making himself confident.
He had goals and ambitions when he came over to Bazhaixiang.
He even prepared to be regarded with hostility or be dragged down in his work.
Now, Chief Physician Li at least had official support, and for him, that was not really a bad thing.
Cai Qiong was very disappointed.
He gazed into the distance, and no one knew what he was thinking.
Chief Physician Li ignored him too.
He went to check on the spare items in the warehouse himself, and he realized that the warehouse was completely stocked from disinfectant, computers, to all kinds of sticker papers.

Certainly, it was not as huge and well-equipped as the provincial hospital during their promotion period for public health, but with the current condition in Bazhaixiang in mind, he could not ask for more.
“This is good...” Chief Physician Li was in incredibly high spirits.
He also talked pleasantly with the pharmaceutical sales representative guarding the warehouse.
“I forgot to ask, which company did you all come from?”
“Yunli Medical Company.
I’m Mai Chun from Yunli Medical Company.
You can just call me Young Mai.” Mai Chun was smart now, and she became enthusiastic when she heard Chief Physician Li’s tone.
Chief Physician Li was full of frustration because of Cai Qiong.
Now, when he heard a clear and melodious female voice, his mood turned better.
He touched his chin and said, “Yunli Medical Company is recently doing quite well in Bazhaixiang.
You appeared at all fronts of the rescue effort.
What are you thinking of achieving?”
“Our company aims to provide the best service.
So, when we know that Doctor Ling has decided to take part, Yunli Medical Company must follow him.” Mai Chun tried to go through the formalities.
Chief Li nodded gently.
“Is that so?
I can tell that you brought quite the complete supply of goods over.
Could you contact logistics and tell them to prepare more items?
Once the road is cleared, send all of them to me.
Of course, if Yun Hua Hospital is your only customer, just ignore what I said.
Hahaha...”
“How can that be?
Just rest assured...” Mai Chun’s eyes sparkled, and she added Chief Physician Li’s WeChat.
She turned around and sent him out before she shouted in the company group chat.
[When I came over to Bazhaixiang to give help, I got myself a major business deal!]
Tons of words quickly popped up in the small group.
[How big is that?]
[It’s business given by Doctor Ling, right?]
[So jealous of you.
It must be business given by Doctor Ling.]
Mai Chun smiled when she saw the texts.
She was so happy that she sent out three photos of handbags, together with a cute picture with the caption: Which one should I buy?
Discussions instantly started again in the group chat.
[Doctor Ling is really handsome and has good luck.]
[Sob, sob, sob...
I want to get a handbag too...]
[By the way, Young Mai, from whom did you get the business deal?
What did they want?]
Mai Chun proudly typed out the words ‘provincial hospital’ and wrote, [I can’t share the details, and I hope that all of you can keep this a secret for me.
Argh, I can’t continue with this.
I need to prepare food for Doctor Ling.]
Again, rows of texts popped up in the group chat.
Mai Chun put away her phone and happily went to prepare food.
Tonight’s dinner would be stewed potatoes with beef.
The potatoes were grown by the villagers.
The beef was reared by the villagers, and the pot was also bought by the villagers.
Even the chef was selected from among the villagers.
Even so, compared with the dining area, which could not be considered a cafeteria in Bazhaixiang, the food prepared by the villagers was much better.

Mai Chun believed that after the chef learned how to cook through the live lecture given by the company’s head chef through the video call, the food and beverage today could satisfy Miss Tian Qi’s basic requirements.
“Young Mai, your side is in charge of dinner tonight, right?” Zuo Cidian chuckled and appeared in the scullery.
Mai Chun knew that Zuo Cidian was Ling Ran’s greatest lackey, and she immediately said, “It’s by us.
The main course will be stewed potatoes with beef, and the side dishes are stirred-fried beef with green bell peppers, Kung Pao Chicken...”
“You don’t have to tell me the name of the dishes.
I just came over and asked to see whether it’s convenient for you to prepare food for a few more mouths.”
“How many people?”
“Two or three.
They’re Chief Physician Li, Department Director Deng, and a senior attending physician from the provincial hospital, though I’m not sure whether they will come or not?” Zuo Cidian smiled faintly.
“Doctor Ling was thinking that it’s not easy for them to perform public health, and he wanted them to eat something good...”
“Since this is Doctor Ling’s request.
That should not be a problem.” Mai Chun resolutely made an “okay” gesture.

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Working on Public Health
paragraphs: Cai Qiong ate some vacuum-packed biscuits as he drank a concentrated cup of tea. He was staring at the monitor as he typed away on the keyboard.

Those who were involved in public health would be more motivated when faced with epidemics like SARS. They would have to work in full swing and liaise with public health departments in the whole country, and those who worked in the laboratory would have to race against time to isolate and study the virus as well as invent a vaccine. Politicians would be rallying for the cause, and every order must be obeyed.
However, in reality, most of the people involved in public health spent most of their time typing in front of a monitor.

They had to write reports, fill in documents, and explain the situation to their superiors... They also had to work on publicity and ensure that everyone in society took disease prevention measures...

Compared with clinicians who only had to face individual patients, those who worked in public health had to face society as a group. Hence, high-ranking doctors were given more room to prove their worth. However, this would give low-ranking doctors nothing but a great wave of depression.
Boredom could be said to be a common complaint among those involved in public health.
In contrast to other low-ranking doctors, Cai Qiong did find the work bearable.
He was not a person who was good with words, to begin with. Of course, he liked to talk. But he actually understood the fact that the more a person spoke, the more mistakes he made.
In the hospital, Cai Qiong actually spent most of his time working hard. It was just that he never failed to let go of any opportunity to speak and offend people.
However, work-wise, people really rarely found fault with Cai Qiong.

This might be attributed to the fact that he was not the kind who bothered with trivial matters. On the other hand, Cai Qiong worked very hard for survival purposes. Hence, even though he was at Chief Physician Li’s disposal right then and had to work on publicizing public health policies, which was a pretty meaningless task, Cai Qiong was still working very earnestly and meticulously. This was to minimize the possibilities of other people finding fault with him.
As for the vacuum-packed biscuits, he was merely trying to save money.

A doctor’s basic pay was not high. Nowadays, there were fewer illegitimate sources of income, and those below the rank of associate chief physician would have to garner the favor of their superiors if they wanted an above-average pay.

To get around this, surgeons carried out more surgeries, while internists took in more patients who were funding their own treatment. This would give them a few thousand extra RMB a month. Basically, the more they worked, the more money they got.

Unfortunately, Cai Qiong never had the opportunity to work more. The only opportunity he ever got was the opportunity to get scolded more. Of course, he always had the chance to carry out miscellaneous tasks. However, he had never gotten the chance to carry out more surgeries or take in more patients.
Truth be told, Cai Qiong was used to earning nothing but his basic pay every month. In this respect, he was basically like a public health specialist.

“Ah, the crumbs fell.” Cai Qiong shoved the rest of the biscuit into his mouth and quickly picked up the crumbs that had fallen onto the table with his fingertips. He licked those crumbs off his fingertips. He then drank another mouthful of concentrated tea and smacked his lips in contentment.
“Ahem.” Chief Physician Li faked a cough to serve as a reminder to Cai Qiong.

Cai Qiong turned to glance at Chief Physician Li. He placed his finger in his mouth and sucked it as he smiled and said, “Hello, Chief Physician Li and Doctor Zuo. Why are both of you here? Have I done something wrong?”
Chief Physician Li sighed and said as he stared at Cai Qiong’s fingertips, “You didn’t do anything wrong. We’re here to ask you out for a meal.”
“I’m not going,” Cai Qiong said without hesitation. “I don’t even know where the chef in the cafeteria came from. He couldn’t even remove the fish scales properly.”

The cafeteria in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch was merely a kitchen that was equipped with cooking utensils and a microwave oven. Its main function was for the medical staff members to heat up their own food. Since there had been a lot of people in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch lately, they hired a temporary chef. However, if a person were to use the name of a place to describe the food made by the chef, “Bazhaixiang” would be perfect.

Zuo Cidian was a very socially adept person, and it only took one glance for him to know what Cai Qiong was thinking about. He spilled the beans. “Doctor Ling will be footing the bill. You won’t need to spend a single penny.”
He would have to pay to eat at the cafeteria. Even though the food in the cafeteria was not expensive, the vacuum-packed biscuits, tea leaves, and hot water provided in the office were all free.

Zuo Cidian could not help but admire Cai Qiong a little when he saw that Cai Qiong had chosen to have vacuum-packed biscuits and tea for lunch. Back when he was still working in a town hospital, even though he jumped at every opportunity to eat free food, he was not this shameless. Hence, he praised Cai Qiong. “Biscuits with concentrated tea might taste better than the food in the cafeteria for real.”

“I know, right? We’re both experienced people.” Cai Qiong laughed out loud, and he could not help but to make another snide remark. “The food in our cafeteria is practically made for pigs. Only idiots would eat there, don’t you think so?”

He had more to say, but he held himself back. However, he had made his point very clear. Chief Physician Li, who was standing beside him, immediately glared at him. Chief Physician Li ate lunch in the cafeteria every day.

“The kitchen cooks separately for us compared to for the others. We’ll be having stewed beef with potatoes. There’ll be a few large pots of it with more than twenty pounds of beef. We’ll even be pairing the dish with rice from the countryside, which isn’t planted using any pesticide or fertilizer at all. Even the oil used to make the stew is from the countryside, extracted the traditional way...” There was a smile on Zuo Cidian’s face. “This is much better than concentrated tea and vacuum-packed biscuits, isn’t it?”

Cai Qiong gulped. “Actually, it wouldn’t do much harm to use some fertilizer or pesticide as long as it’s not over the permitted range, don’t you think so? People in the past used kitchen waste and feces as fertilizer, but the effect doesn’t seem to be better than commercially-produced fertilizer. Don’t people nowadays always say that we must always abstain from using feces as fertilizer? This is because feces might attract parasites... The oil that’s extracted the traditional way isn’t safe either. As doctors, we all know that it’s common for this kind of oil to be high in aflatoxin...”
“We’re almost getting started. Are you coming?” Zuo Cidian asked.
“Yes!” Cai Qiong was practically salivating already. He simply threw his half-eaten vacuum-packed biscuits into the trash can.

Chief Physician Li was exasperated and resigned at the same time when he saw Cai Qiong’s demeanor. He had no choice but to follow Cai Qiong and try to start a conversation with him even though there was nothing to talk about. “Are you done with the copywriting related to health education?”
“Yes. I sent you an email.”
“Alright, then. I’ll check it out later.”
Cai Qiong smiled. “There’s no rush. All the printing shops are closed right now, anyway. It’s not like there’s any place where we can conduct health education at the moment, either.”

“Still, you should get everything prepared beforehand. Also, it is a must for us to start a fever clinic.” As Chief Physician Li spoke, he looked at Zuo Cidian and asked with a smile. “What does Doctor Ling...”
“Doctor Ling supports your efforts very much,” Zuo Cidian answered without hesitation.
“That’s great.” Chief Physician Li was not surprised.

Under normal circumstances, small clinics like the fever clinic would be under the jurisdiction of the Emergency Department, and those responsible for public health would merely play a supervisory role. However, in a place like Bazhaixiang hospital branch, Chief Physician Li intended to up his game.

He was worried that the people from the Emergency Department of Yun Hua Hospital would treat the fever clinic as their territory. If this were to happen, Chief Physician Li would have no choice but to start a gastrointestinal clinic. The gastrointestinal clinic was supposed to be the territory of the General Surgery Department. Besides, working on it would take plenty of time with lackluster results. It would also be harder to promote a gastrointestinal clinic compared to a fever clinic.

“Doctor Cai, you’ll become even busier after we start the fever clinic. But after the roads are usable, things will become easier for you. When that happens, I’ll hire some men to help you out.” Chief Physician Li started planning things.
Cai Qiong smiled and simply replied with a snide remark. “After the roads are usable, I probably won’t be of much use anymore.”
“Hey, let’s head to the table and eat.” Zuo Cidian quickly cut Cai Qiong off and led everyone into the dining room.
The moment Cai Qiong entered the dining room, he saw the handsome Ling Ran sitting under the lamp.
Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile, and Cai Qiong and Chief Physician Li actually felt honored because of it.
“Since everyone’s here, let’s start eating,” Ling Ran said and tapped his stomach. He was hungry.
This action might look improper if someone else were to do it. But no matter what Ling Ran did, he still looked handsome.
Tian Qi clapped softly, and a few chefs who were wearing snow-white chefs’ uniform, snow-white toques and snow-white gloves walked in. They were holding metal pots as they walked over in a line.

Cai Qiong lowered his head to look at the large white coat he had been using as a jacket for the past few days. It was covered in stains. He took a deep breath. The stewed beef with potatoes smelled really good.

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Holding Themselves Back
paragraphs: “Beef from Bazhaixiang actually tastes pretty good. There were even people who deliberately came over to Bazhaixiang to purchase beef.” As a Bazhaixiang local, Xiang Xueming attended to everyone with enthusiasm.

His colleague, though, looked a little diffident. Even though he was older than Xiang Xueming, his hands trembled whenever he held a wine glass. It seemed that he was not well-developed when it came to social skills.
Ling Ran was not a drinker, so he merely smiled. The middle-aged doctor from Bazhaixiang immediately understood what he meant. He flashed a smile at Ling Ran.
“Doctor Ling, here’s a slice of beef brisket.” Tian Qi enthusiastically grabbed a slice of beef brisket for Ling Ran with a pair of chopsticks like it was the most natural thing in the world to do.

The servants from the Tian family, who were standing on both sides of Tian Qi, were astonished when they saw what their young mistress was doing. They immediately understood what was going on in Tian Qi’s mind. A few of them even stepped forward and were about to stop her from grabbing food for Ling Ran. However, they held themselves back.
“Hm, go ahead and grab one for yourself too,” Ling Ran said with a smile before he shoved the entire slice of beef brisket into his mouth and started chewing it.

Tian Qi smiled so brightly that her eyes were narrowed to slits. She grabbed a slice of beef with an equal amount of fats and lean meat. She fanned it with her palm to cool it down before shoving it into her mouth.
“How about some potatoes?” Tian Qi placed a slice of potato in Ling Ran’s bowl.
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment. He then grabbed a ladle and asked, “Do you want some broth to go with your rice?”
“Sure,” Tian Qi said. However, as she caressed her belly with her hand, she worriedly added, “I’ll eat less rice. I’m worried that I’ll get fat.”
Ling Ran glanced at her and said, “You have good body proportions and an adequate amount of muscles. It won’t be a problem for you to eat more...”
Tian Qi did not finish listening to what Ling Ran was saying at all. Her heart erupted with joy only after hearing the first part.

Zuo Cidian deliberately arranged for Cai Qiong to be seated away from Ling Ran. Cai Qiong snuck a few glances at Ling Ran and Tian Qi. He then lowered his head and started eating without looking around.

Zuo Cidian was sitting at the same table as Cai Qiong as he attended to everyone. Even though he was curious about what was on Cai Qiong’s mind, he did not dare to ask as he was worried that Cai Qiong would say something strange.

The atmosphere at the main table was pretty good, though. Even though Ling Ran did not like to chit-chat, the two chief physicians from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital knew each other. Aside from this, they were accompanied by several pharmaceutical sales representatives who were good with words. The food was also good, and everyone soon got into a good mood.

Of course, the reason behind it was also because the two chief physicians form Yun Hua Provincial Hospital had not been flattered much lately. They had to face Cai Qiong, who was only good at making snide remarks, all day. They would take a pharmaceutical sales representative who was not good with words over Cai Qiong any day.

Everyone had a great meal, and toward the end, the two chief physicians from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital were still in the mood to have fun. Hence, they invited everyone out with enthusiasm. “I heard that the karaoke place in Bazhaixiang is open for business again. Why don’t we head over and sing a few songs? Doctor Ling, do you like to sing?”
Ling Ran was surprised as he looked at the other party. He then shook his head gently. “I have an operation scheduled for the afternoon.”

“Ah, you have to operate on a patient in the afternoon?” Chief Physician Li already knew about it, but he still uttered the question. He was tipsy from the alcohol, and he asked with a smile, “Aside from working hard, you should also get enough rest. If it’s not a major surgery, why don’t you let one of your subordinates take over?”
Ling Ran merely smiled without saying anything.
“Doctor Ling will be performing hepatectomy in the afternoon,” Lu Wenbin, who was sitting beside Ling Ran said.
Associate Chief Physician Deng immediately furrowed his eyebrows. “Hepatectomy? This afternoon?”

“Yes,” Lu Wenbin answered without missing a beat. “Residents of Bazhaixiang rarely seek treatment, but there are actually a lot of patients who are suffering from hepatolithiasis. We’ve operated on a few of them before this, and all of them are discharged now. The fact that they can receive hepatectomy here spread by word of mouth, and they can get reimbursement for most of the fee too. Hence, many of them have come over for hepatectomy.”

Both Associate Chief Physician Deng as well as Chief Physician Li, who was sitting beside him, were speechless. Why did they come to the Bazhaixiang hospital branch? It was because they were incapable of performing hepatectomy even though there were patients who wanted it done.
Even though it was mainly because of reasons such as the lack of equipment, at the end of the day, it was because they were not confident enough.

If they had the confidence to perform hepatectomy as long as there were adequate facilities, they would not have to go through the trouble of transporting patients using a helicopter. Take Ling Ran as an example. Even though Yunli Medical Company helped him out by swiftly transporting a full set of brand new medical equipment, he was only able to do this because Department Director Huo gave him the green light.

Associate Chief Physician Deng, Chief Physician Li, and the specialists from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital’s General Surgery Department, who were still stationed in village hospitals, did not dare to guarantee their success in a complicated surgery like hepatectomy. As a result, they had to go through a tedious process. They had to obtain the patients’ agreement and try to transport them to the Bazhaixiang hospital branch before transferring them to Yun Hua Provincial Hospital...

If they were given a choice, they would rather fork out money from their own pockets—of course, not. It would be best if the hospital were to foot the bill and transport the equipment over. That way, they would even be able to perform more than one hepatectomy just like what Ling Ran was doing right now...
“You’ve done a few hepatectomies here?” Chief Physician Li pretended that he was concerned, but he was actually a little jealous.

When Lu Wenbin saw that the doctor from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital was shamelessly asking the question, he immediately said with pride. “Up until today, we have operated on five patients. From today onwards, Doctor Ling plans to carry out two hepatectomies a day.”

“That’s great.” Even though Chief Physician Li was rather old and was involved in public health right now, he was still jealous. Projects related to public health were tremendously troublesome and complicated. Even though he had just gotten started, he was already facing his first obstacle—an idiotic subordinate... Compared to being involved in public health, a news headline like “Yun Hua Provincial Hospital Performed Six Major Surgeries as Part of Their Rescue Efforts in Bazhaixiang” sounded much better.

The two chief physicians from the General Surgery Department, who were pretty much drunk, were suddenly not in the mood for a karaoke session anymore. They felt just like two students who were asking a third student out for some fun when they realized that the other party had completed a lot of exercise books and mock exam papers.

Chief Physician Li spent a shorter time recovering from the shock. He grabbed his glass and finished the liquor inside. He then smiled, flashing his teeth, and said, “I always say that people are not stupid. The people in Bazhaixiang are extremely clever. By seeking out Doctor Ling, they’re practically seeking treatment from the doctor who is the best at hepatectomy in the entire province. Moreover, they do not have to spend much on it. The patients in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch can probably get an 80% reimbursement, can’t they?”
“Most of them can get an 80% reimbursement. However, they still need to pay for some of the drugs,” Xiang Xueming answered.
Lu Wenbin chipped in, “Due to the situation right now, we can’t bill patients for many of the drugs. So the total cost at the end of the day is pretty high when we treat these patients.”

“Doctor Ling is such a kind-hearted doctor.” Since it never hurt anyone to say a few kind words, Associate Chief Physician Deng immediately complimented Ling Ran. He then changed the topic. “Doctor Ling, if you’re not able to handle everything, I can help out since I’ll be in Bazhaixiang for a few more days. I don’t really have anything urgent to attend to either...”

“The greatest limitation right now is the number of operating theaters. We’re not actually lacking in manpower.” Zuo Cidian walked over when he heard the conversation. He chipped in as he stood beside Ling Ran. He then continued with a smile, “Chief Physician Li, please don’t fight for opportunities with junior doctors like me. We came all the way here to Bazhaixiang, and it would be sad if we don’t even get the opportunity to operate on patients here.”

As Associate Chief Physician Deng gazed at Zuo Cidian’s wrinkled face, he could not help but mutter internally, ‘Junior doctor, seriously?’ He then raised his head and faked a smile. “Alright, you guys can have all of the patients...”

He was an associate chief physician from Yun Hua Provincial Hospital, and he was not shameless enough to fight for opportunities with a group of resident doctors and attending physicians no matter how attractive those opportunities were.
“If you guys get too busy, I’m here to help,” Associate Chief Physician Deng said.
Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin smiled in unison.

After the meal, there was a tacit agreement between everyone to stop coming up with suggestions to have fun such as going for karaoke. The drunk Associate Chief Physician Deng and Chief Physician Li decided to follow Ling Ran when they saw him heading to the operating theater.
They wondered how a hepatectomy carried out under such conditions would turn out.

chapters.title: Chapter 869: Support
paragraphs: “Chief physician and associate chief physician, please come over here to take a shower and change your outfits. The shower facilities are all new.” The circulating nurse stood at the entrance of the surgical corridor. There was no emotion shown on her face.

“So, what you mean is we have to shower first before entering the operating theater?” Associate Chief Physician Deng was blocked, so he did not feel quite happy. He had also drunk a little, so his tone was not friendly.

The circulating nurse that day was Nurse Liu, the supervisor nurse. During mealtime, she saw that the chief physician and associate chief physician from the provincial hospital had drunk a little wine, and she knew the mission would be complicated. At this time, she stood at the front and did her official business according to official principles. She said, “Whenever you leave the Operating Area, you need to shower if you want to enter again. The hospital environment in Bazhaixiang is complex, so we need to take more things into consideration, please understand.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng was a little drunk, and he was unhappy while saying, “What’s so complex...”

Chief Physician Li did not drink a lot, and he was rather old. He interrupted Associate Chief Physician Deng and advised him, “Old Deng, it isn’t something bad to take a shower. They treated us to meals and drinks, now, they’re treating us to a shower again. Are you not satisfied with this one-stop service?”
Associate Chief Physician Deng had been a surgeon for a long time, so he was experienced in making dirty jokes. “Showering alone is not considered a one-stop service.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng looked at Nurse Liu once he finished talking.
Nurse Liu was calm. “If both of you want to take a shower together, I can pretend I didn’t see you.”
Associate Chief Physician Deng changed his facial expression instantly. Before he could scold her, he was stopped by Chief Physician Li.

“We are now in the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. It’s good to take a shower. Come, I’ll scrub your back for you.” Chief Physician Li showed a smile on his face as he pulled Associate Chief Physician Deng along with him.
Associate Chief Physician Deng swayed a little, and his voice was also quivering, “No, I will shower alone.”
“How boring it’d be if you showered alone?”
“But I can’t shower with you.”

“Oh come now, back in the days, all of us showered together at the big bathhouse in the hospital. I’ll scrub your back for you, and you did the same for me. We’ve been here for a few days, and I’ve been suffering from walking on all the muddy roads...”
“Be good.”
Two of them talked while walking ahead. As they walked further, their voices became more blurry, as if the sounds were transmitted from the bathroom.

Cai Qiong walked out from the back. Now that he was full, he felt slightly lazy, but he still continued chatting, “Seriously, he’s been an associate chief physician for so long, and he also drank a little. Now, everyone’s an eyesore in his eyes...”
Nurse Liu blocked him with a schooled expression and said, “There aren’t any places inside now. Please wait for a while.”
“I still have to wait...? Alright, it’s just two places. How did Doctor Ling and his assistants finish bathing so fast?” There was a scrutinizing look in Cai Qiong’s eyes.
Nurse Liu’s face finally showed a smile. “The assistants are inside. Doctor Ling has his own shower room.”
“His own? In Bazhaixiang?” Cai Qiong was shocked.

“It’s built spontaneously, so it did not cost much money. The workers set up the new shower facility, then built in hot water and cold water. It’ll be considered ready for use by then,” Nurse Liu deliberately explained. Then, she said, “Its basic conditions are not even comparable to his original shower room.”
Cai Qiong clicked his tongue. “My chief physician and associate chief physician don’t even have their own shower room.”
Nurse Liu’s smile was even more profound than before.

Cai Qiong’s mouth started running off on his own again, “Well, nobody will want to look when our chief physician and associate chief physician bathe, but everyone wants to see Doctor Ling when he showers, no matter where he is.”
Nurse Liu made a light nasal sound.
“Did you snorted just now? Was I correct? Am I right or am I right?” Cai Qiong’s mouth spoke so quickly that he fired three questions in a row.
“You can take the scrubs and slippers first. New slippers are available. If you will use it often, you can put your name on it.” Nurse Liu waved her hand to chase Cai Qiong away.
Although Cai Qiong was not young, he did not have any impact with his position as a senior attending physician from another hospital.
Cai Qiong also knew it, so he stood aside in a show of alertness. He then quietly looked at the time while counting how long it took for the chief physician and associate chief physician to shower.
And he waited for a very long time...
In the operating theater, the X-ray films and CT scan films were placed at the other end of the operating table according to Ling Ran’s habit.
Associate Chief Physician Deng and Chief Physician Li entered the operating theater side by side, then they saw those scans, which were simultaneously familiar and unfamiliar to them.

“Did you take these scans?” Associate Chief Physician Deng immediately walked over and stared at the scans. He felt a sense of familiarity when he looked at the CT scans, but the next second, he doubtfully asked, “Did Cangping District Hospital deploy a CT scan machine to the branch?”

“It’s a portable CT scan machine. Yunli Medical Company provided it for trial use, so it’s considered a part of the emergency rescue,” Yu Yuan answered with a smile. When she stood on a stepping stool, she could convey her emotions through her expressions pretty well.

The chief physician and associate chief physician duo had long baths earlier, and their heads were clear now. Associate Chief Physician Deng found himself stuttering, “Port-Portable CT scan machine? So generous?”

“Yes, it’s the latest version of 32-slice NeuroLogica’s BodyTom®. It has its own medical record writing system, although it’s not so useful. Oh yea, there’s also standard lead shielding...” Yu Yuan was quite fond of advanced medical equipment, so she sounded quite arrogant.

Associate Chief Physician Deng obediently nodded. A CT scan machine itself was an expensive piece of equipment that cost around ten million, and there was not even a need to mention just how much portable CT scan machines cost. At the very least, they cost tens of millions. If they wanted to sign for a long-term service agreement, Associate Chief Physician Deng would not feel strange if that contract cost more than one hundred million.
Meanwhile, in the hospital environment, if such a huge sales deal had to be made, an unknown number of people would definitely be involved to compete for it.
As he looked at the CT scan films in front of him, Associate Chief Physician Deng felt like he saw many doctors like Cai Qiong being abandoned outside the hospital like the lackeys they were...
How could Associate Chief Physician Deng not feel admiration for such a luxurious CT scanner and surgery?
“With the assistance of this portable CT scan machine, you’ve pretty much gained extra strength, Doctor Ling,” Associate Chief Physician Deng chuckled and said something nice.

Chief Physician Li seriously nodded. “This is the first portable CT scan machine in Changxi Province, right? Where is the machine? I haven’t taken a look at it yet. Oh, how was it sent over? Was it conveyed by a helicopter? It should be quite heavy, right?”
“As long as you work hard, you can achieve anything.” Associate Chief Physician Deng chuckled again. He dared not think about the transportation cost for such an expensive thing.

Ling Ran was performing the surgery, and he did not join the discussion. It was still Yu Yuan who answered while performing high-level retraction, “This BodyTom® belongs to Yunli Medical Company, we just borrowed from them. It needs to be returned after we finish using it.”
“Then, Yunli Medical Company will sell it like a new one? That’s not very good, right?”
“This BodyTom® is a financial asset of Yunli Medical Company. It’s a product of financing leasing.” Mai Chun stood at a corner, and she spoke weakly.

“Oh... Yunli Medical Company’s business has grown so much,” Associate Chief Physician Deng said, and he was struck with awe. As someone working in the hospital, he knew how hard it was for a pharmaceutical sales company to conduct business, and he also knew how high the cost was to make a financing leasing.
If many medical companies that specialized in medical equipment could grow very fast and smoothly after their startup, then the financial leasing for medical equipment business would be even riskier.
Associate Chief Physician Deng even felt his teeth aching at the thought of the cost when he thought about it.
Let’s watch the surgery.” Chief Physician Li also felt the same, but he had long since made himself aloof to worldly matters, so he felt slightly better.
Associate Chief Physician Deng shrugged. When he wanted to say something, his phone rang.
“Excuse me.” Associate Chief Physician Deng walked to a corner to pick up the call.
After a moment, Associate Chief Physician Deng put down his phone, went back to the operating table, looked at Ling Ran, and asked, “Doctor Ling, you know Wei Jiayou, right?”
“Who?” Ling Ran frowned, but it was because he was stripping the patient’s portal vein.

“Wei Jiayou. He specializes in cardiovascular surgeries. He’s Academician Di’s student, and he also likes abdominoscopy...” Associate Chief Physician Deng described him and said, “He said that’s coming to support the Bazhaixiang hospital branch on behalf of Academician Di.”
“Oh,” Ling Ran answered.
Yu Yuan introduced Wei Jiayou again from the side. “He’s the ginseng baby, the one who likes to wear the ginseng scent.”
“Oh...” Ling Ran said with a drawl this time and nodded.
