Then, she walked out of the partitioned room. The executives in the meeting room all looked to Tian Qi.
“Carry on.” Tian Qi waved her hand and sat in her chair again.
The meeting resumed, and everyone became tense but lively again.
At Yun Hua Hospital, Ling Ran put his phone down, relieved.

If he were asked to perform surgery, he was still very confident that he could succeed and was willing to perform it. However, when it was about the financial problems of the patient’s family, he was completely lost.
Zuo Cidian sat beside him. He watched Ling Ran put down his phone, then looked at Ling Ran with eyes filled with emotions.
Ling Ran looked at Zuo Cidian.
Zuo Cidian said in a low voice, “Um... Doctor Ling, I accidentally heard that she said a post with an annual salary of 1,000,000 RMB?”
Ling Ran nodded.

“That’s too much. They don’t need that.” Zuo Cidian gasped in admiration and said, “A job with a slightly higher monthly salary and a more flexible schedule will help them a lot. There’s no need for them to have such a high salary.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran gave a noncommittal reply.

“It’d be troublesome if their salary is too high. Let me think about it.” As Zuo Cidian said this, he raised his head and looked around before he said in a low voice again, “That job for 1,000,000 RMB doesn’t require them to sell their kidneys, right? If it’s not a job that sells kidneys or makes the workers hold their back urine, I think I can take up the job too.”

The phone call was from Ling Ran.

Tian Qi immediately screenshot the image of Ling Ran’s call for her.
Then, she could not help but look worried.

chapters.title: Chapter 890: By the Side
paragraphs: [Mission: Cure the Patient]
[Mission Details: Cure Xue Guixiao, retain his self-care skills, and let him live with dignity.]
[Reward: Right Hemicolectomy (Master Level)]

Ling Ran chose right hemicolectomy from the mission prompt. There was no special reason for it. Right hemicolectomy could be used to treat the appendix, whereas left hemicolectomy could be used to cut the sigmoid colon. Ling Ran did not want to cut either, so he randomly made a choice.
The mission prompt reminded Ling Ran of something. It made him naturally turn toward the ward in the General Surgery Department.
Xue Guixiao had been transferred from the special care unit to the general ward.
He was placed in a four-person room with an attached bathroom in the ward. The environment could not be considered very good, but the hygienic condition was not bad.

When Ling Ran entered the room, he saw Xue Guixiao half-reclining against his bed and boasting to another patient. “You can’t wait when you meet an important person, understand? You need to take more initiatives, just like me. In my twenties, I prayed when I came upon a mountain and donated when I saw a temple, but my partner was most displeased. Now... Of course, I don’t want to tell her now, but when I meet her, I must talk to her properly...”

“You’ve prayed for twenty years, and you only met one important person? It’s not worthy, right?” An old man who looked like a cadre sat at the corner of the ward and frowned as he heard this, so he deliberately said, “If you have prayed for twenty years, you should have at least prayed to the point that you turned into an important person, right?”
Xue Guixiao did not like this man, so he ignored him. “As long as my son treats me well, then it’ll be alright. Who knows what will happen in the future?”
Among the four patients in the room, Xue Guixiao’s son came the most frequently, so other people could not pick any fault in it.

The old cadre only smiled and said, “Honestly, the job your son found is to deliver goods to others and escort other delivery trucks, right? The salary is quite high, but the job is exhausting. If I really want to, I can get one too.”
“If you can get one, why are you still staying in the same room as me?” Xue Guixiao became unhappy, so he sounded meaner.

The cadre burst out in laughter. “In a place like Yun Hua Hospital, it’s enough for a general civil servant like me to stay in the general ward. I don’t need to cause trouble about it. This is totally different from looking for a job.”
When he said this, he looked at the door and saw Ling Ran.
He did not know Ling Ran, but when he saw him in his white coat, he did not say anything. He just quietly stared at Ling Ran.
“Doctor Ling.” When Xue Guixiao looked over, he instantly became excited, and he quickly said, “Doctor Ling, I was thinking about when I should visit you and thank you for your help...”
Compared to before, Xue Guixiao’s attitude was much better now. Perhaps it was because Zuo Cidian boasted about Ling Ran too much, and the job Xue Guixiao got was also because of Ling Ran.
Ling Ran did not reject his gratitude, yet he did not admit to it. He just said, “How’s your recovery? I’ll perform a physical examination for you.”

“I’m in great health,” Xue Guixiao quickly answered before he continued, “At that time, Director Liu also said that it’s you who looked for the director of their company and arranged a job for my son. My son works very seriously, so please rest assured... Sigh, there are still many good people in the world...”

“Please lay down properly.” At that moment, Ling Ran felt slightly regretful that he did not bring anyone along, especially when the patients’ families surrounded him. Ling Ran felt extremely stressed when he sensed the need for him to communicate with these people.
Ling Ran’s fingers moved away from the wound, and he pressed lightly against a spot while he asked, “How do you feel these days? Is your wound hurting you?”

“It was slightly uncomfortable and itchy yesterday, but I feel better today. The nurse who changed my dressing was also very careful...” When Xue Guixiao answered, he lowered his voice and said, “um... Doctor Ling, my son says that the hospital bill can be claimed from the medical insurance of his company. Is it full coverage?”
“I don’t know about the exact situation.” Ling Ran thought for a while before he answered, “If Zuo Cidian told you so, that should be it.”
Xue Cuixiao instantly felt relieved. He laid on the bed without moving and allowed Ling Ran to perform the physical examination on him.

When the examination ended, Xue Guixiao coughed and said, “Doctor Ling, um... I have a few relatives in my hometown who don’t have much money to go to a doctor, so can I bring them over for you to take a look...?”
Ling Ran gave him a puzzled glance before he asked, “What illness?”
Xue Guixiao laughed and said, “It’s not about the illness, it’s mainly because they don’t have money.”
Ling Ran stared at him for two seconds before he asked, “Why do they need money?”
Xue Guixiao said, “To... see a doctor...”
“What illness?” Ling Ran repeated.

Xue Guixiao was stunned by Ling Ran’s “strict” logic for a few seconds before he answered, “They do not have any serious illnesses. They just have chronic illnesses like stomach ulcers, enteritis, and heart disease...”

“Currently, I’m the best at hepatectomy, followed by appendectomy, splenectomy, Achilles tendon repair, and finger replantation. It’ll only be suitable for them to come to me if they need treatment in this area.” Ling Ran’s answer was direct yet confusing as usual.
Xue Guixiao did not know what to say for a moment.
“Doctor Ling, let us take over the remaining work.” A doctor from the General Surgery Department entered the room to solve the problem.
Ling Ran nodded. Then, he stood up with natural grace and left the room.
Two doctors of the General Surgery Department followed him tightly.

It was slightly weird for a doctor from the Emergency Medical Center to come to the ward of the General Surgery Department for a ward round. After all, the General Surgery Department was not a place like the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, so it was impossible for them to let anyone come and go as they please.
The doctors of the General Surgery Department stared at Ling Ran sternly.

“Doctor Ling, you should not repeatedly give free treatment to patients. You can’t take care of their entire family either.” The attending physician from the General Surgery Department talked as if he was experienced and acted like he was giving Ling Ran a lecture.

Xue Guixiao’s case was not a secret to the doctors in the General Surgery Department, or rather, it should be said that any doctor might harbor sympathy at certain periods of time, but the frequency in which it occurred was different, and the intensity of their sympathy shown was also different.

The attending physician from the General Surgery Department had been hearing compliments about Ling Ran over the past few days. Although there were constantly young nurses who would praise Ling Ran at random like they were some rabid fangirl, the frequency in which this happened over the past few days was a little too high.
If the situation called for it, the attending physician might even have to criticize Ling Ran a little.
However, Ling Ran seriously thought about it for a few seconds before he said, “Xue Guixiao only introduced a few relatives over. He did not ask me to take care of his whole family.”
“This is something you can conclude through some basic analysis, right? He won’t just ask you to take care of his entire family in the future, his family and friends will all come to you.”
Yet Ling Ran shook his head.
“Do you not believe me?” The attending physician raised an eyebrow.
Ling Ran smiled.

“When you experience more, you will know that there are many kinds of patients.” The attending physician sighed. No one knew whether he was sighing about the world or whether it was because Ling Ran refused to cooperate with him.
Ling Ran still smiled calmly. “I’ll handle my patients first.”
The attending physician said, “There will be a time where you can’t take care of everyone.”
Ling Ran lowered his voice and said, “We’ll talk about it when I really can’t take care of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 891: Switch People
paragraphs: “Handle the discharge process for Bed 12.”
“Go and ask for the MRI scan of Bed 35 for Doctor Ling’s surgery in the afternoon.”
“Doctor Yu, that child said he felt nauseous and vomited.”
Ling Ran was walking leisurely in the treatment room of the Emergency Medical Center. He found himself adapting very well to the noisy surroundings.

Bazhaixiang branch hospital was too small. Not only did it not have enough operating theaters and hospital beds, it also did not have enough staff for medical lab tests, nor enough medical imaging equipment. They also had few patients, and their disease sources were scarce as well.

All he saw while he was there were the same common diseases. Furthermore, due to the large number of doctors compared to patients, the prognosis for patients and nursing care was no longer interesting.
After returning to Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center and listening to the surrounding noise, Ling Ran could truly feel that he was more needed by the patients over here...
“The child who was nauseous and vomited did not go to the toilet for the past two days.” Ling Ran reminded Yu Yuan when he saw Yu Yuan frowning and was prepared to follow the nurse to the ward.
Yu Yuan was stunned for a while and immediately thought of something. She told the nurse beside her, “Could you get a bottle of glycerine enema as well.”

After working so long in the emergency room, Ling Ran had gradually gained some experience in handling normal diseases. Most importantly, he had always paid attention to the symptoms of the patients from the moment they were admitted to the moment they were discharged. Hence, he knew their diseases when he heard of them. For example, when he heard of the case of the child vomiting today, he immediately thought of constipation.
Symptoms of constipation in children might be abdominal pain or vomiting.
Yu Yuan was too busy. After she was reminded of this by Ling Ran, she suddenly realized what was going on and immediately came up with a solution.
The nurse accepted her order and went to collect the medicine, whereas Ling Ran still wandered around the treatment room.
He did not have other surgeries for today.

Ling Ran had just come back from Bazhaixiang, and he had not performed any consultations yet. The transferred cases from other departments and the random cases in the Emergency Medical Center could not sustain his daily surgery volume.
In fact, Ling Ran only used one morning to finish all the hepatectomy patients accumulated yesterday. Then, he could only hang around in the treatment room and observation room.

The young doctors might still have medical records to write or have patients whom they needed to be in charge of. But at Ling Ran’s level, if he did not go for freelance surgery or was packed with surgeries, he actually had nothing much to do.
In short, he was successful now.

Certainly, he was only successful in a tertiary Grade A hospital, or rather, he was successful in a tertiary Grade A hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, which was considered the best in the region. If he had a greater goal of getting promoted or hoping to get the title of an academician title from the Chinese Academy of Engineering, he needed to put in more effort and did more things on the research side.

“Ling Ran, come, come, come...” Doctor Zhou started to perform consultations when he saw that Ling Ran was here. After the patient’s family members paid the fees and the patients sat at the front, Doctor Zhou acted as though he just saw Ling Ran and shouted at him.
Ling Ran took a few brisk steps and came before Doctor Zhou.
“The young man injured himself while skateboarding. Do you want to suture it?” Doctor Zhou grinned and stood up.

A boy who seemed to be in high school sat in front of him. He had many bruises on his face and arms. His worst injuries were the helix of his ear and his chin, which were lacerated. If he looked carefully, the patient was basically disfigured.

Of course, the patient only looked rather pathetic. Based on how well a normal person could recover, as long the two wounds were properly sutured and the lacerations healed, at most, only a few faint lines would remain.
Ling Ran had the urge to perform a surgery too. When he saw Doctor Zhou giving up his space for him, he said, “Wait for me to wash my hands.”
“Okay, I’ll wait for you.” Doctor Zhou smiled like a doting parent. “Come back soon. I’ll occupy this sport for you. You poor thing, after walking around, no one gave up a space for you.”
Ling Ran replied with a smile. From a certain aspect, Doctor Zhou could be considered as his favorite doctor.
A while later, Ling Ran washed his hands. He held his hands away from his chest and came back.

Doctor Zhou had spread out all the instruments in the small cubicle of the treatment room. In fact, the high school student’s face was also wiped cleanly, all that was left was for Ling Ran to suture his face.
Ling Ran took a deep breath and added two more marks for Doctor Zhou.
As a doctor, the most important part was being meticulous.
“Let’s use the 6-0 surgical silk suture.” Ling Ran put on gloves and gave an order to the young nurse beside him.
“Excuse me... Which doctor will be performing the suture?” The patient’s mother who sat at the corner stared at Ling Ran and seemed reluctant to let Ling Ran perform the suturing.
Doctor Zhou immediately understood and said, “Doctor Ling is a well known doctor in our hospital, and his suturing skills are among the top.”
The patient’s mother looked at Doctor Zhou, then looked at Ling Ran before she whispered, “Too young.”
“It’s just suturing. What does it have to do with age?” Doctor Zhou smiled.
The patient’s mother became stern. “The wounds are on the face. The results will last for life. Please... Doctor Zhou, can you perform his suture?”
Doctor Zhou did not know whether he wanted to laugh or cry. “But Doctor Ling truly has the best suturing skills.”
The mother still felt doubt, and she hesitated for a few seconds before she insisted. “Doctor Zhou, please do the suturing.”
“I...” Doctor Zhou sighed. “Doctor Ling truly does a better job. If you don’t believe me, I can perform the sutures as well.”
The mother shook her head seriously and looked at Doctor Zhou.
“Do you really want me to perform the suture?” Doctor Zhou felt resigned.
The patient’s mother nodded.

Although their rules and regulations did not allow patients the authority to choose their doctors, under current circumstances, it was pointless to keep going against the will of the patient’s family member. If it were not handled well, they might receive complaints. Why should they go through that sort of torment?
Ling Ran did not think too much about it and said, “Doctor Zhou, it’s okay for you to do the suturing.”

“Okay. Then, I’ll do it. But since you’ve already washed your hands, you might as well give me some instructions.” Doctor Zhou mediated the situation with a silver tongue. He extended his hands and said, “Give me the 5-0 surgical silk suture.”
The 5-0 surgical silk suture was thicker than the 6-0 surgical silk suture. However, it was much easier to use.
While Ling Ran could easily use the 6-0 surgical silk suture to suture, Doctor Zhou had even a difficult time using even the 5-0 surgical silk sutures.
The nurse quietly took out an absorbable 5-0 surgical silk suture and fixed it on a needle holder.
The patient’s family watched by the side, and a smile could be seen on their faces.
Then, Doctor Zhou injected anesthetic, waited for a moment, took the needle holder, and started to suture.

“Doctor Ling, should I start from here?” Doctor Zhou was naturally very experienced in suturing the face, but he did not have many chances to learn. He only ever had the chance of watching other doctors perform sutures on the face, then try it on his own before he formed a conclusion based on his experience.
In short, doctors who had become attending physicians would have long since mastered suturing skills because they had become familiar with it.
However, for a normal doctor, in order to achieve Ling Ran’s suturing level, practice was not enough. At the very least, they would not be able to reach his level just by practicing blindly.
Doctor Zhou lost his chance to be lazy, so he decided to learn from Ling Ran while Ling Ran was beside him.

Ling Ran did not think too much about it. He went straight to teaching mode and said, “The wound is quite deep. I suggest pushing the needle into the reticular layer and pulling it out of the papillary region. If you do this, you can tie a knot at the reticular layer, and you won’t form scar tissue so easily.
Doctor Zhou kept nodding his head. “In this case, it’ll also be easy to close the epidermis.”
“Yes.”
“Do I use subcuticular suture over here?”
“Yes. Just tie a knot at the cut. The epidermis does not require suturing. This way, the scar resulting from natural healing will be even smaller.”
“Can I enter the needle like this?”
“Okay, it will be better to make it deeper...”
Ling Ran instructed Doctor Zhou. One of them spoke while the other performed the suture. Very soon, the two wounds were sutured.
The patient’s family watched by the side, and they had no idea whether they should talk or not.
“It’s done. Go back and rest. Avoid touching water...” Doctor Zhou was a bit excited, since he had sutured the wounds right from the start to the end and performed the dressing on his own as well.
For him, this was a very rare suturing experience.
“There shouldn’t be... any scar, right?” The patient’s mother was not too sure.

“It’s impossible for you to not have any scars, but it won’t be too deep. At his age, the scar will gradually fade away as well.” Doctor Zhou encouraged the patient’s family members and sent them out from the cubicle.
Before the patient’s mother left, she looked at Ling Ran firmly and looked at Doctor Zhou. She hesitated, but did not say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 892: Not Necessary
paragraphs: “I have to say. I had a good feeling about the intradermal suture I performed just now,” Doctor Zhou suddenly said after he returned to his place and thought about it.
Ling Ran nodded and said, “You really did a great job.”
With Ling Ran’s judgment, Doctor Zhou’s intradermal suture skill was at an advanced Specialist Level. Although he was still a distance away from Master Level, he had done a great job.
This was especially so after considering the fact that Doctor Zhou had not performed many intradermal sutures in the past. Doctor Zhou could be classified as a talented individual among surgeons.
Doctor Zhou also smiled and said, “I still remember that a few years ago, it was me who said ‘Well done’ to you.”
Ling Ran smiled and nodded.

“Unfortunately, there are no longer any suitable patients. If not, I would really want to perform another case.” Doctor Zhou was impressed and said, “With someone guiding me, it’s like a coach outside telling me how to play basketball. It’s a pretty great feeling... Sigh, why aren’t there any patients today?”
He repeated his words, and perhaps, he truly had the feeling that he had a coach guiding him.
Ling Ran remained smiling.

Doctor Zhou completed the intradermal suture as the patient’s family members who doubted him, Ling Ran, and other medical staff watched on. His condition was really good at that time, but that did not mean that his good performance could remain consistent until the end.

Miao Tansheng from Lower Groove Clinic had been learning intradermal suture for more than one year, but he had not reached Master Level even now. So, Doctor Zhou probably would not learn faster than Miao Tansheng, since he was lazy and had a lot more work compared to Miao Tansheng.

Doctor Zhou knew about his skills. He felt diffident when he saw Ling Ran’s smile. He could not help but say, “I’m not just rambling off. When I held the needle and prodded the kid’s skin, I really felt excited...”
The young nurse at the side stared at Doctor Zhou with a strange look.
At this moment, the nurse from the reception desk ran over.

“Doctor Zhou, they just wheeled in a car accident victim. Open fracture, massive blood loss, and the patient is forty five years old...” The reception desk nurse immediately reported. Doctor Zhou had the highest rank in the emergency room as of right now. So, those serious cases needed to be reported to him first.
“The patient did not have circulatory collapse, right?” Doctor Zhou looked quite serious.
The reception desk nurse looked at the list and said, “The patient is still conscious.”
“Oh,” Doctor Zhou replied and said, “Doctor Ling, are you interested in taking this case?”
“Sure.” Ling Ran would never turn down any offer.

“If Doctor Ling handles this, I’m not needed.” Doctor Zhou smiled in a carefree manner. “I’ll be reading up for a bit. There’s too much new research going on. If I’m careless for even a day, I’d feel like a relic of the past. Seriously, the things nowadays...”
The reception desk nurse could not hold it anymore. “Doctor Zhou, you just complained about our lack of patients...”

“That was just a passing remark. Furthermore, such a case must undergo surgery immediately. I won’t have any chance in performing intradermal surgery,” Doctor Zhou replied naturally. He stretched his back and said, “Doctor Ling just came back from Bazhaixiang, and he must be bored. It’s been a long time since he last met a severe enough case, right?”
Ling Ran nodded gently.
Doctor Zhou smiled sincerely.
When the two nurses at the side saw this, they felt angry and spoke at the same time.
“Doctor Ling just came back, and he needs rest.”
“Doctor Zhou, your job is not just to perform intradermal suture.”

Doctor Zhou only chuckled and let them be. He turned around and left, “I’ll go to the toilet first. Pay attention so that you can receive the patient in time. Don’t be late to his treatment. Doctor Ling, I’ll leave the rest to you.”
“Okay,” Ling Ran replied in a simple manner. He hung around in the emergency room because he wanted to perform surgery, after all.
Just like what Doctor Zhou had said, Ling Ran really missed accident patients when he was at Bazhaixiang over the past few days.

Compared to hepatectomy, cholecystitis, injuries sustained through falls, burnt and scalded patients, surgery for car accident patients was simpler and cruder. From the perspective of a surgeon, that meant the surgery was more straightforward, and the results were clearer...
A clear result was always something surgeons pursued.
Ling Ran followed the young nurse to the reception door. He even felt a bit excited.
A while later, an ambulance drove over.
Then, a man with a haggard look, blood on his face, and shut eyes was pushed into the hospital.
“Electrocardiogram.” Ling Ran requested. Then, he pushed the patient away.
The family members came with the ambulance. They quickly followed the patient. They looked at both the doctor and the patient, and they did not know what to do.
“I just changed my direction,” the patient muttered. Anyone who was not close to him would not hear him.
Ling Ran heard that but did not further question him.

Surgeries in the Emergency Department had standard operating procedures, and most of the time, the basic procedure was to anesthetize the patients, but the words spoken by patients under anesthesia cannot be trusted.
The gurney was pushed with maximum speed into the operating theater.
Ling Ran washed his hands and entered the operating theater again.
It was spacious, bright, familiar, and he could work smoothly here.
This was the feeling Ling Ran had when he was back in the operating theater at Yun Hua Hospital.
At the same time, Lu Wenbin and Ma Yanlin also came into the operating theater.

“Invite the Orthopedics Department, Neurosurgery Department, and General Surgery Department for consultation...” Although Ling Ran could do inter-departmental surgery, he would not actually take up every single task, not at the cost of missing out on a lot more.
The circulating nurse who was already prepared for it, immediately took the phone and informed those departments.

In Yun Hua Hospital’s system, where there were emergency consultations, departments were required to reach them in three minutes. In order to meet the demand, some departments would even locate some people at the Emergency Medical Center.
However, only when the chief surgeon confirmed that a consultation was necessary would they invite these people over.
At the same time, Ling Ran started to perform bleeding control. He also checked the patient and sutured certain wounds.
*Ring, ring, ring*
Zuo Cidian’s phone rang.
Zuo Cidian hesitated for a while. He still picked up the phone when he saw that the caller was the town mayor.
“Old Zuo, it’s been a long time.” A greeting was immediately heard from the phone.
“I’m now at the operating theater,” Zuo Cidian whispered.

“Then, I’ll cut the story short. I’ve something to trouble you.” The town mayor chuckled and said, “I’m not sure if your hospital has received a patient called Wang Chuanli. He’s in his forties, and he was sent over to Yun Hua Hospital due to a car accident...”
Zuo Cidian peeped at the operating theater and said, “We might have received him.”
“Really? Then how’s his condition? Is it serious?”
“Serious.” Zuo Cidian gave an affirmative answer.

The town mayor was stunned when he heard that, and he said, “Old Zuo, you’ve got to do me a favor. This is an investor who came and investigated our town... Let me put it this way, only use the best drugs on him, you must save the life of this person. I’m now rushing to Yun Hua, let’s chat about this again when we meet...”
“Okay,” Zuo Cidian replied. He ended the call promptly.
For Ling Ran, such words were not necessary.

chapters.title: Chapter 893: Morning
paragraphs: An attending physician from the General Surgery Department, an attending physician from the Orthopedics Department, and a resident doctor from the Neurosurgery Department came—one after another—to the operating theater in the Emergency Medical Center. They stood in their positions, read their scans, and quietly analyzed the situation.

Among them, the resident doctor from the Neurosurgery Department looked the calmest, while the attending physician from the General Surgery and the attending physician from the Orthopedics Department looked very serious.

Under normal inter-departmental consultations, specialist departments normally sent out resident doctors. Most of the emergency cases were not serious, after all, there were patients who had their heads hit a clock, legs hit a clock, or an*ses hitting a clock, and all of them came for consultation. During those times, resident doctors were enough to treat them.
Even if there were patients with serious symptoms, the resident doctor could make their judgment and send them to the relevant departments.
As for the attending physicians in the department, they could chill when they were free, but they needed to stay in their department and chill.
However, if Ling Ran wanted a consultation, then to certain departments, they could not treat it as something casual.
For example, the Orthopedics Department and General Surgery Department dared not send resident doctors over.
The departments were still keen on preserving their dignity.

It was not embarrassing to serve as the junior doctor for a doctor like Ling Ran, but if he or she could not answer a question or was completely unable to answer whatsoever, then it would be bad. If there were any mistakes made during the operation, it would make the situation worse.
Under normal circumstances, specialist departments had a psychological advantage over the Emergency Department.

However, in Yun Hua Hospital, the normal doctors from the Orthopedics Department or General Surgery Department had lost their psychological advantage over Ling Ran, and the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery even had a psychological disadvantage...

When they worked for other doctors in the Emergency Department (in the past) or in the Emergency Medical Center (as it was known as now), they did not worry that other doctors would look for their faults. After all, it was impossible for them to make any mistakes in a normal operation, and emergency doctors could not find fault in the specific operations, anyway.
However, when they faced Ling Ran, the doctors from the Orthopedics Department or General Surgery Department felt like they were working under the supervision of a department director.

“By the looks of it now, there are two main parts. The bone fracture at the ankle is simpler, so we can just apply plastering after the surgery. The more serious part is at the shoulder. It should be a Colles’ fracture. I think he needs to undergo surgery to receive reduction...” The attending physician of the Orthopedics Department opened up and suggested his plan first.
Ling Ran nodded and accepted it. “Do the plastering for the bone fracture later, pass the Colles’ fracture to Zuo Cidian.”
“Then...” The attending physician of the Orthopedics Department was surprised and pointed at himself.

If this was in the past, he would definitely argue with Ling Ran without bothering about the difficulty of Colles’ fracture. No matter what, it was still considered to be the Orthopedics Department’s work.
However, this was not the first day it was known that Huo Congjun liked snatching over everything in the Emergency Medical Center, while Ling Ran...
Ling Ran was never the sharing kind when it came to surgery.
The young attending physician of the Orthopedics Department was depressed and looked at Ling Ran before he smiled in resignation. “Then, we don’t have any business here.”
“If there’s no other problem with the bone, the Emergency Medical Center can handle the patient’s bone fracture.” Ling Ran’s answer was incredibly clear.
“Alright, then I’ll go back now.” The young attending physician of the Orthopedics Department did not talk much. He turned around and left straightaway.

“I...” The attending physician of the Orthopedics Department could not help but turn around, then he saw Ling Ran’s side profile, and he could not help but have his words change. “It’s bad if we don’t have work now?”
The attending physician of the General Surgery Department shrugged. “As long as you feel good, then it’s not a problem.”

The attending physician of the Orthopedics Department became angry. He did not leave, but stood at the front and said, “I’d like to see what work you can get.”
“At least an ascending colon.” The attending physician of the General Surgery Department chuckled and said, “Everyone knows that Doctor Ling does not do intestines...”
“The ascending colon ruptured?”

“Maybe it was pierced through by an iron sheet.” The attending physician of the General Surgery Department raised his head and said, “The exact situation is more complicated, I’m not going to describe it.”
The attending physician of the Orthopedics Department was angry, but could do nothing about it.

I see that the spleen has been removed, and the stomach seems to be repaired. There’s no need to even mention the few abdominal wounds...”
As he said this, he became depressed. The surgeries had been performed by the Emergency Department, so the space given for the General Surgery Department to survive naturally became smaller...
“When you mentioned colon repair, you mean there is a rupture at the ascending colon?” Ling Ran pointed at the scan, and it clearly showed a ruptured ascending colon.
The attending physician of the General Surgery Department nodded. “The surface area is not big. Later, I will use a laparoscope—”
“I’ve repaired it,” Ling Ran said.
“What?” The attending physician of the General Surgery Department not only was stunned when he heard this, he also thought that Ling Ran was wrong.

The attending physician of the General Surgery Department took two steps backwards.
The attending physician from the Orthopedist Department deliberately walked past him, smiled, and said, “I’ll go back first. Ascending colon... Haha...”
The attending physician’s features were twisted together, just like a colon.
He looked at Ling Ran angrily. Then, he stared at Ling Ran’s hands and fell into deep thought, ‘It’s truly well done!’
The attending physician of the Orthopedist Department saw his expression, looked in the direction of his gaze, and suddenly lost his interest at laughing at his peer.

They were one of the batches at Yun Hua Hospital which quickly got promoted to attending physicians. As the main force of their department, both of them were just over thirty five years old, and they were at the age where they could climb up the skill tree in the medical world the fastest. They were now the experts in their respective departments.
However, such arrogance, pride, and mocking words thrown at each other instantly became meaningless when they faced Ling Ran.
When the patient was pushed out, it was already sunset. Most of the hospital staff naturally clocked off work as well.
However, the doctors and nurses who walked out from the operating theater had no will to go back home at all or clock off work late. They just did what they needed to do.

Zuo Cidian was waiting outside the shower room and waited for Ling Ran to finish bathing and change his attire. After Ling Ran came out, he chuckled and went to him, “Doctor Ling, the patient’s family came over, and they want to give you a treat to express their gratitude.”
Ling Ran looked at Zuo Cidian in a puzzled manner, “Why did the previous patients’ families not give us a treat?”
If Zuo Cidian were not familiar with Ling Ran, Zuo Cidian would have been defeated by Ling Ran’s question.
“You are trying to ask what’s so special about this patient’s family, right?” Zuo Cidian slightly corrected Ling Ran’s words.
Ling Ran said, “Of course.”

“Hmm...” Zuo Cidian sighed quietly and said, “The patient resuscitated today is an investor from another place. Well... this means he’s pretty capable, and, the patient’s family is truly thankful for this.”
“Oh?”

“They wanted to donate to Yun Hua University School of Medicine.” Zuo Cidian looked at Ling Ran’s expression as he said, “When they first came to me, I ignored them, then they went to Yun Hua University School of Medicine. Dean Wu Junior purposely made a call to me and let me ask for your opinion. ”
Ling Ran thought about this for a while. “It’s okay to meet them, but there is no need for a meal.”

This was the strategy that Ling Ran always carried out. If Ling Ran agreed to have a meal with the people who wanted to treat him, he would probably spend most of his time every day in the restaurant.
Zuo Cidian immediately felt relieved. “Just a meeting will do. How about you fix the time?”
“Tomorrow morning. Come earlier,” Ling Ran said while drying his hair, and he slowly went away.
Zuo Cidian looked at Ling Ran’s back, and he used his foot to write the letters for morning, but it just looked like a very skewed version of a squiggly line written by a bent fork.

chapters.title: Chapter 894: Burnt and Scalded
paragraphs: Patient Wang Chuanli was admitted to the ICU. His breathing was as deep as the breathing of an old cow. Luckily, his lungs were still functioning, and everyone was delighted about it.
At least, the family members were still calm and had treated all the medical staff at the Emergency Medical Center who were willing to join at Prosperous Fountain Restaurant.

Although not many went, the family members’ attitude was one of the best ever seen, and the repayment... There was no repayment. The patient was already at the ICU, and even if the nurse wanted to flip the patient around a few more times to clean him up, the cardiologist would not allow that to happen.
By noon, Dean Wu Junior and the patient’s family members came to Ling Ran’s office.
Huo Congjun, who received the news, did not keep himself idle either. He showed up in a relaxed manner.
“Hello, Dean Wu, what a coincidence!” Huo Congjun greeted with a smile.
Dean Wu knew him well too. He looked at him with the ghost of a smile and said, “Department Director Huo, aren’t you keeping a really close eye on Ling Ran? I just came over to say hello.”
“Aren’t I here to say hello too?” Huo Congjun’s face did not show any sense of embarrassment.
“You came over to the Emergency Department to greet me?” Dean Wu purposefully shook his head.

Huo Congjun still did not feel ashamed. He stared ahead like an old monk when he held a woman, and his back was straight. He said, “Since you came here, I must come over to greet you. By the way, Ling Ran is teaching at Yun Hua Hospital, right? Did it go smoothly?”
“Of course. All the students like Ling Ran.”
“That’s great.”

Dean Wu pursed his lips while listening to the insincere reply from Huo Congjun. Then, he introduced the person behind him. “I forgot to introduce this person to you. This is Wang Chuanwen, the brother of the critically injured patient saved by Ling Ran yesterday. He rushed over and had just arrived by plane.”

“Oh, Mister Wang Chuanwen, hello.” When Huo Congjun faced the patient’s family member, whom he was not familiar with, he was like an old monk who met a rich person. He stared ahead, and his back was as straight as a board.
“Department Director Huo, sorry to trouble you this time as well.” Wang Chuanwen was older than Huo Congjun. His gray hair made him look haggard.
“It’s a doctor’s duty to treat the patient,” Huo Congjun said cordially to the patient’s family and pushed open the office door. He shouted, “Ling Ran—”
If he did this, the patient’s family member and Dean Wu would be considered to have been brought in by Huo Congjun.

Dean Wu knew this, but did not care about it. He did not have the intention to poach Ling Ran to his university, and since Yun Hua Hospital was affiliated to Yun Hua University, what was the use of trying to poach Ling Ran?

Certainly, if Ling Ran were willing to work full time at the campus, Dean Wu would welcome him very much. However, current clinicians would rarely make such a choice, and hence, he did not expect anything from Ling Ran.

“Doctor Ling will be back soon.” Intern Qi Zao became a delicate flower when she saw that important guests had suddenly come in, and she immediately served drinks to them. She explained, “The surgery in the operating theater is still not completed yet. Today, there is a hepatectomy going on. The surgery had started when he received the news.”
“The surgery is more important. Try to ask Ling Ran how much longer we’ll need to wait.” Huo Congjun did not give Dean Wu a chance to speak.

Dean Wu then nodded. Wang Chuanwen, who was at the side, apologized and said, “I’m sorry. We thought of coming over earlier, but I heard that Doctor Ling enters the operating theater at two or three in the morning, and that’s too early for us. So, we decided to postpone the time.”
“Normally, surgeries will start around four or five in the morning. Surgeries at two or three in the morning are less common.” Huo Congjun corrected.
Wang Chuanwen looked at Huo Congjun like he was a monk. He smiled faintly, “Four to five in the morning is still too early.”
“That’s true, too,” Huo Congjun replied and continued, “You came here just to meet Doctor Ling?”
“Also, to express our gratitude,” Wang Chuanwen said.
There was nothing wrong with people who valued their lives meeting high-end doctors.
On top of that, Wang Chuanwen was truly thankful to Ling Ran.

“Mister Wang Chuanwen is here to invest in Yun Hua Hospital.” Dean Wu looked at Huo Congjun and said, “Also, Mister Wang Chuanwen’s family has donated Yun Hua University an audio-visual classroom which provides great aid for our teaching staff and students. So when they faced problems now, we hoped to try our best and help...”
“Oh,” Huo Congjun replied and seemed as if he finally understood the relationship of both parties.
Wang Chuanwen hesitated and said, “My other three brothers plan to come over today too. I came over first to handle the problems about accommodation. I wonder, how’s my younger brother...?”

“How about this? We can go to the ICU to take a look first. The doctors in the ICU will have a better understanding of the details.” Huo Congjun became more enthusiastic for the sake of Dean Wu and because he always had good feelings toward charitable people.
A group of people then headed to ICU and listened to the detailed explanation by the doctor in the ICU.
When Ling Ran came out of the operating theater, Huo Congjun had started to do some introductions to Wang Chuanwen at the emergency room.
The scenario at the ICU was not pleasant. Usually, family members were not willing to spend a long time looking at their relatives in the ICU.
In comparison, although shouts could be heard nonstop from the emergency room, it seemed livelier.
“Doctor Ling, you’re here.” Dean Wu Junior saw Ling Ran from afar and immediately asked him to come over because it was too depressing to follow Huo Congjun moving around.

Ling Ran went over while still dressed in blue scrubs. Behind him was Lu Wenbin and Ma Yanlin, who wore scrubs as well. The strong and imposing manner they gave off was still the best in the hospital.
“Doctor Ling, hello...” Wang Chuanwen put on a very humble front.
The doctors of the ICU did nothing else but praise Ling Ran.

If there were certain groups of doctors who saw death the most, then one of them would be the doctors from the ICU. However, if there was a group of doctors who saw dying patients the most, then the ICU doctors would definitely be at the top.
Since they had seen many dying patients, they had their own standards for judgment when it came to the patient’s condition and their prognosis.
And within Yun Hua Hospital, Ling Ran was recognized as the doctor who produced the best prognosis.
If the prognosis was good, the patient would have better recovery and have a high chance of leaving the ICU successfully. That was one of the reasons why the ICU liked Ling Ran so much.
As Wang Chuanli’s eldest brother, Wang Chuanwen wanted his brother to receive the best medical protection. That was his greatest wish.

Wang Chuanwen went forward and held Ling Ran’s hand. He shook Ling Ran’s hand vigorously before releasing it in front of everyone. After thanking him repeatedly, he said, “Doctor Ling, can you tell me what is the best way for my brother’s body to recover?
Huo Congjun, who was at the side, was stunned, but shrugged. He did not stop him.

The patient’s family always wanted the best suggestion, but usually, they had no ability to judge which suggestions were the best. At the end of the day, it all depended on the doctor whom they trusted the most.

Ling Ran did not think too much about this. He thought about Wang Chuanli’s surgery and said, “He’ll be able to recover well by staying at the ICU now. The patient sustained great physical trauma. Judging from the current situation...”
*Ring, ring, ring*
*Ring, ring, ring*
Several doctors’ phones started to ring.

“A building is on fire.” Huo Congjun immediately picked up the phone before he turned around and frowned. He said, “It’s estimated that there will be a large number of burnt patients who will be sent over.”
As he said this, Huo Congjun looked at Wang Chuanwen and said, “Sorry, Mister Wang, the Emergency Department will become busier later.”
“Okay, I need to go.” Although Wang Chuanwen said that, he did not have the intention to immediately leave.

Huo Congjun did not care about him. He looked at Ling Ran and said, “If it’s just burns and scalds, then you don’t have to join the surgery. However, we need to clear the emergency room first and send away all the patients who can be transferred. Ling Ran, you will take care of those who can be treated immediately.”
COMMENT
“Oh? Okay.” Ling Ran agreed without thinking much.
He was not familiar with handling burns and scalds, but he could quickly treat the cases in the emergency room. In fact, he could do it as easily as breathing.
The doctors of the Emergency Medical Center who stood by the side started having their imaginations run wild.

Huo Congjun specialized in burns. When he went off to treat these patients, he naturally brought a few senior doctors with him. However, among the other doctors remaining were also treatment group leaders, and Ling Ran was to be in charge...

The patient’s family always wanted the best suggestion, but usually, they had no ability to judge which suggestions were the best.
At the end of the day, it all depended on the doctor whom they trusted the most.
Ling Ran did not think too much about this.
He thought about Wang Chuanli’s surgery and said, “He’ll be able to recover well by staying at the ICU now.
The patient sustained great physical trauma.
Judging from the current situation...”
*Ring, ring, ring*
*Ring, ring, ring*
Several doctors’ phones started to ring.
“A building is on fire.” Huo Congjun immediately picked up the phone before he turned around and frowned.
He said, “It’s estimated that there will be a large number of burnt patients who will be sent over.”
As he said this, Huo Congjun looked at Wang Chuanwen and said, “Sorry, Mister Wang, the Emergency Department will become busier later.”
“Okay, I need to go.” Although Wang Chuanwen said that, he did not have the intention to immediately leave.
Huo Congjun did not care about him.
He looked at Ling Ran and said, “If it’s just burns and scalds, then you don’t have to join the surgery.
However, we need to clear the emergency room first and send away all the patients who can be transferred.
Ling Ran, you will take care of those who can be treated immediately.”
COMMENT
“Oh?
Okay.” Ling Ran agreed without thinking much.
He was not familiar with handling burns and scalds, but he could quickly treat the cases in the emergency room.
In fact, he could do it as easily as breathing.
The doctors of the Emergency Medical Center who stood by the side started having their imaginations run wild.
Huo Congjun specialized in burns.
When he went off to treat these patients, he naturally brought a few senior doctors with him.
However, among the other doctors remaining were also treatment group leaders, and Ling Ran was to be in charge...

chapters.title: Chapter 895: Flurry and Chaos
paragraphs: Huo Congjun left the moment he said that he would. He called several resident doctors and attending physicians over and gave them some orders. He then headed to his Burn Center to attend to things.

As a former military doctor, most things Huo Congjun knew about medicine was about burns. Hence, when there was a large number of burn patients, Huo Congjun was not satisfied with merely exercising his role as a department director.
Everyone’s gaze shifted from Huo Congjun to Ling Ran.
A few ordinary resident doctors could not help but look doubtfully at Ling Ran.
They had watched as Ling Ran entered the hospital, conquered his internship and became a resident doctor without being a houseman first. And they knew that Ling Ran was way out of their league.
No one in Yun Hua Hospital doubted Ling Ran’s skill anymore. But when it came to management, things were different.
Everyone had rarely seen Ling Ran speak out in public, let alone gave brief speeches as a leader. And the situation in the Emergency Department right now was tense...

“Next, all treatment groups must transfer all the patients that can be transferred to other departments. As for those who cannot be transferred, divide them into ‘critical’, ‘serious’, and ‘minor’.” Ling Ran had experienced the entirety of two disaster relief efforts, plus he did not even know how serious this fire was, so there was nothing much for him to be afraid about.
It was never a problem for Ling Ran to handle a major situation.

“Zuo Cidian, take a houseman with you and go to the patient assistance desk to help out. Tell the patients and their family members about the current situation. Ask the patients who don’t fulfill the criterion for emergency treatment to leave or head to specialized departments for treatment.
“As for patients in the ward who are qualified to be discharged, try to discharge them as soon as possible. Nurses, start rolling out extra beds.”
Ling Ran was talking very quickly, but his meaning was very clear, and his logic was sound. The slightly tense atmosphere in the emergency room quickly dissipated.
After that, Ling Ran looked at the resident doctors and said, “All treatment groups should go ahead with their tasks. If there’s a need, I’ll help out.”
The resident doctors who had just relaxed a little froze for a moment. They raised their heads and wanted to ask some questions, but Ling Ran was already heading toward the treatment room.

“About this...” A resident doctor with such an ordinary appearance that other people could not even remember his name went over to Zuo Cidian and quickly asked, “Doctor Zuo, what procedure are we following now? I don’t know what to tell our chief physician after he comes out of the operating theater later...”
“Carry on with your tasks, and Doctor Ling will be helping out. Is there anything you don’t understand about this?” Zuo Cidian said flatly.
“I guess I don’t understand the part about Doctor Ling helping out. How will he be helping out? I’ll have to tell our chief physician about it...” the resident doctor said meekly.

It was tougher to work in the Emergency Department than other specialized departments because even chief physicians and associate chief physicians had to be at the forefront of the charge. Aside from the fact that they got to sleep more when they were on the night shift, they rarely received any special treatment.

That was very tough on the bodies of senior doctors who were already old and frail. And for junior doctors, it was also very tough for them to always have their superiors around them. This really bored them too.

So, if the resident doctors did not want to be scolded by the chief physicians and associate chief physicians, not only would they have to perform well in the operating theater and when making ward rounds, but they also had to carry out the daily tasks involved in the operating theater well.

Now that a resident doctor who looked so ordinary that it was hard for others to remember his name was asking a question, the other junior doctors who were working in the treatment room also crowded over.
Since they did not dare to crowd around Ling Ran, who was basically their boss, they had no choice but to crowd around Zuo Cidian, who always wore a smile on his wrinkled face.
Zuo Cidian gazed at the first resident doctor who spoke for a few seconds, but he was unable to remember the name of the ordinary-looking physician doctor. So, he asked, “Who’s your chief physician?”
“Chief Physician Tao,” the resident doctor answered.
“Oh... Chief Physician Tao will be fine with it. He’s a mild-tempered man, and we’re facing an emergency situation now. Don’t you think so?” Zou Cidian smiled.
“How about Department Associate Director Du? What should I report to him?” another resident doctor asked Zuo Cidian.
Zuo Cidian looked at the other party and flashed another smile. “Department Associate Director Du will be fine with it too.”
“How about Associate Chief Physician Li...”
“Associate Chief Physician Li will be fine with it too.”

There were only two chief physicians in the Emergency Medical Center, and they were Huo Congjun and Chief Physician Tao. There were also three associate chief physicians, and two of them had their own treatment groups. Along with the Ling Treatment Group, they had five treatment groups in total.
After the resident doctors asked Zuo Cidian about their respective group leaders, they realized that Zuo Cidian was saying all of them would be fine with it.
“How could they be fine with it?”
“Maybe Chief Physician Tao is indeed mild-tempered, but will the other leaders be fine with it?”

“I know, right? Associate Chief Physician Li from our treatment group is super hot-tempered. If he asks me about this later and I’m unable to come up with a satisfactory answer, he’ll probably flay me alive.”
“Our boss isn’t an amicable man either...”
Zuo Cidian started chuckling.
Everyone looked at him, and he smiled. “So, do you think that your leaders are more hot-tempered, or do you think that Department Director Huo is more hot-tempered?”
The resident doctors who were uttering a cacophony of complaints immediately went silent.

Zuo Cidian looked around and realized that there was nobody else around. Hence, he continued, “I’ll tell you guys something else: if someone were to call me out on it at a later date, I won’t admit that I was the one who said it.”
All the resident doctors nodded.
Zuo Cidian nodded a little and said in his slightly hoarse voice, “Do you guys think that Doctor Ling is an amicable person?”
The resident doctors looked at each other vigilantly. They then realized what Zuo Cidian was implying and started chuckling.

“That’s why.” Zuo Cidian took a deep breath. “Go ahead with your tasks. Clear out the patients in your respective treatment group. If you’re unable to discharge enough patients or the process is going slowly, Doctor Ling will go and help out.”

All the resident doctors understood what was going on now. Ling Ran was not an amicable person who was taking charge instead of Huo Congjun. He was the whip that Huo Congjun was using to dominate them.
This was totally Huo Congjun’s style.

The resident doctors did not say anything else. Those who were supposed to make calls did so, and those who had tasks on their plates went about them. They looked like a flock of sparrows who were shocked by the chiming of the clock tower, dying to sh*t on every single bald head in the temples.
Ling Ran discharged many of the patients from his treatment group.

His treatment group executed a policy where patients were kept in the hospital for a long time because the Emergency Medical Center was not monitored for the turnover of patients. Hence, there were even some patients in his wards who were only going through rehabilitation exercises.

Of course, these patients would be able to recover faster if they were to rehabilitate in the hospital. However, they would not be greatly affected if they were to rest at home. They would just take a month or two longer to recover.
Ling Ran authorized the discharge forms for almost twenty patients at one go. It was only after that did he wash his hands and return to the emergency room.
Right now, all the treatment groups in the emergency room were busy.

The second-string attending physicians had come over from the waiting rooms, their home or even operating theaters so that they could clear out all the patients in the treatment room, where the patients with minor burns would be gathered. The nurses were changing the treatment room’s layout so that a large number of burn patients could fit inside.
As for the third-strong associate chief physicians and chief physicians, some of them had exited the operating theaters, while some were still working in the operating theaters.

As usual, the resident doctors were always the busiest. They were akin to worker bees in the hive, junior monks in the temples, and pimps in wh*rehouses. They needed to work while other people were sleeping. They needed to work when other people were working in their beds. When other people finished their work in their beds and rested, they still had to work.
Ling Ran stood with his hands clasped behind his back. He swept his gaze around the treatment room like a hawk and made various judgments.
A patient suffering from abdominal pain and was suspected to suffer from appendicitis was sent to the General Surgery Department. What a waste!
A patient with a minor fracture was transferred to the Orthopedics Department after receiving an X-ray. What a waste!

A patient, whose buttocks were whipped so badly that it was bleeding, was restrained by his parents and a resident doctor at the same time. He let out a shrill scream as he received an injection... This one was not going anywhere.
Ling Ran stopped in his tracks. He immediately went over to them and said, “I’ll do it.”

The flustered resident doctor was not even able to voice out his objection. He had no choice but to continue restraining the patient. He watched as Ling Ran grabbed the needle holder and administered anesthetics.

Usually, patients with such minor injuries were the best source material for resident doctors or even housemen to put in some practice. But today, they were forced to be relegated to assistants who did not actually do anything.

Ling Ran quickly administered local anesthetics. He then quickly performed drainage and stitched up the wound. Before the resident doctor could react, Ling Ran left, inadvertently passing the patient with stitches on his buttocks to the other party.

Soon after that, Ling Ran immediately performed a tracheotomy on a patient beside him who was having difficulty breathing. After electrocardiography was done, the patient was transferred to the Cardiology Department.
It was flurry and chaos in the emergency room.

To clear out the treatment room and make way for burn patients as soon as possible, all the doctors who were supposed to be resting were working. As for the patients in the waiting room, they were quickly being categorized and treated.
While the doctors were busy working, the siren of an ambulance rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 896: Is There Any Way That I Can Be of Help?
paragraphs: There were many adorable aspects to hospitals such as the young female nurses, young female caregivers, and young female doctors...
If a person had nothing to do and was merely walking around in a hospital, the landscape of the hospital would usually appear quite beautiful. Moreover, ambulances actually looked pretty adorable.
However, very few people went to hospitals because of that.
Compared with the bloodiness, the adorable aspects of hospitals were nothing.
That was especially true when it came to burn victims.

The atmosphere in the emergency room immediately became ice-cold the moment two burn patients were sent in. It was as if someone suddenly filled the main hall of a temple with ice on a scorching hot day. More than one person reached out to scratch their heads.
Ling Ran’s mood was also a little affected.

Within the field of clinical medicine, burns had always been what Huo Congjun majored in, and he also had the intention of passing the craft to Ling Ran. However, compared to ordinary surgeries, burns were closer to internal medicine. Aside from that, whether a person was to look at it from an aesthetic point of view or in terms of the treatment process, the treatment of burns was far from “orderly”.
For burn patients, there were way too many variables.

The two patients entered via the reception door and appeared before everyone for around ten seconds. They were then wheeled into a room that was specifically built for the treatment of burns. Huo Congjun and the associate chief physician under him, as well as a group of attending physicians and resident doctors, were there. As the biggest treatment group in the Emergency Medical Center, at most, they were capable of treating twenty patients with minor burns or four patients with serious burns at once.
“Focus on your own tasks.” When Ling Ran noticed that his surroundings had gone from being full of flurry and chaos to sheer panic, he immediately furrowed his eyebrows.

Even though everyone’s attention was diverted by the burn patients, Ling Ran’s presence was tremendously strong. Whenever he was unhappy, even if he only furrowed his eyebrows a little, everyone could sense it immediately.
Ling Ran did not need to say anything. Some experienced nurses dispersed the crowd of resident doctors who were watching the burn patients like she was chasing away a crowd of young monks.
“Stop looking and carry on with your own tasks.”
“Why are you watching? Haven’t you seen burn patients before?”
“If you want to help out with the burn patients, you can stay for a night shift. We’ll reward you with some fruits.”
Some of the patients’ family members in the emergency room also took the initiative to ask their family members to disperse.

In Chinese hospitals, it was unavoidable that patients’ family members had to carry out a lot of extra and irrelevant tasks. And because of this, the hospitals got to save on manpower. But this resulted in extra chaos.

Meanwhile, in the wards, the longer a patient stayed in the hospital, the more familiar his family members were with the hospital. It was to the point that they would even see life in the hospital as part of their life, just like how patients had no choice but to see their illnesses as part of their body. It was not a pleasing choice, because there were no other options for them.

There were always regular patients and their family members in the emergency room. Nowadays, it was harder to get a hospital bed in a tertiary Grade A hospital compared to f*cking an internet celebrity, and it was more expensive too.

Comparatively, it was much easier to obtain a hospital bed in the emergency room. At least, patients who were ill but not in a critical condition could just call an ambulance and be sent to the emergency room.
This was what many regular patients often did.

And today, the hospital beds in the emergency room were more scarce than usual. A few resident doctors furrowed their eyebrows as they tried to persuade a few patients whose conditions were not too serious to leave. They also transferred even more patients to other departments so that those departments could worry about those patients.

At a time like this, departments that were not usually willing to take in regular patients had no choice but to put on a nice facade and take in a patient or two. Hence, the emergency room was able to free up some space.
For that purpose, Zuo Cidian talked so much that his tongue became thinner.

At that moment, however, Huo Congjun did not emerge again. He was fully focused on the two burn patients whom they had just taken in. Aside from making sure that their vitals were fine, the doctors also had to monitor their amount of urine and fluid transfused as well as prevent infection. It was an extremely complicated task.
Ling Ran, who was in the emergency room, was getting into the zone.

After experiencing the flood in Brazil and the mudflow in Bazhaixiang, Ling Ran was very used to handling such calamities, to begin with. If there was something that he was not used to, it would be the fact that problems would always arise in terms of cooperation with other doctors.

Not only were the chief physicians and associate chief physicians who were leaders of treatment groups not used to Ling Ran’s leadership style, but attending physicians like Zhao Leyi were also not very willing to take orders from Ling Ran.
When faced with this situation, Ling Ran solved the problem by... doing it himself.

He did not even put the fact that there would be doctors who were unwilling to take orders from him into consideration. It was just like how the doctors in the Emergency Medical Center never expected Ling Ran to possess such a great number of skills.

When it came to general surgeries, Ling Ran could deal with anything between the stomach and the an*s. As for orthopedics surgeries, he could handle anything from the fingers to the elbow and from the toes to the knee. He also knew all kinds of skills that could help a patient retain his or her life. It could be said that Ling Ran was a lot more adept at treating patients with those ailments compared to other doctors. As for patients who were not within that scope, ordinary emergency medical specialists were not capable of dealing with them either.
Ling Ran treated patients from one end of the emergency room to the other. He then repeated the process.
Those who were willing to take orders from Ling Ran did things according to Ling Ran’s arrangements, while those who refused to do so naturally had their position as chief surgeon snatched away.
Even the only chief physician present, Chief Physician Tao, listened to Ling Ran’s orders. He followed a patient on a gurney into an operating theater and did not emerge after that.
“Wow, is he Superman?” Zuo Cidian had just returned from the inpatient building, and he saw Ling Ran treating patients one by one at lightning speed.

As the doctor who was the best at administration in Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center, Zuo Cidian naturally did not think that what Ling Ran was doing was the best choice. However, it was an extremely pleasing sight.

“Ling Ran truly lives up to his reputation of being skillful.” Dean Wu did not leave the emergency room. He was standing beside Wang Chuangwen and peering at Ling Ran from afar with a look of admiration on his face. “He’s blessed by God indeed.”

Zuo Cidian chuckled a few times and tried to downplay Ling Ran’s achievements so that he could make Ling Ran sound humble. “That’s what Doctor Ling is like. He doesn’t mind offending people if he has set his mind to something.”

“With such skills, he doesn’t need to worry about offending anyone in the Emergency Department.” Dean Wu laughed and said half-jokingly, “If it weren’t for the fact that Old Huo is too fierce, I would have asked Ling Ran to head to Yun Hua University and offend people.”

“Never say this in front of Department Director Huo.” Zuo Cidian’s shoulders tensed up a little without him realizing. When he saw Wang Chuanwen, who was standing beside Dean Wu, he decided to put his social skills to use. “You told me earlier that your three younger brothers will be here soon, right? I’m afraid that Doctor Ling might be too busy to attend to them. If you need stuff such as information, you can ask me about it.”
“There’s no rush. As for you, is there any way that I can be of help?” Wang Chuanwen also put his great social skills to use.
Zuo Cidian froze for a moment. “What do you mean by that?”

“We plan to make some donations and start a few charity projects in Changxi Province. You guys... I mean, what does Doctor Ling need the most right now?” Wang Chuanwen’s gaze followed Ling Ran’s blue scrubs.

Most of the doctors in the emergency room were clad in large white coats, and Ling Ran’s blue scrubs were especially jarring amid the sea of large white coats. In addition, Wang Chuanwen was giving his silent approval to Ling Ran’s efficiency and style of getting things done.
